description: Terrestrial herbs with underground tubers; stem glabrous (to pubescent). Foliage leaves 1–2, basal or cauline. Inflorescence spicate, often secund; bracts much smaller than the foliage leaves, much shorter than the flowers. Flowers resupinate, white to mauve or purple (rarely yellow). Sepals plain (i.e., not saccate); dorsal sepal 2–7.5 mm long. Labellum narrowly attached to the column, 3-lobed, often finely puberulose on the ventral side, spurred at base; spur shorter than the labellum lamina, not constricted at base. Column with a slightly bilobed, flat to convex stigma; distal part of rostellum narrow, straight, squeezed in between the thecae; viscidia 2, naked; anther firmly attached, thecae not extending from the column; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous. Fruit a capsule.</br></br>A genus of ca. 30 species distributed from north-eastern India, Tibet, northern Thailand and northern Vietnam across China to Taiwan, Korea, Japan and the Kuril Islands; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 4–8 cm tall; stem 0.6–0.8 mm in diameter, 2-leaved. Foliage leaves basal, subsessile, (ob)lanceolate-oblong with sheathing, overlapping bases, acuminate, 2.2–4 by 0.8–1.1 cm. Inflorescence lax, secund; rachis up to 2 cm long, 1- to 4-flowered; bracts ovate, acute to acuminate, 2.4–4.2 by 1.4–2.7 mm. Flowers white. Sepals boat-shaped, obtuse, glabrous, 1-veined; dorsal sepal ovate to elliptic, 2.6–2.9 by 1.7–2 mm; lateral sepals obliquely ovate, 2.5–3.4 by 1.5–2.1 mm. Petals more or less connivent with the dorsal sepal, obliquely elliptic, obtuse to rounded, minutely dentate by protruding marginal cells, glabrous, 1-veined. 2.5–2.7 by 1.5–1.6 mm. Labellum moderately 3-lobed at the middle, finely puberulose on the ventral side. 4–5.6 by 4.7–6.2 mm; side lobes obliquely oblong, rounded; mid-lobe broadly obovate-oblong, rounded; spur downcurved, cylindrical, rounded, 3–3.8 mm long. Column semiterete, 1.2–1.5 mm long; stigma flat. Ovary 5.8–8 mm long.

description: Terrestrial, rhizomatous herbs; the creeping stem-like rhizome rooting from its nodes. Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base. 7–34 cm tall. Foliage leaves (2–)3–7, crowded on the lower part of the stem, petiolate, sheathing at base. Inflorescence racemose (to spicate); bracts acuminate, (glandular-)pubescent on the dorsal side. Flowers 1–15, resupinate. Sepals free, obtuse to acuminate, 1-veined; dorsal sepal porrect over the column, 5.1–13.4 mm long; lateral sepals more or less spreading. Petals adherent (rarely adnate) to the dorsal sepal, acuminate to obtuse. Labellum basally adnate to the column, straight (i.e. not twisted), 6–12 mm long along the mid-line, differentiated into hypochile, mesochile, and epichile; hypochile spurred (protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals when the flower is viewed from the side), spur inside with 1 subsessile appendage on either side; mesochile with one pair of entire to pectinate lateral flanges: epichile deeply bilobed. Column straight (i.e., not twisted), with two parallel wings on the front; stigma bipartite, flat; rostellum triangular, bifid: viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile, (sub)acuminate in front; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary (glandular-)pubescent. Fruit a capsule dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 30 species distributed from tropical Southeast Asia to northeastern Queensland and the western Pacific islands; 6 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 7–32.5 cm tall. Foliage leaves very dark green to brown with pink to whitish reticulation above, uniformly pink below; lamina obliquely (ovate-helliptic, acute to subacuminate, mucronate, (1.8–)3.1–7 by (1.3–)2–5.5 cm. Inflorescence glandular-pubescent; rachis 1.5–7.6 cm long, 3- to 13-flowered; bracts lanceolate-oblong to ovate-lanceolate, 1-veined, pubescent on the dorsal side, 10.1–12 by 3.9–5.9 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled to subsessile, mainly greenish-yellow to purplish-green with white labellum. Sepals glandular pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal lanceolate-oblong, 8.6–9.3 by 3.9–4.1 mm; lateral sepals obliquely oblanceolate-oblong, subacuminate to obtuse, 9.4–9.9 by 3.4–3.5 mm. Petals obliquely oblanceolate, 8.4–9.6 by ca. 2.9 mm. Labellum 6.8–7 mm long along the mid-line; spur pointing backwards (parallel to the ovary), describing an obtuse to nearly right angle to the mesochile, fusiform-ovoid, retuse, ca. 4.5 mm long, only the pointed apex protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals; mesochile with a pair of pectinate flanges; epichile lobules 6.5–6.6 mm long, 1.5–2.5 times as long as wide, describing an acute angle to each other when flattened, forming a tiny conical receptacle at base. Column porrect (more or less continuing the line of the ovary), 5.6–5.9 mm long; wings on the front not prolonged into the spur; anther 5.1–5.3 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 9–13 mm long. Capsule suberect, short-pedicelled to subsessile, 1.2–1.4 cm long, 0.4–0.5 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 17–34 cm tall. Foliage leaves bronze-black with copper-red reticulation above, uniformly copper-red below; lamina obliquely (ovate-)elliptic, acuminate to acute, mucronate, 2.7–8.3 by 1.8–5.2 cm. Inflorescence glandular-pubescent; rachis 2.5–9.5 cm long, 3- to 13-flowered; bracts ovate to lanceolate, 1-veined, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 9.9–10.3 by 3.9–6.9 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled, mainly copper-red with pale yellow petals and yellow labellum. Sepals glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, dorsal sepal (broadly) ovate, 5.1–5.6 by 3.8–5.2 mm; lateral sepals obliquely oblanceolate-oblong to obovate-oblong, 6.6–7.3 by 3–4.2 mm. Petals falcately and very obliquely obovate-oblanceolate, 5.9–7.4 by 2.1–2.9 mm. Labellum 8–10.5 mm long along the mid-line; spur pointing downwards (more or less perpendicular to the ovary), describing a right angle to the mesochile, conical, obtuse to rounded, 2.4–3.1 mm long, approximately the distal half protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals; mesochile with a pair of narrow entire flanges; epichile lobules 4–8 mm long, 2.5–3 times as long as wide, describing an obtuse to acute angle to each other when flattened, flat at base. Column reflexed (describing a right to acute angle to the ovary), 3.7–4.6 mm long; wings on the front not prolonged into the spur; anther 3.7–4 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 8–17 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 7–17 cm tall. Foliage leaves dark greenish-brown with golden or copper-red reticulation; lamina obliquely and broadly ovate to elliptic, acuminate to obtuse and mucronate, (1.5–)1.8–7 by (1.2–)1.5–4.5 cm. Inflorescence (glandular-)pubescent; rachis up to 1.8 cm long, 1- to 5-flowered; bracts ovate, 3-veined, pubescent on the dorsal side, 11–15 by 8–8.3 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled, predominantly white with two pink spots on the labellum and reddish indumentum on the sepals. Sepals covered with mainly non-glandular hairs on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal ovate-lanceolate, 10.8–12 by ca. 5 mm; lateral sepals obliquely and narrowly oblong, ca. 11.2 by ca. 4.5 mm. Petals very obliquely linear-oblong, ca. 11.8 by ca. 3 mm. Labellum 7–9 mm long along the mid-line; spur pointing backwards (parallel to the ovary), describing a right (to slightly obtuse) angle to the mesochile, cylindric, rounded to obtuse, 9–14 mm long, approximately the distal half protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals; mesochile with a pair of pectinate flanges; epichile lobules 5–7.5 mm long, 1.3–1.8 times as long as wide, describing a very obtuse angle to each other when flattened, forming a tiny conical receptacle at base. Column porrect (more or less continuing the line of the ovary), 6–7.8 mm long; wings on the front strongly prolonged, nearly reaching the bottom of the spur; anther ca. 6.4 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 15–16 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 9–21 cm tall. Foliage leaves dark green with pink to whitish reticulation above, uniformly purplish to pale green below, lamina broadly and obliquely ovate to elliptic, acute to obtuse, mucronate, (1.4)2–5.7 by (0.9–)1.2–3.9 cm. Inflorescence glandular-pubescent; rachis up to 5.1 cm long, 1- to 11-flowered; bracts ovate, 1-veined, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 8.7–9 by 5.7–6.4 mm. Flowers subsessile, mainly green with white petal margins and labellum and pale orange column. Sepals glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal ovate, ca. 7.5 by ca. 4.2 mm; lateral sepals obliquely linear-oblong, 10.3–10.5 by ca. 3.7 mm. Petals falcately and very obliquely oblanceolate-oblong, 8–8.1 by 3–3.2 mm. Labellum 6–8.7 mm long along the mid-line; spur pointing backwards (parallel to the ovary), describing an obtuse angle to the mesochile, (conical-)cylindric, retuse, 4.5–5.5 mm long, approximately the distal half protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals; mesochile with a pair of narrow (erose-)dentate flanges; epichile lobules 7–11.3 mm long, 4–5 times as long as wide, describing an acute angle to each other when flattened, flat at base. Column porrect (more or less continuing the line of the ovary), ca. 4.7 mm long; wings on the front not prolonged into the spur; anther ca. 3.8 mm long. Ovary 8.5–14 mm long. Capsule spreading, subsessile, ca. 1.6 cm long, 0.5–0.6 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots (9–)14–26 cm tall. Foliage leaves velvety, dark purplish-green with red, pink or yellow reticulation; lamina obliquely (ovate-)elliptic, obtuse to acute, mucronate, (1.6–)2.8–6 by (0.9–)2–4 cm. Inflorescence glandular-pubescent; rachis up to 8.6 cm long, 1- to 14-flowered; bracts triangular-ovate, 1-veined (to 3-veined), glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 7.5–12.6 by 3.5–5.9 mm. Flowers subsessile, mainly reddish-brown (to greenish-white) with white to cream petals and labellum. Sepals covered with mainly glandular hairs on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal broadly lanceolate, 10.9–13.4 by 5–5.4 mm; lateral sepals obliquely oblanceolate-oblong, 11.6–15 by 4.6–5 mm. Petals obliquely linear-oblanceolate, 11.4–13.5 by 2.5–3.4 mm. Column porrect (more or less continuing the line of the ovary), 6.8–8.2 mm long; wings on the front moderately prolonged, reaching approximately half-way down the spur; anther 5.8–7.5 mm long. description: Flowering shoots 11–30 cm tall, Foliage leaves velvety, dark green with golden to copper red reticulation above, uniformly pinkish-purple below; lamina obliquely elliptic to broadly ovate, short-acuminate to acute or rounded, mucronate, 1.1–7.8 by 0.9–5.5 cm. Inflorescence glandular-pubescent; rachis up to 15 cm long, 2- to 15-flowered (rarely 1-flowered); bracts ovate, 1- to 3-veined, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 5–15 by 4–6.8 mm. Flowers short pedicelled, mainly green to whitish-pink with white labellum and column. Sepals glandular pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal recurved at apex, ovate, 6.4–6.7 by 3.5–5.2 mm; lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate-oblong, 7.4–8.8 by 3.4–4.3 mm. Petals very obliquely oblanceolate, 6.3–6.7 by 2.4–2.5 mm. Labellum 6.2–7.5 mm long along the mid-line; spur pointing forwards (more or less continuing the line of the ovary), describing an acute angle to the mesochile, slenderly conical, retuse to emarginate, 2.5–5.2 mm long, approximately the distal half protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals; mesochile with a pair of pectinate flanges; epichile lobules 4–10 mm long, 2–3 times as long as wide, describing an acute to obtuse angle to each other when flattened, forming a tiny conical receptacle at base. Column reflexed (describing an acute angle to the ovary), 3.4–4.4 mm long; wings on the front not prolonged into the spur; anther 3.4–3.6 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 8.5–16.6 mm long. description: Terrestrial herbs with underground tubers. Flowering shoots (6.8–)12–63 cm tall; stem glabrous. Foliage leaves (3–)4–11, scattered along the stem. Inflorescence spicate; bracts more or less similar to the foliage leaves, all of them longer than the flowers. Flowers 2–14 (to many), resupinate, white, greenish, rose-coloured to purple or variegated. Sepals plain (i.e., not saccate); dorsal sepal 5.5–20.9 mm long. Labellum narrowly attached to the column, elliptic to broadly (ob)ovate or subcircular, smooth on the ventral side, spurred at base; spur shorter than the labellum lamina, not constricted at base. Column with an entire, concave stigma; distal part of rostellum narrow, straight, squeezed in between the thecae; viscidia 2, naked; anther firmly attached, thecae not extending from the column; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 35 species distributed in tropical and southern Africa, in Madagascar, in tropical parts of mainland Southeast Asia and in Taiwan; 5 species in Thailand.

description: Terrestrial or lithophytic, rhizomatous herbs; the creeping, clearly segmented rhizome with internodal rhizoids (roots absent or hair-like). Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base, 2.5–30(–37) cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–10, scattered along the stem or placed in a basal rosette, petiolate, sheathing at base. Inflorescence racemose to spicate; bracts glabrous or (glandular-)pubescent on the dorsal side. Flowers 1–10(–15), resupinate. Sepals connate to form a 3.5–19 mm long tubular synsepal. Petals free or adnate to the synsepal. Labellum adnate to the lower half of the column, straight (i.e., not twisted), 3.5–18.5 mm long along the mid-line, differentiated into hypochile, mesochile (sometimes obscure), and epichile; hypochile concave to slightly saccate (sac hidden by the synsepal), inside with 1 to many, sometimes branched appendages on either side; mesochile (if recognizable) devoid of lateral flanges; epichile simple and entire to deeply bilobed, or coarsely dentate (rarely vestigial). Column straight (i.e., not twisted); stigma bipartite, flat (fertile parts) but extended in 2 sterile stylids parallel to the rostellum; rostellum triangular, bifid; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous or glandular-pubescent. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 50 species distributed in tropical and southeastern Africa, in Madagscar and other islands of the Indian Ocean, in Indomalesia and northeastern Australia and on the western Pacific islands (east to Vanuatu); 8 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 6–20 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–8, placed in a basal rosette; lamina (ob) lanceolate, acuminate to acute, 0.9–4.1 by 0.3–0.9 cm (lamina of longest leaf (1–)1.4–4.1 cm long). Inflorescence (glandular-)pubescent; rachis up to 0.7 cm long, 1- to 3-flowered; bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, 3- to 5-veined, (glandular-)pubescent on the dorsal surface, 7.5–16 by 3–5.7 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled, mainly white with whitish-green synsepal and two green to brown blotches on base of epichile. Synsepal glandular-pubescent, 12–19 mm long. Petals adnate to the synsepal in nearly their whole length (apices free), porrect to slightly incurved, falcately linear-oblanceolate, rounded, 15–20 by 2.9–3.8 mm. Labellum 15.5–18.5 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with a long row of numerous (at least 20) papilla like appendages on either side; epichile cleft for about two thirds of its length to form two subsimilar, deeply laciniate lobules (each 11–14 by 13–14 mm). Column 10–12 mm long; stylids narrowly linear, subequal to the rostellum; anther subacuminate in front,3.8–4 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) glandular-pubescent, 5–10 mm long. Capsule spreading, short-pedicelled, ellipsoid, sparsely glandular-pubescent, ca. 1.2 cm long, ca. 0.7 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 12.8–23.4 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–5, placed in a basal rosette; lamina elliptic-oblong to ovate, acute, 1.5–3 by 0.8–1.7 cm (lamina of longest leaf 1.6–3 cm long). Inflorescence pubescent below, glabrous above; rachis 2.4–3.8 cm long, 7- to 10-flowered; bracts linear-lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, acuminate to cuspidate, 1-veined, glabrous, 3.9–5.4 by 1.2–2.7 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled, mainly green with white labellum. Synsepal glabrous, 3.6–3.8 mm long. Petals adnate to the synsepal in most of its length (apices free), slightly incurved, falcately oblanceolate, obtuse, 3.5–3.8 by 1.1–1.2 mm. Labellum 3.7–3.9 mm long along the midline; hypochile inside with a short row of 2–4 papilla-like appendages on either side; epichile cleft in about half of its length to form two subsimilar laciniate lobules (each 3.2–3.4 by 2.1–2.4 mm). Column 1.9–2.3 mm long; stylids falcately (linear-)lanceolate, subequal to the rostellum; anther subacuminate in front, ca. 1.3 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) glabrous, 5.3–6 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 12–22 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–5, placed in a basal rosette; lamina lanceolate to ovate, acute to acuminate, sometimes mucronate, (1–)1.3–3.5 by (0.3–)0.6–1.4 cm (lamina of longest leaf 1.4–3.5 cm long). Inflorescence sparsely (glandular-)pubescent; rachis 1.2–2.8 cm long, 3- to 10-flowered; bracts (broadly) ovate, acuminate, 1-veined, glandular pubescent on the dorsal surface, 1.8–4.6 by 1.8–3.2 mm. Flowers distinctly pedicelled. Synsepal (sparsely) glandular-pubescent, 3.5–3.9 mm long. Petals adherent to the synsepal in at least half of their length, porrect to incurved, obliquely oblanceolate, acute to obtuse, 3.2–4 by 1.1–1.3 mm. Labellum 3.5–4 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with a short row of 4–5 papilla-like appendages on either side; epichile transversely oblong, truncate, subentire, ca. 3.4 mm wide, or epichile cleft for about half of its length to form two subsimilar, subentire to erose-crenulate lobules (each 2.8–3 by 2–2.2 mm). Column 1.7–1.9 mm long; stylids obliquely ovate lanceolate, subequal to or slightly shorter than the rostellum; anther acuminate in front, 1.5–1.7 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) glandular-pubescent, 4.7–7.8 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 3.5–9 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–8, scattered along the stem, dull green above, paler underneath; lamina ovate to elliptic, acute to acuminate, often minutely mucronate, 0.5–2.5 by 0.4–1.4 cm (lamina of longest leaf 1.2–2.5 cm long). Inflorescence glabrous; rachis up to 0.5 cm long, 1- to 2-flowered; bracts lanceolate, acute, 1-veined, glabrous, 7–11 by 2–2.7 mm. Flowers subsessile, white. Synsepal glabrous, ca. 11.5 mm long. Petals adnate to the synsepal in their whole length (their recurved apices protruding from its lateral sinuses), obliquely (ob)lanceolate, obtuse, ca. 12.2 by ca. 3.1 mm. Labellum ca. 8.2 mm long along the midline; hypochile inside with a longitudinal row of 15–20 papilla-like appendages on either side; epichile transversely elliptic, coarsely 7-to 8-dentate, ca. 3.4 by ca. 5.2 mm (to apices of teeth). Column ca. 5.2 mm long; stylids linear, subequal to the rostellum; anther acuminate in front, ca. 1 mm long. Ovary glabrous, 8–10 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 2.5–15 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–10, scattered along the stem, dark green above, mid-green underneath; lamina (triangular-)ovate to lanceolate, acute to acuminate, mucronate, 0.3–1.2 by 0.2–0.7 cm (lamina of longest leaf 0.5–1.2 cm long). Inflorescence glabrous; rachis up to 1.1 cm long, 1- to 4-flowered; bracts ovate to elliptic, acuminate, 1-veined, glabrous, 1–4.5 by 1.5–3.5 mm. Flowers (sub)sessile, mainly (greenish-)white with two yellow spots at base of epichile. Synsepal glabrous, 3.5–5.5 mm long. Petals adnate to the synsepal in their whole length, porrect to incurved, obliquely subspathulate-linear, obtuse, 4–4.1 by 1–1.1 mm. Labellum ca. 5.4 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with one, basally 2- to 3-branched appendages on either side; epichile cleft for about two thirds of its length to form two subsimilar, slightly erose-dentate to erose-crenulate lobules (each ca. 2.5 by 2.9–3 mm). Column 2.8–3 mm long; stylids obliquely linear-oblanceolate, subequal to or slightly shorter than the rostellum; anther (sub)acuminate in front, ca. 2.2 mm long. Ovary glabrous, 3.8–6.5 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots (8.5–)10.8–30 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–5, placed in a basal rosette, light olive-brown with dark brown reticulation above, light brown to dull olive-green below; lamina lanceolate to ovate, acute, 1.3–8 by 0.8–2.4 cm (lamina of longest leaf 2.3–8 cm long). Inflorescence glandular-pubescent; rachis up to 7.5 cm long, 1- to 7-flowered; bracts triangular ovate to lanceolate, (sub)acuminate, 1-veined, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal surface, 3.5–6 by 1.3–4.5 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled, mainly green to light brown with white petals and a white labellum with two grey lines at base of epichile. Synsepal glandular-pubescent, (5–)7–9.2 mm long. Petals adnate to the synsepal for most of their length (apices occasionally protruding from the lateral sinuses of the synsepal), obliquely to falcately (ob)lanceolate, rounded (to subacute), (6.8–19.5–11.5 by (2.3–)3.4–3.8 mm. Labellum (7–)9.5–10.5 mm long along the mid line; hypochile inside with a short row of 3-6 appendages on either side; epichile cleft for most of its length to form two subsimilar erose-crenulate to irregularly dentate lobules (each (7.5–19–11.5 by (3.5–)6.9–7.6 mm). Column 3–3.8 mm long; stylids obliquely oblong to narrowly linear lanceolate or subulate, shorter than to longer than the rostellum; anther acute to truncate in front, 2.3–2.5 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) glandular-pubescent, 5.7–9 mm long. Capsule suberect, short-pedicelled, (oblongoid-)obovoid, sparsely glandular-pubescent, 0.7–1(–1.2) cm long, 0.4–0.5(–0.6) cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 7.5–20 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–4, placed in a basal rosette; lainina lanceolate, acute (to acuminate), 1.4–2.9 by 0.5–1.3 cm (lamina of longest leaf 2.1–2.9 cm long). Inflorescence glandular-pubescent; rachis up to 3.3 cm long. 1- to 4-flowered; bracts ovate, acuminate to cuspidate, 1-veined, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal surface, 5–8.5 by 3.8–5 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled, mainly olive-green to pale brown with white petals and a white labellum with two green spots at base of epichile. Synsepal (sparsely) glandular-pubescent, 7.2–8.9 mm long. Petals free in their whole length, distally recurved with apices protruding from the lateral sinuses of the synsepal, sigmoidly linear-lanceolate, obtuse to rounded, 8.3–9.5 by 2–2.5 mm. Labellum 7.5–9 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with a short row of 3–6 papilla-like appendages on either side; epichile suborbicular, emarginate and slightly erose, or deeply divided into two unequal, dentate-laciniate lobules (each up to 6.5 by 2.3 mm). Column ca. 4 mm long; stylids obliquely linear-oblanceolate, slightly exceeding the rostellum; anther subacuminate in front, ca. 2.5 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) (sparsely) glandular pubescent, 5–9.6 mm long. Capsule suberect, short-pedicelled, obovoid, sparsely glandular pubescent to glabrous, 0.7–1.1 cm long, 0.4–0.6 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 9–25(–37) cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–6, placed in a basal rosette; lamina elliptic to lanceolate, acute, 0.9–5 by 0.5–2.4 cm (lamina of longest leaf 1.5–5 cm long). Inflorescence glandular-pubescent; rachis 0.7–4.5(–6) cm long, 2- to 10-flowered (rarely up to 15-flowered); bracts ovate-lanceolate to narrowly triangular, acuminate, 1-veined, glandular pubescent on the dorsal surface, 3.6–5.5 by 2–2.5 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled, mainly light green with greenish-white petals and white labellum with a yellow spot. Synsepal (sparsely) glandular-pubescent, 4.9–6.5 mm long. Petals adnate to the synsepal in nearly their whole length (apices free), porrect to slightly incurved, obliquely to falcately linear-oblanceolate, obtuse to rounded, 4.6–8.3 by 1–2 mm. Labellum 4.8–8.5 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with a short row of 2–4(–5) papilla-like appendages on either side; epichile cleft for half to three fourths of its length to form two subsimilar, coarsely dentate lobules (each 2.5–7 by 2.5–7 mm). Column 2.8–2.9 mm long; stylids obliquely linear-lanceolate, subequal to the rostellum; anther acute to acuminate in front, 2–2.4 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) (sparsely) glandular pubescent, 7.1–8.3 mm long. Capsule suberect, short-pedicelled, obpyriform, sparsely glandular pubescent, 0.6–0.9 cm long, 0.3–0.5 cm in diameter.

description: Small to tiny terrestrial herbs with small underground tubers; stem glabrous. Foliage leaf 1, subapical. Flower solitary, sessile on a diminutive peduncle, resupinate, predominantly purplish-white and brown; floral bract slightly longer than the ovary. Sepals glabrous; dorsal sepal large, boat-shaped; lateral sepals and petals linear, thread-like or vestigial. Labellum narrowly attached to the column, orbicular, glabrous, proximally provided with two spurs, spurs much shorter than the labellum lamina, not constricted at base. Column completely enclosed within the labellum base, with an entire, concave stigma; rostellum erect, broadly triangular; viscidium 1, naked; anther firmly attached, thecae not extending from the column; pollinia 4, basitonous. Fruit not seen.</br></br>About 120 species constitute this genus which has a disjunct distribution encompassing (1) an area ranging from northeastern India to southern China, (2) Taiwan, (3) scattered areas throughout Malesia, (4) eastern Australia, (5) Tasmania and (6) New Zealand and smaller islands in the SW Pacific; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots formning dense, clonal colonies, 1–2 cm tall. Foliage leaf sessile, circular-cordate, variegated, short-acuminate, 9–14 by 12–19 mm. Dorsal sepal incurved, linear-spathulate, obtuse, 10–10.4 by 3–3.2 mm, with 7 non-crested veins, white, suffused with reddish purple along the veins, lateral sepals acuminate, 8.4–9 by ca. 0.4 mm, dark purplish-brown. Petals connate at their very base and adnate to the lateral sepals, acuminate, 1-veined, 5.5–7 by ca. 0.4 mm, dark purplish-brown. Labellum strongly recurved with incurved sides, white with pinkish-purple base and a dark purplish-brown band along the edge (with ramifications towards the base), 5.5–6 by 6.6–7 mm when spread out, provided with a low callus at the centre; front edge rounded, fimbriate-ciliate; spurs conical, slightly oblique, ca. 2 mm long. Column subclavate, slightly incurved, ca. 1.8 mm long. Ovary ca. 2 mm long, glabrous.

description: Terrestrial herbs producing fasciculate fleshy roots from the basis of an erect, glabrous stem. Foliage leaves basal, long-petiolate. Inflorescence racemose, lax. Flowers non-resupinate, predominantly green to brownish-red, dominated by a large labellum. Sepals free, with inrolled margins. Labellum straight (i.e., not twisted), partly enveloping the column at base, 13.9–20 mm long, simple, entire, minutely papillose on the ventral side, strongly concave at base, devoid of ornaments. Column straight (i.e., not twisted), short, slightly winged; stignia entire to bilobed, convex; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile, thecae not extending from the column; pollinia 4, acrotonous. Ovary glabrous. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>This genus of ca. 25 species has scattered occurrences from Sri Lanka, northeastern India and Taiwan in the northwest to Tasmania, northernmost New Zealand and Samoa in the southeast; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 24–52.5 cm tall; stem 1–4 mm in diameter. Foliage leaves 1–3; petiole channelled, 3.3–12.5 cm long, spotted with purple; lamina ovate to elliptic or broadly lanceolate, often oblique, acuminate, (6.8–18.4–16 by (2.6–)4–6.7 cm. Inflorescence cylindric, 9- to many flowered; rachis (5.5–)12–30 cm long; bracts ovate-lanceolate, long-acuminate, shorter than or subequal to the ovary, 7–18 by 2–6.2 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled, predominantly dull brownish-red (sepals and petals light green, labellum with dark crimson spots). Sepals subsimilar, linear-triangular, acuminate, glabrous, 3-veined, 14–16.7 by 2.3–2.9 mm. Petals spreading, linear-triangular, acuminate, 1-veined, 8–11.1 by 1.5–1.6 mm, with entire, inrolled margins. Labellum ovate-oblong, 13.9–20 by 5–8.3 mm; distal part flat with an acute to acuminate, distinctly incurved apex. Column semiterete, 2–3 mm long; anther 2.5–2.6 mm long, 1.4–1.5 mm wide, with a recurved, subacuminate apex. Ovary 7.5–17 mm long. Capsule short-pedicelled, ellipsoid, 10–15 mm long, 5–7 mm in diameter.

description: Terrestrial, achlorophyllous, mycoheterotrophic, erect herbs, often with thick and fleshy roots arising from short rhizomes; stems often several from each rhizome, simple or branched, fleshy, papillose, often yellowish-brown to reddish-brown in colour. Foliage leaves reduced to scale-like sheaths or bracts, one at each node, glabrous to pubescent. Inflorescence consisting of a terminal and often several lateral racemes, few-to many-flowered; rachis pubescent or mealy hairy; bracts persistent. Flowers usually not opening widely, greenish, yellowish or brownish. Sepuls free, 6- to 9-veined, often papillose outside, fleshy. Petals free, 7- to 9-veined, slightly shorter than the sepals, glabrous. Labellum concave, entire, with thickened disc, base adnate to base of column. Column stout, slightly curved, without foot, usually with lateral toothed wings; pollen assembled in 2 mealy pollinia without caudicles or viscidium. Ovary slender. Fruit a fleshy berry, pink, red or orange, often shiny. Seeds with stout testa, with or without a narrow surrounding wing.</br></br>A genus of about 5 species, distributed from Sri Lanka to NE India, S China, Japan, Indo China, Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Sumatra, Java, the Philippines and New Guinea; 3 species in Thailand.
bibliographicCitation: Cyrtosia  . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 46. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Flowering shoots 20–65 cm tall, erect, 4–6 mm in diameter at base, branched; nodes with sheaths; sheaths glabrous to pubescent, ovate, 4–10 mm long, acute, coriaceous. Inflorescence composed of a terminal and often several axillary racemes, furfuraceous, many-flowered; rachis furfuraceous; bracts ovate, 2.5–4 by 3–5 mm, furfuraceous. Flowers short- to long pedicelled, brownish-yellow. Sepals furfuraceous outside, 6- to 9-veined, apex acute; dorsal sepal lanceolate-oblong, 15–20 by 6–8 mm; lateral sepals obliquely ovate, 14–20 by 8–9 mm, larger than dorsal sepal, apex slightly hooded. Petals glabrous, ovate-lanceolate, 14–18 by 6–8 mm, 7- to 9-veined, apex obtuse, not hooded, shallowly grooved outside. Labellum obscurely 3-lobed, orbicular in outline, yellow, fleshy, strongly concave, 9–12 mm long, 8–12 mm wide when spread out, prominently grooved outside; the high side lobes envelop the column and form a deep sac which is divided into two halves by a rather high square keel which at its base has a small conical callus; keel widens spathulately or spoon-shaped obovate on the disc, surrounded by a horseshoe-shaped ridge of fine long hairs. Column stout, 5–8 mm long, at apex with lateral spreading wings, anther ca. 1 mm long, irregularly fringed on top. Ovary (including pedicel) up to 1 cm long, furfuraceous. Berry oblong, bright glossy pinkish-orange, 3.5–6.5 by 0.3–0.6 cm, fleshy, furfuraceous.

description: Flowering shoots 10–20 cm tall, erect, yellowish-brown, 2–3 mm in diameter at base, rarely branched; fleshy roots pale yellow; nodes with sheaths, sheaths glabrous to pubescent, ovate-lanceolate, 3–7 mm long, acute, coriaceous. Inflorescence composed of a terminal and often several axillary racemes, furfuraceous, many-flowered; rachis furfuraceous; bracts ovate, 1–3 by 1.5–2.5 mm, furfuraceous. Flowers short- to long-pedicelled, pale yellow. Sepals furfuraceous outside, 7- to 9-veined, apex acute, slightly hooded; dorsal sepal lanceolate-ovate, 13–16 by 5–7 mm; lateral sepals ovate-oblong, 14–16 by 5–6 mm. Petals glabrous, ovate-oblong, 12–14 by 5–6 mm, 7- to 9-veined, apex obtuse, not hooded, shallowly grooved outside. Labellum obscurely 3-lobed, orbicular in outline, yellow, fleshy, strongly concave, 9–10 mm long, 8–10 mm wide when spread out, prominently grooved outside; a rounded or squarish keel from base of lip ending at middle of disc usually with two small teeth besides each other, apical part of lip very rugose-papillose. Column stout, about 5–6 mm long, at apex without wings; anther ca. 1 mm long, pubescent. Ovary (including pedicel) up to 1 cm long, furfuraceous. Berry oblong, pinkish-red, 3.5–6.5 by 0.3–0.6 cm, fleshy, furfuraceous.

description: Flowering shoots 10–20 cm tall, erect, pinkish-orange, 5–7 mm in diameter at base, branched or not; fleshy roots yellow; nodes with sheaths; sheaths glabrous to pubescent, ovate, 5–10 mm long, obtuse to acute, coriaceous. Inflorescence a terminal raceme, densely short-hairy, few-to many-flowered; rachis densely short-hairy; bracts ovate, 2–5 by 3–5 mm, densely short hairy. Flowers sessile to short-pedicelled, yellow, not widely opening, non-resupinate. Sepals oblong, incurved, densely and shortly papillose outside, 7- to 9-veined, apex acute; dorsal sepal 12-15 by 5–7 mm; lateral sepals 12–14 by 6–8 mm, larger than dorsal sepal, apex slightly hooded. Petals glabrous, oblong-ovate, 12–14 by 7–8 mm, 7- to 9-veined, apex obtuse, not hooded. Labellum entire, ovate-oblong, orange, fleshy, strongly concave, 9–10 mm long, 7–8 mm wide, the inner surface nearly completely covered by a low horseshoe-shaped callus, its concavity towards base of the labellum firmly fused with base of the column, epichile hairy. Column stout, about 6 mm long, at base with a small conical callus on front, at upper half with large lateral spreading wings which split up into 2–3 layers with irregular dentate edges; anther ca. 1 mm long, pubescent. Ovary (including pedicel) obscure. Berry oblong, bright glossy pinkish-orange, 6–8 by 1–1.5 cm, fleshy, with scattered short hairs. Seeds wingless.

description: Terrestrial herbs with a fleshy, branched rhizome rooting from its nodes or devoid of roots. Flowering shoots terminal, erect, leafless or with a few leaves in a basal rosette. Foliage leaves (if present) short-petiolate; petiole channelled, sheathing at base. Inflorescence spicate; bracts ciliate. Flowers resupinate. Sepals free, 1- to 2-veined. Petals connivent with the dorsal sepal. Labellum basally adnate to the column, straight (i.e., not twisted), differentiated into hypochile, mesochile, and epichile; hypochile forming two conspicuous lateral sacs, each containing a subsessile appendage; mesochile with margins incurved to meet in the middle, glabrous to rugose-papillose; epichile triangular to transversely rectangular with incurved margins (sometimes vestigial). Column straight (i.e., not twisted); stigma bilobed, flat: rostellum triangular, more or less bifid; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous or pubescent. Fruit not seen.</br></br>A genus of ca. 20 species distributed in nearly all of Malesia, across Peninsular Malaysia to southern Thailand, and on the Palau Islands; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 5–35 cm tall, pale reddish-brown, all leaves reduced to brownish sheaths; stem 1–2.5 mm in diameter. Inflorescence pubescent, cylindric to somewhat secund; rachis 0.8–8 cm long, 3- to 10-flowered; bracts narrowly ovate, acute to acuminate, usually shorter than the ovary, 8.7–10 by 4–4.2 mm. Flowers sessile, pale reddish-brown, scarcely opening. Sepals sparsely pubescent on the dorsal side (occasionally glabrous); dorsal sepal lanceolate-triangular with an obtuse to rounded, slightly hooded apex, 1-veined, 5.7–6.3 by 2.2–2.3 mm; lateral sepals obliquely ovate to linear-pandurate with saccate bases and rounded, strongly hooded apices, 1- to 2-veined, 7.5–9 by 2.4–3.6 mm. Petals obliquely linear, acute to obtuse, 1-veined, 5.1–6.5 by 1.3–1.4 mm, entire. Labellum 7.6–9.4 mm long; hypochile smooth; mesochile rugose papillose in its distal half, margins entire; epichile vestigial. Column subclavate, 2–2.5 mm long; anther 2–2.1 mm long, 1.4–1.7 mm wide, acuminate; pollinia elongate. Ovary 4.5–8.5 mm long, glabrous.

description: Terrestrial herbs with underground tubers, stem glabrous or sparsely pubescent. Foliage leaves 1–3, crowded on the basal part of the stem, sessile, sheathing at base, glabrous or pubescent. Inflorescence suberect, 1- or 2-flowered. Flowers short-pedicelled, resupinate; bracts glumaceous, much shorter than the foliage leaves, shorter than the flowers. Sepals plain (i.e. not saccate), glabrous or pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal 13–15 mm long. Labellum narrowly attached to the column, glabrous, spurred at base; spur distinctly longer than the labellum lamina, gently tapering towards the base. Column with two fertile stigma parts placed on 2 freely extending stigmaphores; distal part of rostellum broad, saddle-shaped, jutting out between the thecae, longer than the stigmaphores; viscidia 2, naked; anther firmly attached, thecae basally extending from the column together with the lateral parts of the rostellum; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous or pubescent. Fruit a capsule.</br></br>A genus of 2 species distributed in Nepal, Bhutan, northeastern India, southern China, northern Myanmar, northeastern Thailand and northern Vietnam; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 3.5–13.5 cm tall; stem glabrous. Foliage leaves 2–3, recurved, leathery, (narrowly) linear-lanceolate, acute to acuminate, often mucronate, glabrous, (1.5–)4.1–11.6 by (0.3–)0.4–1.1 cm. Flowers usually solitary, mainly white with yellowish-green ovary and pale greenish-yellow spur and column; bracts broadly cordate, acuminate, often mucronate, 3- to 5-veined from the base, glabrous, 8–16 by 6–14 mm. Sepals glabrous, distinctly keeled, 3-veined from the base; dorsal sepal (lanceolate-oblong, (sub)acuminate, often mucronate, 13–15 by 4–7 mm; lateral sepals obliquely (linear-)lanceolate, acuminate, 10–15 by 3–4.5 mm. Petals (trulliform-)ovate to obovate, rounded (to short-acuminate), 5-veined from the base, 13–19 by 8–13 mm. Labellum obovate to subspathulate, broadly emarginate, usually apiculate, 14–21 by 11–18 mm; spur (clavate-)filiform, incurved, 27–48 mm long. Column 6.5–9 mm long (to apex of rostellum). Ovary (including pedicel) glabrous, 6–15 mm long.

description: Small delicate terrestrial herbs with underground tubers, stem fragile, glabrous. Foliage leaves scattered on the stem, sessile, clasping the stem. Inflorescence racemose; bracts leaf-like, shorter than the ovaries. Flowers 1–4, resupinate, unpleasantly scented. Dorsal sepal adnate to the petals to form a shallow hood over the labellum and column; lateral sepals connate in their proximal part, each with a small conical sac in the proximal half. Labellum adnate to the whole front of the column, clawed, 2–2.5 mm long. Column stout, with 2 pad-like stigmas; rostellum tripartite, consisting of a flat central part that covers the anther and two lateral filiform arms; viscidia 2, naked; anther firmly attached, reflexed, thecae extending from the column; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>This genus of ca. 105 species is disjunctly distributed in parts of southern and tropical Africa, the islands of the Indian Ocean, and in parts of tropical Asia from southern India to Taiwan, the Philippines and Papua New Guinea; only 1 species occurs in the areas east of the Indian Ocean, including Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots (3–)4–14 cm tall. Foliage leaves (1–)2(–3), (reddish-green, sometimes purple below, ovate to reniform with undulate margins, acute to rounded, 0.5–1.1 by (0.2–)0.4–1 cm. Bracts ovate to reniform, 2–8 by 1.5–6.5 mm, becoming smaller towards inflorescence apex. Petals broadly and falcately ovate-lanceolate, obtuse, 5.5–6.5 by 2–3.5 mm. Labellum with a 1.5–2 mm long claw; lamina rounded (to retuse), with a tomentose median crest and two lateral horn-like, usually tomentose, processes. Column 1.5–2 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 6–14 mm long. Capsule erect, short-pedicelled, fusiform, glabrous, ca. 1.7 cm long (including pedicel), ca. 0.3 cm in diameter.

description: Terrestrial, rhizomatous herbs; the creeping stem-like rhizome rooting from its nodes. Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base, 15–46 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–7, scattered to crowded on the lower part of the stem, petiolate; petiole channelled, sheathing at base. Inflorescence spicate; bracts glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side. Flowers 5 to many, resupinate, predominantly reddish-green to yellowish-green with white epichile. Sepals free, 1- to 3-veined; dorsal sepal porrect over the column, 4.2–8 mm long. Petals connivent with the dorsal sepal, 1-veined. Labellum basally adnate to the column, straight (i.e., not twisted), differentiated into hypochile and epichile; hypochile with erect sides, entire, spurred (protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals when the flower is viewed from the side), spur devoid of ornaments or containing 2 clavate appendages; epichile simple, entire, recurved to reflexed, slightly narrower than the hypochile when spread out. Column straight (i.e., not twisted); stigma bilobed, flat; rostellum triangular, bifid; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glandular-pubescent. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 20 species distributed from Bhutan and southwestern China across tropical Southeast Asia and Malesia to Tonga in the Pacific; 2 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots erect from a decumbent base, 15–46 cm tall; lower part of stem 2–4 mm in diameter. Foliage leaves 4–7, scattered on the lower part of the stem; petiole (including sheath) 1.6–3.6 cm long; lamina obliquely (oblong-)ovate to (elliptic-)lanceolate, acute to subacuminate, 2.8–10.4 by 1.6–3.9 cm. Inflorescence glandular-pubescent, narrowly cylindric; rachis 1.7–15.2 cm long, densely to laxly 6- to many-flowered; bracts somewhat boat-shaped, linear-triangular to lanceolate-triangular, acute to acuminate, shorter than or subequal to the ovary, 4–9.5 by (1.2–)2.5–3.3 mm. Flowers mainly olive-green to yellowish-green with white to yellow labellum (turning brownish-orange towards the base) and purple streaks on the petals. Sepals densely glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, lanceolate oblong, obtuse, 1-veined, 4.2–4.6 by 1.9–2 mm; lateral sepals somewhat spreading, obliquely (lanceolate-)oblong, obtuse, 1- to 3-veined, 4.3–4.8 by 2.2–2.3 mm. Petals obliquely linear lanceolate, obtuse, 4–4.4 by 1–1.2 mm. Labellum 3.2–3.5 mm long (excluding spur); spur 1.7–2 mm long, protruding 1.4–1.7 mm below the lateral sepals, tapering towards the emarginate apex; epichile transversely (triangular-)elliptic, rounded to subacute. Column subclavate, 3–3.2 mm long; anther subacuminate in front, 2–2.1 mm long, 0.8–0.9 mm wide. Ovary 6–10 mm long. Capsule (sub)sessile, 0.8–1 cm long, 0.3–0.4 cm in diameter, glandular-pubescent.

description: Flowering shoots erect from a decumbent base, 20–35 cm tall; lower part of stem 2–2.5 mm in diameter. Foliage leaves 3–6, crowded on the lower part of the stem; petiole (including sheath) 2.5–5 cm long; lamina obliquely ovate to (lanceolate- elliptic, acute, 4.1–11.9 by 2.6–5.6 cm. Inflorescence pubescent, ovoid to cylindric; rachis 3.3–7 cm long, (sub)densely 5- to many flowered; bracts boat-shaped, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, subequal to or longer than the ovary, 7–15 by 2–3 mm. Flowers pale reddish brown with white labellum. Sepals sparsely glandular pubescent to subglabrous on the dorsal side, dorsal sepal porrect over the column, slightly boat-shaped, lanceolate-oblong, obtuse, 3-veined, 6–8 by 1.8–2.1 mm; lateral sepals somewhat spreading, obliquely lanceolate-oblong, subacute, 3-veined, 7.1–7.4 by ca. 2.4 mm. Petals linear spathulate, subacuminate, 5–6.9 by 1.5–1.7 mm. Labellum ca. 6 mm long (excluding spur); spur ca. 4 mm long, protruding 3–3.5 mm below the lateral sepals, dilated towards the bifid apex; epichile suborbicular to transversely elliptic, rounded. Column subterete, ca. 5 mm long; anther subacute in front, ca. 4.5 mm long, 1.2–1.3 mm wide. Ovary ca. 9.2 mm long. Capsule sessile, suberect, 0.9–1 cm long, 0.4–0.5 cm in diameter, glandular-pubescent.

description: Terrestrial, achlorophyllous, mycoheterotrophic, climbing or scrambling herbs; aerial roots produced one at each node, short, fleshy, unbranched, used for attaching to the substrate; stems much branched, thin, cylindric, flexible, glabrous, pale brown to reddish-brown or yellowish-brown. Foliage leaves reduced to scale-like sheaths or bracts, one at each node, glabrous. Inflorescences terminal or lateral opposite the roots, racemes or panicles, many flowered, glabrous. Flowers not opening widely. Sepals free, fleshy, 5. to 7-veined, dorsal sepal arching forward. Petals free, 5-veined, narrower than the sepals. Labellum entire or obscurely 3-lobed, lateral margins rolled upward to form a floral tube around the column, with a longitudinal pubescent median ridge, both sides with many transverse ridges, base of midlobe with a woolly callus. Column with a short descending foot, tapering into the median ridge of the lip; pollen assembled in 2 firm pollinia without caudicles or viscidium. Ovary slender. Fruit a slender capsule. Seeds with stout testa and broad wings.</br></br>A genus of 2–3 species, distributed from Japan to Indo-China, NE India, Myanmar, Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Sumatra, Java, the Philippines and E Australia; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Stems climbing up to 10 m long, cylindric, pale brown to reddish-brown, 3–5 mm in diameter, branched; nodes with scales; scales opposite the aerial roots, ovate-lanceolate, 5–15 by 3–7 mm, acute, coriaceous, glabrous. Inflorescence a large panicle, glabrous, many-flowered; bracts ovate, 1.5–2 by 1.5–2.5 mm, persistent, smooth to slightly muricate. Flowers pale yellow, pedicel slender. Sepals glabrous, smooth or minutely muricate near apex, slightly hooded; dorsal sepal suboblong, 13–16 by 3.5–5 mm, 7-veined, usually with 5 veins distinct and 2 veins obscure, apex acute to obtuse; lateral sepals suboblong, 13–15 by 4–5 mm, 5- to 7-veined, apex obtuse. Petals glabrous, oblong-oblanceolate, 14–15 by 2.5–3 mm, 5-veined, apex obtuse-retuse. Labellum shortly obovate, concave, obscurely 3-lobed, 9–11 mm long along the mid-line, base adnate to the column, with a longitudinal pubescent median ridge, 6–7 mm long, ca. 2 mm wide, longitudinally grooved and cleft at apex, above this with a woolly ovate to subglobose callus below midlobe of lip, 2.5–3 mm in diameter, grooved and cleft at apex, both sides of median ridge with several purple transverse ridges, veins branched above; side lobes rounded, 10–12 mm across both sides when spread out; midlobe small, 2–3 mm long, 4–5 mm wide, with wavy margin. Column slender, 6–7 mm long; anther ca. 1 mm long, glabrous. Ovary (including pedicel) 7–10 mm long. Capsule narrowly cylindric, reddish, 15–25 by 0.5–1 cm long. Seeds with wing cleft on one side.

description: Terrestrial, achlorophyllous, mycoheterotrophic, climbing or scrambling herbs, often with stout, tuberous rhizomes; aerial roots produced one at each node, tendril-like, unbranched, used for attaching to the substrate; stems short- or long-branched, thick, cylindric, slightly fleshy, flexible, glabrous, reddish-brown in colour. Foliage leaves reduced to scale-like sheaths, one at each node, glabrous to furfuraceous. Inflorescences terminal or lateral, racemes or panicles, few-to many-flowered; rachis and flowers pubescent, covered with yellowish-brown hairs; bracts caducous or persistent. Flowers not opening widely, fleshy, yellowish or brownish. Sepals free, 5- to 9-veined, hairy outside, lateral sepals larger than dorsal sepal. Petals free, 3- to 7-veined, slightly smaller than the sepals, glabrous. Labellum concave, fleshy, with papillae inside, base with or without a prominent callus. Column short and stout, straight or curved forward, without foot, dilated at apex; pollen assembled in two cleft mealy pollinia without caudicles or viscidium. Ovary slender. Fruit a slender capsule. Seeds large, winged, with stout testa.</br></br>A genus of about 10 species, distributed from Madagasgar to NE India, Myanmar, S China, Japan, Indo-China, Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Sumatra, Java, the Philippines and New Guinea; 2 species in Thailand.

description: Stems climbing up to 10 m long, cylindric, smooth to furfuraceous, 4–8 mm in diameter, branched; nodes with scales; scales ovate-lanceolate, 0.5–2.5 by 0.4–1 cm, acute, coriaceous, furfuraceous at base. Inflorescence a panicle, lateral or terminal, pubescent, few- to many flowered; bracts lanceolate, 3–6 by 2–3 mm, furfuraceous. Flowers yellow, pedicel slender. Sepals  linear-oblong, 18–22 by 3–4.5 mm, acute to rounded at apex, 4- to 5-veined, hairy with reddish-brown hairs outside; lateral sepals larger than dorsal sepal. Petals glabrous, linear oblong, 18–25 by 2–3.5 mm, 3- to 5-veined, apex rounded. Labellum broadly ovate, concave, irregularly dentate on margin towards apex, 10–16 mm long along the mid-line, 8–12 mm wide when spread out, base embracing the column, inner surface with small scattered papillae. Column slender, 7–8 mm long; anther ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous. Ovary (including pedicel) 2–4 cm long. Capsule cylindric, furfuraceous, 8.5–20 by 0.8–1.2 cm. Seeds with wing ovate in outline, not much longer than broad, margin subentire to irregularly crenate.

description: Stems climbing 5–10 m long, cylindric, smooth to furfuraceous, 7–10 mm in diameter, long-branched; nodes with scales; scales opposite the aerial roots, ovate, 1–2.5 by 1–1.5 cm, acute, coriaceous, glabrous to furfuraceous at base, glabrous towards apex. Inflorescence a large panicle, lateral or terminal, pubescent, few-to many-flowered; rachis pubescent with yellowish brown hairs; bracts ovate, 2–7 by 2–6 mm, pubescent with reddish-brown hairs. Sepals hairy with reddish-brown hairs outside, 7- to 9-veined, apex acute; dorsal sepal lanceolate-elliptic, 7–14 by 4–8 mm; lateral sepals obliquely oblong-elliptic, 10–16 by 6–8 mm, larger than dorsal sepal, apex slightly hooded. description: Terrestrial, rhizomatous herbs; the creeping stem-like rhizome rooting from its nodes. Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base, 5–103 cm tall. Inflorescence spicate or racemose; bracts glabrous, ciliate, fimbriate or glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side. Flowers 2 to many, resupinate. Sepals free, 1- to 3-veined; dorsal sepal 2–16.2 mm long. Petals adherent or adnate to the dorsal sepal, occasionally connate at apex, 1-veined, glabrous. Labellum basally adnate to the column, straight (i.e. not twisted), 1.5–12.8 mm long, simple or 3-lobed with porrect to recurved apex; the concave to saccate basal part with tufted or scattered fleshy hairs inside. Column straight (i.e. not twisted), subclavate to subterete); stigma bilobed, flat or with raised margins; rostellum triangular, bifid; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary (glandular-)pubescent to glabrous. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 100 species, distributed throughout most of North and Central America and Eurasia to northern Queensland and the western Pacific islands, and across the Indian Ocean to Madagascar and Mozambique: 8 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 14–35 cm tall. Foliage leaves 5–10, herbaceous, scattered along the stem, uniformly (glaucous-)green; lamina elliptic to broadly lanceolate, more or less oblique, acuminate to acute, (2.4–)3.2–8 by (1.2–)1.5–4.5 cm. Inflorescence cylindric, dense, glabrous; rachis 2.5–6.5 cm long, 6- to 17-flowered; bracts linear, acuminate to acute, longer than the ovaries, glabrous, 10–23 by 2–5.5 mm. Flowers sessile, pale and dull pinkish-brown to whitish. Sepals (sub)glabrous; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, straight to slightly incurved, ovate-oblong, obtuse to subacuminate, 3-veined, 8–9.4 by 4.3–4.8 mm; lateral sepals slightly spreading, boat shaped, obliquely (ovate-)oblong, obtuse to acuminate, 8.2–10.2 by 3.8–4.8 mm. Petals obliquely (rhomboid-)oblanceolate, rounded to obtuse, 8–10.8 by 3.2–3.6 mm. Labellum broadly ovate, 7.5–8.8 by 4.4–5.2 mm, concave with a flat, rounded to subacute porrect apex; the concave part with numerous fleshy hairs, devoid of other ornaments. Column 6.5–8 mm long; anther acuminate in front, 5–5.3 mm long. Ovary 9–10.3 mm long, (sub)glabrous. Capsule sessile, slenderly ellipsoid, 7–12 mm long, 2.5–5 mm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 53–100 cm tall. Foliage leaves (3–)6–10, herbaceous, crowded on the lower to middle part of the stem, dark glossy green above, bright light green underneath; lamina obliquely elliptic to broadly lanceolate, acuminate, 7.8–19.5 by 2.8–9 cm. Inflorescence cylindric, relatively lax, glandular-pubescent; rachis 14.9–34.1 cm long, many-flowered; bracts linear-lanceolate, acuminate, shorter than the ovaries, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 6–12.5 by 1–2.5 mm. Sepals glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal with recurved to recoiled apex, ovate-oblong, obtuse, 3-veined, 6.8–7.7 by 2.8–2.9 mm; lateral sepals widely spreading with recurved apices, obliquely lanceolate, obtuse, 3-veined, 7.9–8.1 by ca. 3 mm. Petals falcately oblanceolate, obtuse, 8.3–8.8 by 1.9–2.2 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, 8–8.5 by 4–4.5 mm, concave with scattered fleshy hairs towards the base; side lobes broadly rounded; midlobe linear, acute, recurved, much longer than the side lobes, devoid of ornaments. Column 6.2–6.8 mm long; anther acute in front, 2.8–3 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 9–17 mm long, glandular-pubescent. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 7.5–14.5(–20) cm tall. Foliage leaves 5–6, fleshy, scattered along the stem or crowded on its lower part, dark green with white to whitish-green or purplish reticulation above; lamina obliquely (linear-)lanceolate, acute to acuminate, (1.7–)2.5–8(–10) by (0.8–)1–1.8(–2.1) cm. Inflorescence secund, relatively lax, glandular-hispid; rachis 2.4–9 cm long, 10 to many-flowered; bracts linear-lanceolate, acuminate, longer than or subequal to the ovaries, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 7–11 by 1.5–2 mm. Flowers sessile, predominantly olive-green with the apices of sepals white and the petals and labellum dull white. Sepals glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, straight to slightly incurved, ovate-triangular, obtuse, 1-veined, 2–3.7 by 1.5–2.5 mm; lateral sepals slightly spreading, boat shaped, obliquely elliptic, obtuse to rounded, 1-veined, 2–4.1 by 1–2.2 mm. Petals obliquely oblanceolate, obtuse to acute, mucronate, 2–4 by 1–1.5 mm. Labellum ovate-triangular, 3–4 by 2–2.8 mm, concave with a flat porrect obtuse apex; the concave part with scattered fleshy hairs, devoid of other ornaments. Column ca. 3.2 mm long (to apex of the long rostellum); anther acuminate in front, ca. 1.5 mm long. Ovary (4–)6–8.5 mm long, densely glandular-pubescent. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 5–16 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–5(–6), herbaceous, crowded on the lower part of the stem, dark green with copper-red reticulation above; lamina (ovate-)lanceolate, acute to acuminate, (0.8–)1.5–6.5 by (0.5–)0.8–2.5 cm. Inflorescence secund, fairly dense, sparsely papillose-pubescent to subglabrous; rachis 1.3–7.5 cm long, 5- to many-flowered; bracts linear-triangular to ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, longer than the ovaries, more or less fimbriate towards the base (otherwise glabrous), 5.1–10.8 by 1.8–3.7 mm. Flowers sessile, white. Sepals glabrous; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, straight to slightly incurved, ovate-elliptic, obtuse to rounded with a short subapical keel on the dorsal side, 1-veined, 2.5–3.7 by 1.7–2.7 mm; lateral sepals slightly spreading, shallowly boat-shaped, falcately (ovate-)oblong, obtuse to rounded with a short subapical keel on the dorsal side, 1-veined, 2.7–4.3 by 1.7–2.5 mm. Column 1.7–2.3 mm long; anther obtuse to acuminate in front, 1–1.2 mm long. Ovary 3.8–7 mm long, glabrous. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 10–34 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–11, herbaceous, crowded on the lower part of the stem, shiny green with pale green to yellow mottling or irregular spots above, greyish-green underneath; lamina (lanceolate-)ovate (to elliptic), acute to acuminate, 2–9.6 by (0.9–)1.5–4.3 cm. Inflorescence secund, (relatively) lax, glandular-pubescent; rachis 4.3–14.2 cm long, (4–)9- to many-flowered; bracts (ovate-)lanceolate, acuminate (to caudate), subequal to or shorter than the ovaries, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 7–17.4 by 2.5–5.8 mm. Flowers sessile, mainly white to pink with petals and labellum green-or brownish-tipped. Sepals glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal boat-shaped with recurved apex, ovate oblong to lanceolate-oblong, obtuse, 1-veined, 7.6–11 by 3.4–5.3 mm; lateral sepals slightly spreading with recurved apices, shallowly boat-shaped, obliquely ovate-oblong to lanceolate oblong, obtuse, 1-veined, 7.2–12 by 2.9–4.7 mm. Petals obliquely elliptic to oblanceolate, obtuse to rounded, 6.6–11 by 3–4.6 mm. Labellum linear-triangular, 6.4–11 by 3.4–3.9 mm, distinctly concave with a flat, obtuse to subacute recurved distal part with two low longitudinal ridges; the concave part with scattered fleshy hairs. Column 3.6–5.5 mm long (to apex of the rostellum); anther acuminate in front, 2.8–3.4 mm long. Ovary 5–15.5 mm long, glandular pubescent. Capsule sessile, obovoid-oblongoid, 1–1.2 cm long, 0.4–0.5 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 30–55 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–7, herbaceous, crowded on the lower part of the stem, green above, pale light green underneath; lamina obliquely elliptic to broadly lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 3.6–13 by 1.6–5.2 cm. Inflorescence cylindric, relatively lax, glandular-pubescent; rachis 7.7–18.3 cm long, 9- to many-flowered; bracts linear-lanceolate, acuminate, shorter than or subequal to the ovaries, subglabrous to sparsely pubescent on the dorsal side, 3–8 by 1–2.5 mm. Flowers (sub)sessile, dull (brownish-)pink to light rose-coloured or pale green except for the white to yellow or brown labellum with green venation and yellowish hairs. Sepals pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal straight to slightly incurved, ovate oblong, obtuse, 3-veined, 4–4.9 by 2.8–3 mm; lateral sepals slightly spreading, obliquely ovate, obtuse, 3-veined, 4–4.2 by 2.4–3 mm. Petals obliquely rhombic-oblong, obtuse to acute, 4–4.6 by 1.9–2.5 mm. Labellum broadly ovate, 3.3–3.5 by ca. 3.4 mm, concave with a flat, rounded to obtuse recurved apex; the concave part with a large central tuft of fleshy hairs, devoid of other ornaments. Column 2.7–3 mm long (to apex of the long rostellum); anther acuminate in front, 2.4–2.5 mm long. Ovary 8.5–10 mm long, pubescent. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 12–30 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–8, herbaceous, crowded on the basal part of the stem, pale greyish-green with obscure dark green reticulation above, paler and shiny underneath; lamina cordate-ovate to ovate-elliptic, slightly oblique, acute to acuminate, (1.4–)2.5–8 by (0.8–)1.8–3.5 cm, margins often slightly undulate. Inflorescence cylindric to secund, lax, pubescent (sometimes sparsely so); rachis 3–9.2 cm long, 2- to 20-flowered; bracts (narrowly) lanceolate, acuminate, longer than or subequal to the ovaries, ciliate in their proximal half (otherwise glabrous), 11–23 by 2–8.5 mm. Flowers sessile, predominantly pale green to dull red with the apex of labellum white. Sepals glabrous; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, straight to slightly incurved, (oblong-)lanceolate, subacute, 3-veined, 6–16.2 by 3–6.1 mm; lateral sepals reflexed, shallowly boat-shaped, (oblong-)lanceolate, slightly falcate, subacute, 3-veined, 6–15.1 by 2–5.4 mm. Petals obliquely oblanceolate to spathulate-rhombic, obtuse to subacute, 6–15.8 by 2–5.6 mm. Labellum broadly ovate, 7–12.8 by 6.8–10.1 mm, concave with a flat, obtuse to acute, recurved to reflexed apex; the concave part with a large central (sometimes longitudinally split) tuft of fleshy hairs, devoid of other ornaments. Column 6.2–12.5 mm long (to apex of the very long rostellum); anther acuminate in front, 5.9–11.1 mm long. Ovary 6–15 mm long, subglabrous to sparsely pubescent. Capsule sessile, ovoid-fusiform, 13–19 mm long, 6–7 mm in diameter.

description: Almost always terrestrial, deciduous, tuberous herbs, mostly glabrous. Flowering shoots (5–)10–80(–150) cm tall, unbranched. Foliage leaves one to several, basal or cauline, lanceolate, elliptic or ovate. Usually with one to several sterile bracts above the foliage leaves, their margins often short-hairy. Inflorescence terminal, racemose. Flowers few to many, small, medium-sized or rarely large, resupinate in the Thai species, predominantly white to green, rarely yellow, pink or red; often fragrant. Sepals free; dorsal sepal concave and almost always erect in the Flora area, often forming a hood with the petals; lateral sepals spreading or reflexed. Petals entire or bilobed. Labellum 3-lobed or rarely entire, sometimes basally clawed; spur long or short, clavate, slender or saccate, very rarely absent. Column short; anther erect or somewhat reflexed, thecae mostly adjacent and only rarely separated by a wide connective, mostly with narrow basal extensions termed anther canals, pollinia 2, sectile; stigmas as freely projecting short or elongate stigmaphores; rostellum 3-lobed, central rostellum lobe insignificant or rarely prominent. Ovary glabrous or papillose, mostly indistinguishable from the pedicel. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by six longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 600 species, distributed throughout the tropics and subtropics of the world, predominantly found in grassland or savanna, less commonly in densely forested habitats; 45 species in Thailand.</br></br>Notes: A more comprehensive version of this account was published in Thai Forest Bull., Bot., special issue: 7–105. 2009.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 17–52 cm tall. Foliage leaves 1–3, cauline, scattered in the lower half of the stem, lanceolate-oblong, acute, mucronate, 3–13(–19) by 0.4–2.2 cm. Sterile bracts 6–11(–15), spreading or suberect, lanceolate, acuminate, 1.4–4.5(–8.5) cm long, margins often stiff-hairy. Inflorescence semi-dense or lax, 10- to 18-flowered; rachis 2.5–6 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 9–25 by 1.3–2.2 mm, margins usually stiff-hairy. Flowers 8–10 mm in diameter, yellow to greenish-yellow, white or orange, spur often green in the upper half, sometimes sepal and petal margins stiff-hairy. Sepals subacute; dorsal sepal erect, elliptic to ovate, 3–5.2 by 2–5 mm; lateral sepals recurved, obliquely ovate-lanceolate, 5–7 by 2.7–4.5 mm. Petals oblong, obtuse, cohering with the dorsal sepal, 3.5–5 by 0.9–2.6 mm. Labellum 6–12 by 2.5–5.5 mm, 3-lobed to the base, with a collar in front of the spur mouth; midlobe linear or oblong, 5–12 by 0.5–0.9 mm; side lobes linear, 1–3(–6) by 0.3–0.8 mm, ranging from one to two thirds of its length; spur cylindric, clavate in its distal third, 7–19 mm long. Column 2.2–4 mm long; anther erect, anther canals ca. 2 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 8–16(–24) mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 19–45 cm tall. Foliage leaves 5–9, cauline and scattered along the stem, elliptic-ovate or elliptic-obovate, obtuse or acute, to 11.6 by 3 cm. Sterile bracts 0–4, erect, lanceolate-elliptic, acute, 1–2.5 cm long. Inflorescence lax, 2- to 11(–16)-flowered; rachis 3.5–13 cm long; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, 15–23(–28) by 5–10.5 mm. Flowers 1.2–1.9 cm in diameter, sepals white with greenish tips, labellum green. Sepals obtuse to subacute; dorsal sepal erect, suborbicular, 5.7–9 by 6–9 mm; lateral sepals obliquely ovate, (6–)7.5–10.5 by 2.5–4.5 mm, basally united with the petals and the labellum. Petals suberect, bilobed; posterior lobe narrowly strap-like, 3-veined, 6–11 by 0.5–1.9 mm; anterior lobe narrowly strap-like, 6–10 by 0.5–0.7 mm. Labellum 10–13 mm long, equally 3-lobed to near the base; lobes narrowly linear to filiform, 9–12 by 0.5–0.75 mm; spur cylindric, clavate in the distal half, 12–15 mm long. Column 2–4 mm long; anther ca. 2.5 mm long, anther canals ca. 2 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 17–20 mm long, smooth. Capsule fusiform-elliptic, ca. 16.8 mm long, about 5 mm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 16–25 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2, basal, adpressed to the soil, ovate or orbicular, acute, mucronate, 2–4 by 1.6–3.8 cm. Sterile bracts 3–6, erect, lanceolate, acuminate, 0.9–1.2 cm long. Inflorescence lax, (1–)5-to 8-flowered; rachis 4–8.1 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate to ovate, acuminate, 6.6–11 by 2.35–4 mm. Flowers 4–8 mm in diameter, subactinomorphic, perianth lobes subequal, unlobed, outside of sepals, petals and labellum green, inside of petals and labellum white; flowers rarely opening up widely. Sepals elliptic ovate, subacute or acute; dorsal sepal 5.6–7 by 2.2–5 mm, lateral sepals 5.5–6.5 by 2–3 mm. Petals elliptic-ovate, subacute, 4.9–6.5 by 1.8–2.8 mm. Labellum spurless, 4.5–6.5 by 2–3.5 mm. Column 1.5–2 mm long, with two 3-lobed organs (apparently representing the anther and the rostellum) and two stout forwards-curved stigmas. Ovary (including pedicel) 10–14.5 mm long. Capsule fusiform, 12–15 by 2.5–3 mm.

description: Flowering shoots 24–63(–80) cm tall, glabrous below, with elongate papillac and stout grouped or branched hairs above. Foliage leaves 4–6, cauline, scattered in the lower stem part, lanceolate, acute, (14–)21–24 by (2.8–)3–5.9 cm, petiolate, glabrous. Sterile bracts 8–10, lanceolate, acute or acuminate, 2–4 cm long, margins shortly hairy. Inflorescence lax, many flowered; rachis 9–33 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 12–21 by 2.2–4 mm, margins with stiff short hairs. Flowers 1.3–1.5 cm in diameter, green. Sepals often with stiff short hairs on the margins, dorsal sepal erect, broadly elliptic or suborbicular, 2.4–3 by ca. 3 mm; lateral sepals recurved, front margin as a false apex pointing downwards, 7–8 by 1.5–3 mm. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, linear, acute, 2.5–3.2 by 1 mm. Labellum to 13 mm long, 3-lobed to near the base, lobes linear, midlobe ca. 12 by 0.6 mm; side lobes ca. 8 by 0.3 mm; spur cylindric and distally clavate, 17–25 mm long, straight, pointing backwards or upwards. Column ca. 3 mm long; anther canals 6.5–7.2 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 20–27 mm long, papillose or shortly hairy. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 25–30 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–7, cauline, scattered along the stem, oblong-lanceolate, acute, to 11.5 by 1.5 cm. Sterile bracts absent. Inflorescence dense, many-flowered; rachis ca. 9.5 cm long; floral bracts narrowly lanceolate to ovate, acuminate, to 25 mm long. Flowers ca. 1.5 cm in diameter, white. Sepals subacute or obtuse; dorsal sepal erect, broadly elliptic to suborbicular, 7–7.8 by ca. 4 mm; lateral sepals spreading, narrowly ovate, basally united with the petals and the labellum, 6.4–8 by 3.3–4 mm. Petals falcately triangular, cohering with the dorsal sepal, obtuse, ca. 6 by 3.9 mm. Labellum 10–16 mm long, 3-lobed to ca. 4.5 mm from the base, lobes oblong or linear; midlobe 5.5–6.5 by 1.6–1.8 mm, margins deflexed; side lobes 5.8–6.3 by ca. 0.5 mm; spur cylindric and distally clavate, 7.1–8 mm long, slightly geniculate. Column 2.7–2.8 mm long; anther canals ca. 0.5 mm long, stigmas ca. 2.5 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) ca. 12 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, (5–)11–25 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–4, basal, lanceolate, acuminate or acute, mucronate, 5.5–9 by 1.9–4.2 cm, with white blotches. Sterile bracts 3–7, spreading or suberect, lanceolate, acuminate, 0.8–2.2 cm long. Inflorescence lax, 2- to 10(–15)-flowered; rachis 2–3 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate or acute, 10–13 by 10–12 mm. Flowers to 2.2 by 3 cm, pink or rarely white. Sepals subacute or obtuse; dorsal sepal erect, narrowly elliptic to ovate, 6–10 by 3–6 mm; lateral sepals spreading, ovate, 8–10.5 by 6–10 mm. Petals cohering with the dorsal sepal, broadly ovate, several-veined, 6–9 by 4–6 mm, anterior margins sometimes shortly hairy. Labellum 18–30 mm long, 3-lobed, upper surface and margins normally shortly hairy; midlobe spathulate or obovate, (10–)22–25 by (10–)12–15 mm, apically deeply incised; side lobes flabellate, (9–)18–20 by 7–8 mm; spur cylindric, distally clavate, 35–43(–55) mm long. Column 3.5–4.5 mm long; anther canals ca. 4 mm long; central rostellum lobe prominent and exceeding the anther in length; auricles prominent and extending above the anther canals. Ovary (including pedicel) 19.4–28 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 12–30(–66) cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–5, cauline, scattered in the lower half of the stem, lanceolate-oblong, acute, mucronate, 4–17 by 0.4–1.1 cm. Sterile bracts 1–7, narrowly lanceolate, acute or acuminate, 1.4–5.5 cm long, erect or suberect, margins often with short stiff hairs. Inflorescence semi-dense or lax, 6- to 30-flowered; rachis 2–8 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acute or acuminate, 11–17 by 1–2.5 mm, margins with short stiff hairs. Flowers 8–10 mm in diameter, mostly yellow, sometimes greenish, brown or yellow, once reported with a white labellum, spur greenish-yellow. Sepals ovate, obtuse; dorsal sepal erect, 3.6–5 by 2.5–3.5 mm; lateral sepals spreading, not or weakly oblique, 4–6 by 2.6–3.9 mm. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, oblong-ovate, obtuse, 3.7–5.5 by 1.2–2.4 mm. Labellum 4–7 by 1.5–1.7 mm, 3-lobed to near the base, without a collar at the base; midlobe oblong, 4.2–5.8 by 0.5–1.4 mm; side lobes very narrowly triangular, 2–3.8 by 0.4–0.8 mm; spur cylindric, clavate in the distal third, (8–)8.5–10.8 mm long. Column 2–3 mm long; anther canals 1–1.5 mm long; stigmas 1.5–1.8 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 10–15 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous or elongate-papillose, 18–27 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–5, clustered near the stem base, lanceolate-elliptic, shortly and abruptly acuminate, mucronate, 6–12 by 2–3.7 cm. Sterile bracts 2, erect, lanceolate, acuminate, 1.9–3.6 cm long. Inflorescence lax, 7- to 13-flowered; rachis 7–13 cm long, elongate-papillose or slightly denticulate; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 11–19 by 5–7 mm, margins elongate-papillose to shortly hairy. Flowers green. Sepals elliptic-ovate; dorsal sepal erect, obtuse, 6–7 by 3–5 mm, with prominent and sometimes slightly denticulate ribs but not prominent keels; lateral sepals oblique, subacute, 6.5–7 by 3–4 mm, basally united with the labellum. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, narrowly triangular, subacute, 6.2–7 by 1.5–2 mm. Labellum 8–8.3 mm long, 3-lobed from near the base, lobes linear, obtuse; midlobe 5.5–6.4 by 0.9–1 mm; side lobes 8.9–9.5 by 0.7–0.8 mm; spur cylindric and clavate in its upper half, slightly curved forwards, 16.8–18 mm long. Column 3–4 mm long; anther canals 2–2.7 mm long; stigmas ca. 2.5 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 14.8–16 mm long, with pronounced and occasionally slightly denticulate ribs. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, (59–)75–150 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–7, cauline, scattered in the lower stem portion, lanceolate-oblong, acute, sometimes mucronate, 8.3–18(–32) by 1.3–2.4(–3) cm. Sterile bracts to 14, suberect, narrowly lanceolate, acute, 4.7–7(–11) cm long, margins with stiff hairs. Inflorescence lax, 7- to many-flowered; rachis 10.5–16(–21) cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acute or acuminate, 19–37(–62) by 2–4 mm, margins with stiff hairs. Flowers 1.8–2 cm in diameter (excluding labellum), white or greenish-white, turning brown. Sepals obtuse or subacute; dorsal sepal erect, suborbicular, deeply hooded, 5–7 by 6–11 mm, hood 4–5.5 mm deep; lateral sepals reflexed or spreading, ovate, 11–15 by 7–9.5 mm, more than twice as long as the dorsal sepal, strongly oblique with a false apex pointing downwards. Petals erect, oblong-ovate, obtuse, 5.2–7.2 by 3–3.6 mm. Labellum over 30 mm long, 3-lobed above the 5–8 mm long united base; midlobe linear, entire, 22–37 by ca. 1 mm; side lobes of similar length, linear, spur cylindric, 60–80 mm long, clavate in the upper part. Column 2.5–4 mm long; anther canals ca. 7 mm long, upwards-angled. Ovary and pedicel 48–70 mm long. Capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Habenaria commelinifolia . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 95. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 95–130 cm tall, with purple tinge. Foliage leaves 9–11, cauline, clustered in the stem middle, lanceolate, acute, mucronate, 10–21 by 2–4.1 cm. Sterile bracts 7–10, erect, lanceolate, acute, 2.7–4.8 cm long. Inflorescence semi-dense or dense, many flowered; rachis 5–9 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 13–27 by 2.5–3 mm. Flowers 8–10 mm in diameter, green, greenish-brown, also reported as white, red or reddish-green. Sepals subacute or obtuse; dorsal sepal reflexed, hooded, lanceolate to oblong-suborbicular, 3.8–6 by (2–)2.4–3.5 mm; lateral sepals spreading, obliquely-ovate, 4.1–7 by 2.5–3.5(–4) mm. Petals erect, bilobed to near the base; anterior lobe linear, 6–10 by 0.2–0.5 mm; posterior lobe narrowly lorate, 3.5–5(–6) by 0.3–0.9 mm. Labellum 7–10.5 mm long, 3-lobed to near the base, lobes linear, midlobe 4.5–10 by 0.6–0.8 mm; side lobes similar but slightly narrower; spur cylindric, 14.5–20 mm long, distally clavate. Column 2.2–3 mm long; anther canals 1–2.5 mm long, straight projecting forwards; stigmas 1.7–2 mm long. Ovary 9–12 mm long, with a narrow neck; pedicel sharply distinct from it, (10–)21–22 mm long. Capsule ovoid-fusiform, ca. 11 by 4.8 mm, long-stalked.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, (26–)42–101 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–7, cauline, scattered in the lower stem half, elliptic-ovate, acute, mucronate, 6–20 by 1.5–3.2–5) cm. Sterile bracts 3–11, erect, lanceolate, acuminate, 2–7.5 cm long. Inflorescence semi-dense or lax, (2–)5- to many-flowered; rachis (2–)4–9.5 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acute or acuminate, 10–33 by 2–6 mm. Flowers 1.3–2.9 cm in diameter, white, sometimes partly tinged with green; margins of perianth lobes mostly denticulate or shortly hairy. Sepals subacute or acute, sometimes mucronate; dorsal sepal erect, elliptic-ovate, 7–16 by 3.5–9 mm; lateral sepals spreading, ovate, 7.5–17 by 3.4–5.5(–9) mm. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, lanceolate, acute, 5–11.5 by (1.2–)1.7–2.8 mm. Labellum 9–25 by 2.5–17 mm, 3-lobed, usually spreading, with a narrow claw, a collar in front of the spur mouth; midlobe oblong or triangular, acute or subacute, (3–)11–22 by 0.7–3 mm; side lobes spreading, mostly flabellate, (0.5–)2.9–22 by 1–12 mm, margins mostly dentate; spur cylindric, usually 20–50 mm long, distally clavate, mostly geniculate. Column 2.5–5 mm long; anther canals 1.5–3 mm long; stigmas 2.3–3 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 15–30 mm long, keels pronounced and often shortly hairy. Capsule subsessile, elliptic-fusiform, 19–26.9 mm long, 3.7–5.4 mm in diameter, with a beak to 6.4 mm long.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 36–43 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–5, cauline, scattered in the lower stem part, lanceolate-oblong, acute, mucronate, 7–13 by 1–2 cm. Sterile bracts to 7, erect or spreading, lanceolate, acuminate, 1.8–3.6 cm long, margins shortly hairy. Inflorescence semi dense, 8- to many-flowered; rachis 5–7 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 8–16 by 1–2 mm, margins shortly hairy. Flowers to 1.8 cm in diameter, dorsal sepal, petals and labellum white, lateral sepals brown. Sepals obtuse to subacute; dorsal sepal suberect, elliptic, 4.7–5 by 3.3–4 mm; lateral sepals recurved, obliquely ovate, 5–5.9 by 3.5–5 mm. Petals erect, oblong, obtuse or subacute, 4–4.5 by 1.2–2 mm. Labellum to 14 mm long, 3-lobed above an undivided base of 3–4 mm, lobes linear, base with a concave tongue in front of the spur mouth; midlobe 9–10.3 by ca. 0.8 mm; side lobes similar but narrower; spur cylindric, 21–25 mm long, distally clavate. Column ca. 2.8 mm long; anther canals ca. 2 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 15–19 mm long, beaked. Capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Habenaria erostrata . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 98. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 50–71(–90) cm tall. Foliage leaves 5–6, cauline, clustered in the stem middle, elliptic-oblanceolate, acute or acuminate, 8–14 by (1.8–)2.4–3.5 cm. Sterile bracts 1–2, erect, lanceolate, 2.5–3.5 cm long. Inflorescence lax, 8-flowered; rachis 14.5–22 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 15–24 by 4–5 mm. Flowers to 3.1 cm in diameter, pale green. Sepals elliptic-oblong, subacute or obtuse, prominently mucronate; dorsal sepal erect, 15–17 by 5–8 mm; lateral sepals spreading, similar but slightly shorter and narrower. Labellum 17–20 mm long, 3-lobed above a basal stalk 5–6 mm long, lobes linear; midlobe 12–13 by 0.5–0.8 mm; side lobes 12–14 by 0.6–1 mm; spur cylindric, 18–23 mm long, slightly geniculate, clavate in the distal half. Column ca. 4.5 mm long; anther canals 1.7–2 mm long, straight; stigmas ca. 3.8 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 26–30 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, (24–)38–68 cm tall. description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 30–38 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–3, cauline, scattered in the lower half of the stem, narrowly elliptic-oblong, subacute, 4–8 by 0.3–1 cm. description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 13–15 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–4, cauline, scattered in the upper half of the stem, elliptic-lanceolate, acute, 2–5.5 by 0.7–1 cm. Sterile bracts absent. description: Flowering shoots glabrous, to 100 cm tall. Foliage leaves 6–10, cauline and scattered in the stem middle, lanceolate-elliptic, acute or acuminate, mucronate, 13–21 by 3.5–5.1 cm. description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 27–56(–74) cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–9, cauline, scattered in the lower portion of the stem, elliptic-lanceolate, acute, mucronate, (3–)6–16 by 0.8–2.8 cm. description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 21.5 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4, basal and spreading just above the soil, elongate-ovate to elliptic, acute to subacute, 4–7 by 1.2–2.2 cm. description: Flowering shoots  57–65 cm tall, glabrous below, with elongate papillae and stout branched or grouped hairs above. description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 45–77 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–7, cauline, scattered in the lower stem half, elliptic-oblong, acute, mucronate, 4–12 by 1–3(–4.5) cm.
