description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 19–40 cm tall. Foliage leaves (2–)4–5, cauline, scattered in the lower two thirds of the stem, lanceolate, acute or acuminate, mucronate, 8–15 by 2–2.5 cm. Sterile bracts 1–3, erect, lanceolate to ovate, acuminate, (2–)3–4.4 cm long, margins minutely denticulate or shortly hairy. Inflorescence lax, few-flowered; rachis 3–4 cm long; floral bracts narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, 15–25 by 2–5 mm, margins sometimes shortly hairy. Flowers white with green sepals and petals, labellum base often red. Sepals acute; dorsal sepal erect, ovate, 8–8.5 by 4–4.2 mm; lateral sepals spreading to somewhat reflexed, obliquely ovate, 7.5–11.5 by 4.75–4.9 mm, basally united with the labellum. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, linear, acute or obtuse, 7–8 by 0.5–1 mm. Labellum 18–25 mm long, 3-lobed above a basal united part of 4.5–7 mm; midlobe linear-oblong, 4–8 by 0.7–1 mm; side lobes 13–23 mm long, with 15–17 laciniae 11.5–20 by 0.25–0.3 mm; spur cylindric, 31–40 mm long, sometimes distally clavate. Column 3.5–4.5 mm long; anther erect, anther canals 1.7–3 mm long; auricles insignificant. Ovary (including pedicel) 20–40 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, to 50 cm tall. Foliage leaves 5–7, cauline, forming a cluster near the stem middle, ovate-elliptic, acute to acuminate, mucronate, (7.5–)9–14 by 2.5–4.8 cm. Sterile bracts 2, erect, ovate, acuminate, 2.5–5 cm long. Inflorescence dense or semi-dense, 20- to 30-flowered; rachis 4–9 cm long; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate to caudate, (19–)21–25 by 3.4–6 mm. Flowers 1.3–1.6 cm long, green or pale green, labellum and petals sometimes whitish; sepals and petals with filiform caudae which measure one third to half of their length; flowers scented. Sepals ovate or ovate-lanceolate; dorsal sepal erect, 22–30 by 3–4 mm; lateral sepals spreading, 18–29 by 3.5–4 mm. Petals bilobed, both lobes filiform; posterior lobe 14–17 mm long; anterior lobe 8–10 mm long. Labellum 18–28 mm long, 3-lobed from the base, all lobes filiform; midlobe 18–28 by 0.3–0.4 mm; side lobes 14–28 by 0.3–0.4 mm; spur cylindric, 19–20.5 mm long, distally clavate. Column 1.8–2 mm long; anther 4.5 mm long, reflexed, anther canals ca. 2 mm long. Ovary 11–25 mm long, differentiated from a pedicel up to 5 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 15–20 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2, basal, close to and partly adpressed to the soil, elongate-ovate to elliptic, unequal in size, subacute, 6–8 by 3–5 cm. Sterile bracts 3, erect to spreading, narrowly lanceolate, acute, to 1.5 cm long. Inflorescence lax, rather wide, 2- to 12-flowered; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, ca. 8 by 3.4 mm. Flowers to 1.4 cm in diameter, white with green dorsal sepal and spur. Sepals subacute; dorsal sepal erect, with 3 veins which are rather pronounced on the outside, ovate, 4.5–5 by ca. 3.3 mm; lateral sepals spreading, ovate-elliptic, ca. 6.3 by 4 mm. Petals lorate-spathulate, obtuse, forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, ca. 5 by 1.7 mm. Labellum ca. 7.5 mm long, 3-lobed almost to the base; midlobe linear, ca. 6.5 by 0.6 mm; side lobes linear, ca. 5 by 0.8 mm, upwards-curved, base forming a right angle with the midlobe; spur ca. 14 mm long, pendent, strongly clavate in the distal half. Column ca. 2.8 mm long; anther canals ca. 1 mm long; stigmas ca. 1 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) ca. 17 mm long, patent. Capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Habenaria poilanei . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 128. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, (10–)16–23 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–3, basal, adpressed to the soil, ovate, acute, (2–)2.3–6 by 1.3–3 cm. Sterile bracts 3–6, erect but apex spreading, lanceolate, acuminate, 0.8–2.5 cm long. Inflorescence lax, (1–)2- to 5-flowered; rachis 2–6.5 cm long; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, 7–12 by 3–4(–5) mm, margins sometimes denticulate. Flowers 1.3–1.4 cm in diameter, sepals and petals pale greenish, labellum and lower spur half white, distal spur half pale green. Sepals subacute or obtuse, margins denticulate; dorsal sepal erect, acuminate, ovate, 4.9–7 by 3.3–4.5 mm; lateral sepals spreading, elliptic-ovate, 6–9 by 2.8–3.3(–4) mm. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, linear-triangular, acute, 5–6.5(–2) by 1–1.6(–2) mm. Labellum 9–11 mm long, 3-lobed to near the base; midlobe linear, 7–10 by 0.6–1.5 mm; side lobes lorate, 4.5–12(–14) by 1–2 mm; spur cylindric, 15–25 mm long, distally clavate. Column ca. 2.7 mm long; anther canals 1–1.5 mm long; stigmas 3–4.5 mm long, about three to five times longer than the anther canals. Ovary (including pedicel) 13–15(–17) mm long, ribs denticulate or papillose. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 34–59 cm tall, glabrous below, with elongate papillae and stout hairs above. Foliage leaves 3–6, cauline, clustered in the lower stem third, elliptic-lanceolate, acuminate, mucronate, 13–18 by 2.5–4.4(–5.3) cm, glabrous. Sterile bracts 5–9, suberect, lanceolate, acuminate, 2–3 cm long, glabrous, margins mostly hairy. Inflorescence lax, (10–)17 to 25-flowered; rachis (8.5–)14–25 cm long, hairy; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 15–18 by 4–6 mm, margins shortly hairy. Flowers 1–1.5 cm in diameter, light green or whitish. Sepals subacute; dorsal sepal erect, suborbicular, 3–5 by 3-4 mm; lateral sepals recurved, forming a false apex pointing downwards, 8–11 by 4–4.5 mm. Petals broadly triangular, obtuse, forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, 2.5–4 by 1.5–1.8 mm. Labellum 10–15 mm long, 3-lobed above a united 3.5–4 mm long base; midlobe terete, 6.5–14 by 1–1.5 mm long; side lobes similar, 6.2–7.5(–11) by 0.6–1 mm; spur cylindric, 15–18 mm long, distally clavate, strongly curved forwards below the flower. Column 2–3 mm tall; anther canals 6–8 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 17–25 mm long, with elongate papillae and stout hairs, neck narrow. Capsule elliptic-fusiform, ca. 25 mm long, 3.7 mm in diameter, with a long beak.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, (4.5–)10–19 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–4, basal, adpressed to the soil, elliptic to ovate, acute, mucronate, 1.4–4 by 1–1.4 cm. Sterile bracts (1–)4–9, spreading or suberect, lanceolate, acuminate, 0.5–1.8 cm long. Inflorescence lax, (1–)3- to 7-flowered; rachis 3–5 cm long; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, 7–10 by 1.5–3 mm. Flowers 6.5–9 mm in diameter, yellow-green or brownish. Sepals lanceolate-elliptic or ovate-elliptic, subacute or obtuse; dorsal sepal erect, 3.5–4(–4.5) by 1.5–3 mm; lateral sepals spreading, 3.5–4(–4.5) by 1.7–3.4 mm. Petals falcately linear-triangular or elliptic-lanceolate, subacute or obtuse, forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, 3.5–4.5 by 0.8–1.6 mm. Labellum 4.5–10 mm long, 3-lobed almost to the base; midlobe linear, (3.7–)5–9 by 0.2–0.3(–0.7) mm; side lobes filiform, 6–29 by 0.1–0.3 mm; spur cylindric, to 7.6 mm long but often much shorter, curved forwards, distally clavate. Column 1–2.3 mm long; anther canals insignificant; stigmas ca. 2 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 8–15 mm long. Capsule sessile, elliptic-fusiform, 9.5–10 mm long, 2.2–3 mm in diameter, shortly beaked.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 10–25(–42) cm tall. Foliage leaves (2–)4–5(–7), cauline, scattered in the lower half of the stem, oblong-lanceolate, acute, mucronate, 4–17(–24) by (0.6–)1–1.9(–3.8)cm, green or rarely mottled with greyish-green. Sterile bracts 2–8(–11), mostly suberect,lanceolate, acuminate, 1.8–4(–8) cm long. Inflorescence lax, (1–)2- to 20-flowered; rachis 1–6 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate to ovate, acuminate, (7.5–)15–22(–30) by 4–6(–7) mm. Flowers 2–3.5 cm in diameter, variable from red to yellow and pink. Sepals elliptic, subacute; dorsal sepal erect, 6–9(–15) by 6–7(–10) mm; lateral sepals reflexed, (5.5–)8–13 by 3.5–6 mm, basally connate with the labellum. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, elliptic-lorate, 1-veined, subacute, 6–7.8(–13) by 1.5–3 mm. Labellum 16–27(–35) by 12–23 mm, 3-lobed with a claw 2–5(–8) mm long, base with a collar in front of the spur mouth; midlobe spathulate, 9–14(–19) by (7.5–)9–13(–19) mm, apically deeply incised; side lobes flabellate, ovate-oblong, 9–13(–21) by 4–6.3(–12) mm; spur cylindric, 30–45(–50) mm long, sometimes distally clavate. Column 3–5 mm long; anther canals 4–8 mm long; central rostellum lobe prominent and exceeding the anther in length; auricles insignificant. Ovary (including pedicel) 19–32 mm long. Capsule elliptic fusiform, 28.1–38 mm long, 4–5.2 mm in diameter, with a short basal stalk and apical beak.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 16–50 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–4, cauline, scattered in the lower stem half, oblong-oblanceolate, acute, mucronate, 4.3–7(–13) by 0.5–1.4 cm. Sterile bracts 5–8(–11), suberect, lanceolate, acuminate, 2–5.3 cm long. Inflorescence semi-dense, (3–)5 to 17-flowered; rachis 1.6–5 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 10–15 by 1.8–3 mm, margins shortly hairy. Flowers 1–1.5 cm in diameter, mostly pale pink, brown or white, lateral sepals usually with brown or green blotch, also reported with dark sepals and white petals; margins of dorsal sepal and petals mostly denticulate or shortly hairy. Sepals obtuse or subacute; dorsal sepal erect, suborbicular, 3.9–5.4 by 3–5 mm; lateral sepals reflexed, strongly obliquely ovate, 5.8–8 by 3.3–5.4 mm. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, triangular-oblong, subacute, 4–5 by 1–2.1 mm, basally united with the lateral sepals and the labellum. Labellum 7–13 mm long, 3-lobed above a short united part, with a 3–4 mm long and weakly 3-lobed erect tongue in front of the spur mouth; midlobe linear, 5.5–12 by 1–1.6 mm; side lobes linear, 7–11.5 by 0.5–1 mm; spur cylindric, 15–25 mm long, geniculate, distally clavate. Column 3–4 mm long; anther canals 3–5 mm long, geniculately bent upwards; stigmas 3–4 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) (17–)20–25 mm long, beaked. Capsule sessile, elliptic-fusiform, to 25 mm long and 4.5 mm in diameter, with an elongate beak.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 17–38 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–4. cauline, scattered in the lower stem part, oblong-oblanceolate, acute, mucronate, 4.5–12 by 0.4–1.4 cm. Sterile bracts 6–11, suberect, lanceolate, acuminate, 2–5 cm long, margins denticulate or shortly hairy. Inflorescence semi-dense, (3–)7- to 18-flowered; rachis 2–7 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 9–18 by 1–3 mm, margins shortly hairy. Flowers 1–1.2 cm in diameter (excluding labellum), mostly brown, pinkish-brown, orange-brown or orange, also recorded as yellow or white with dark brown labellum, spur sometimes green. Sepals obtuse or subacute, margins mostly denticulate; dorsal sepal erect, suborbicular, (3–)3.5–4.2 by 3–4 mm; lateral sepals reflexed, prominently obliquely ovate, 5.5–7 by 3–4.8 mm. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, triangular-oblong, subacute, 3–4.2 by 1.7–1.8 mm, basally united with the lateral sepals and the labellum, margins mostly denticulate. Labellum 8–14 mm long, 3-lobed above a short united part, with a collar in front of the spur mouth; midlobe linear, 7–12 by 0.8–1.2 mm; side lobes linear, (6–)9–12 by 0.5–0.8 mm; spur cylindric, 17–25 mm long, distally clavate. Column 2.5–3 mm long; anther canals 2–3 mm long, straight or slightly curved upwards; auricles prominent and high. Ovary (including pedicel) 19–27 mm long, beaked, hairy. Capsule elliptic fusiform, ca. 22.3 mm long and 4.1 mm in diameter, beak elongate.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, (15–)23–36(–48) cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–4, cauline, scattered in the lower half of the stem, linear, acute, mucronate, 5–12 by 0.4–1(–1.5) cm. Sterile bracts 6–13, spreading or erect, lanceolate, acuminate, 1–5.5 cm long, margins papillose-denticulate or shortly hairy. Inflorescence dense, 10- to 30-flowered; rachis 1.5–3.5(4) cm long; floral bracts linear-lanceolate, elongate-acuminate, 10–25 by 1.5–2.2 mm, margins sometimes shortly hairy. Flowers 8–11 mm in diameter, white, yellow or brown, once recorded as purple. Sepals obtuse; dorsal sepal erect, elliptic, 3–5 by 1.8–3.5 mm; lateral sepals reflexed, obliquely ovate-elliptic, 4–6(–7) by 2.8–3.5(–3.8) mm. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, oblong to triangular, obtuse, 3.3–5.5 by 0.9–2 mm. Labellum 6–10 mm long, 3-lobed from near the base, with a collar in front of the spur mouth; midlobe attenuate, 5–9 by 0.6–1.6 mm; side lobes attenuate, 3–5.5 by 0.5–0.7 mm; spur cylindric, 4.3–13 mm long, distally clavate. Column 2–2.5 mm long; anther canals short; lateral rostellum lobes apically enlarged. Ovary (including pedicel) 9–16(–20) mm long. Capsule sessile, elliptic-fusiform, 10–13 mm long, 1.8–3.6 mm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 8–12.5 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2(–3), basal, adpressed to the soil, cordate to ovate-lanceolate, mucronate, 1.9–3(–4.8) by 1.5–2.1(–2.4) cm. Sterile bracts 3–4, suberect, lanceolate, acuminate, 0.8–2 cm long, margins sometimes shortly hairy. Inflorescence lax and rather wide, 2- to 9-flowered; rachis 1–5 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate to ovate, acuminate, 7–13 by 2.2–3 mm, margins shortly hairy. Flowers to 1.5 cm in diameter (excluding labellum), white or greenish-yellow. Sepals  subacute or obtuse; dorsal sepal erect, elliptic, 5.8–7 by 3–5 mm; lateral sepals spreading, elliptic-ovate, 6.5–7(–8) by 2.5–3(–3.7) mm. Petals erect, triangular, subacute, 6–7 by 1.8–3 mm. Labellum 11–15 mm long, 3-lobed almost to the base; midlobe linear, 7–11 by ca. 0.6 mm; side lobes filiform, forming an acute angle with the midlobe, (11–)15–18 by ca. 0.3 mm; spur cylindric, 7–12.5 mm long, distally clavate. Column 1.5–3 mm long; anther thecae adjacent; auricles rather high; lateral rostellum lobes short, bent upwards, with a wide truncate apex. Ovary (including pedicel) 11–17 mm long, patent. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 49–63(–80) cm tall. Foliage leaves 6–10, cauline, forming a cluster near the middle of the stem, elliptic-oblanceolate, acuminate, 8–20 by 2.5–5.3 cm. Sterile bracts 1–5, erect, lanceolate, acuminate, 2.5–3.5 cm long. Inflorescence densely many-flowered; rachis 4–11 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 16–22 by 5–7 mm. Flowers 1–2 cm in diameter, green, pale green or rarely white. Sepals elliptic, long-acuminate; dorsal sepal erect, 9.5–13 by 5–7 mm; lateral sepals spreading, 8–13.8 by 5–5.8 mm. Petals bilobed; posterior lobe cohering with the dorsal sepal, narrowly oblong, acute, 7–11 by 1.2–1.8 mm; anterior lobe 1.5–3 by 0.5–0.7 mm long. Labellum 10–17 mm long, 3-lobed above a basal part 2–4 by ca. 3.5 mm, all lobes linear, midlobe 8–13 by 1.5–2 mm; side lobes 8–11 by 1.1–1.3 mm; spur cylindric, 13–17(–23) mm long, slightly geniculate, clavate towards the apex. Column 4–5 mm long; anther canals ca. 2 mm long, stigmas stout, ca. 3 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 12.5–17 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 44–50 cm tall. Foliage leaves to 12, cauline, scattered in the stem middle or all along it, broadly elliptic or lanceolate, acute, mucronate, (3.5–)8–12 by (1.7–)2.4–3.5 cm, lower surface pale green or silvery. Sterile bracts absent. Inflorescence lax, many-flowered; rachis 8–15 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acute, (12.3–)20–27 by 0.7–4 mm. Flowers green or greenish-white, petals and labellum a few times reported as white, in a doubtful record flower described as pink. Sepals subacute or obtuse; dorsal sepal erect, hooded, broadly ovate or suborbicular, 3.5–7 by 4–5 mm; lateral sepals spreading or recurved, obliquely ovate lanceolate, 5–8 by 2–4 mm. Petals spreading or suberect, bilobed to near the base; posterior lobe 2-veined, 4–6 by ca. 1 mm; anterior lobe 3–4.5 by 0.2–0.5 mm. Labellum 6–7.5 mm long, 3-lobed to near the base; midlobe oblong or linear, 4–7 by ca. 0.6 mm; side lobes similar but shorter, 3.5–6 mm long; spur cylindric, 9–16 mm long. Column 2–3 mm long; anther loculi ca. 2.2 mm long, anther canals ca. 1 mm long; stigmas ca. 1.5 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 14–16 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 21–60 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–3(–4), cauline, scattered in the lower half of the stem, elliptic-ovate, acute, mucronate, 5–11 by 1.6–2.8 cm. Sterile bracts spreading or suberect, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 2–4 cm long. Inflorescence semi-dense, 6- to 9-flowered; rachis 5–7.8 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate to caudate, 16–25 by 3–4 mm, margins minutely denticulate to shortly pubescent. Flowers 2–2.7 cm in diameter, white. Sepals acuminate; dorsal sepal erect, ovate-oblong, 10–15 by 3.5–4.5 mm, margins denticulate to shortly pubescent; lateral sepals reflexed, lanceolate to ovate-oblong, 12–16 by 4–6.5 mm. Petals cohering with the dorsal sepal, linear-falcate, acuminate, 10–11 by 1.3–1.5 mm, margins sometimes serrate. Labellum 3-lobed above a short basal claw; midlobe linear-lanceolate, subacute, 7–11 mm long; side lobes with filiform laciniae 9–12 mm long; spur cylindric, to 90 mm long, apically clavate. Column 2–3 mm long; anther canals 1–2 mm long; stigmas short and globose, auricles inconspicuous. Ovary (including pedicel) 20–39 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 10–36 cm tall, hairy and elongate-papillate. Foliage leaves 2–5, cauline, in a cluster near the stem base, elliptic-oblanceolate, subacute, mucronate, (3–)8–14 by 1.3–3 cm, glabrous, margins often shortly hairy. Sterile bracts 1–3, spreading or erect, lanceolate, acute or acuminate, 1.3–2.8 cm long, glabrous, margins shortly hairy. Inflorescence lax, (4–)6-to 10-flowered; rachis 4–14(–21) cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 9–19 by 2.8–5.5 mm, glabrous, margins shortly hairy. Flowers to 1.7 cm in diameter, white or whitish-yellow with green lateral sepals and labellum. Sepals subacute; dorsal sepal erect, suborbicular, 6.5–9 by ca. 4 mm; lateral sepals reflexed, obliquely ovate, 6–7 by 3.8–4.7 mm. Petals cohering with the dorsal sepal, broadly ovate, subacute, 6–8 by 4–6 mm. Labellum 8–11 mm long, 3-lobed to the base, with a ridge in front of the spur mouth; midlobe recurved below the flower, linear to oblong, 7–10 by 0.8–1.5 mm; side lobes pointing upwards, oblong or linear, 12–15 by 0.8–1 mm; spur cylindric, 20–30 mm long. Column 2.5–4 mm long; anther canals ca. 2 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 15–22 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 23–45 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–4, basal, suberect or erect, narrowly lanceolate, subacute or acute, 5.5–11 by 0.5–0.85 cm. Sterile bracts 1–7, erect, lanceolate, acuminate, 0.7–4.5 cm long, margins sometimes serrate. Inflorescence lax, about 12 to many-flowered; rachis 8.5–24 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, (3.5–)5–8 by 1–2 mm. Flowers 4.8–7 mm in diameter, green or yellow-green. Sepals subacute; dorsal sepal erect, suborbicular, 2–3.5 by 1.6–2.5 mm; lateral sepals spreading, somewhat obliquely ovate, 3-4.4 by 1.8–3.5 mm. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, triangular-ovate, subacute or obtuse, 2–3.8 by 0.5–1.5 mm. Labellum 4.5–9 mm long, 3-lobed from just above the base; midlobe oblong, sides deflexed, 2.9–5 by 0.8–1 mm; side lobes spreading, oblong, acute, 3.5–6 by 0.4–1.2 mm; spur cylindric, 15–21 mm long. Column 1–1.5 mm long; anther reflexed, anther canals in the examined Thai material 0.5–0.8 mm long; stigmas to 2 mm long. Ovary 4.2–7.7 mm long, distinct from the 1.5–3.5 mm long pedicel. Capsule shortly stalked, elliptic-fusiform, 12.8 mm long, 2.9 mm in diameter. [This description does not include the doubtful collection Suksathan 3579].

description: Terrestrial herbs with underground tubers; stem glabrous. Foliage leaves 1(–2), basal. Inflorescence spicate; bracts much smaller than the foliage leaves, much shorter than the flowers. Flowers (1–)3 to many, resupinate, white to pink or variegated. Sepals plain (i.e., not saccate); dorsal sepal 4–9 mm long. Petals connivent with the dorsal sepal. Labellum narrowly attached to the column, broadly oblong to elliptic, minutely rugose-papillose on the ventral side, spurred at base; spur shorter than the labellum lamina, not constricted at base. Column with a flabellate, concave stigma; distal part of rostellum broad, saddle-shaped, jutting out below the thecae; viscidia 2, contained in separate, non-versatile bursicles formed partly from the rostellum and partly from the anther canals; anther firmly attached, thecae not extending from the column; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 10 species distributed in Nepal, northern India, Bhutan, Myanmar, Thailand, northern Vietnam, southern China and Taiwan; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 8–31.3 cm tall; stem 0.5–4 mm in diameter, often spotted with purple. Foliage leaf sessile (to short-petiolate), ovate to (lanceolate-)elliptic, mottled dull/dark green (or purple/green) above, pale light green with purple marks underneath, acute to acuminate, 4.2–18.4 by 1.5–10.2 cm. Inflorescence lax, more or less secund; rachis (0.4–)1.5–11.8 cm long; bracts (linear-)triangular, acuminate, 6–13.1 by 3.4–4.7 mm. Flowers predominantly pink to rose-coloured (sepals and petals often white). Sepals boat-shaped, glabrous; dorsal sepal ovate oblong, obtuse, 1-veined, 4.7–5.1 by 2.7–3 mm; lateral sepals reflexed, broadly and obliquely ovate, obtuse to rounded, 3-veined, 5.8–6.2 by 3.7–3.9 mm. Petals obliquely ovate, rounded, minutely apiculate, minutely papillose on the dorsal side, 3-veined, 4.7–5 by 3.2–3.3 mm. Labellum rounded-truncate to emarginate with a tiny apiculum in the sinus, more or less undulate along the finely erose-crenate margin, proximally provided with two low longitudinal ridges, 7.2–9.1 by 6.3–7.8 mm; spur straight to slightly downcurved, (conical-)cylindric, obtuse to rounded, 4.7–6.3 mm long. Column semiterete, 2.6–2.8 mm long. Ovary 6–15 mm long. Capsule subsessile, terete, ca. 12 mm long, ca. 4 mm in diameter.

description: Terrestrial herbs with underground tubers; stem glabrous. Foliage leaves 2–4, scattered along the stem or crowded on its basal part. Inflorescence spicate; bracts much smaller than the foliage leaves, those in the apical part of the inflorescence shorter than the flowers. Flowers many, resupinate, yellowish-green. Sepals plain (i.e., not saccate); dorsal sepal 2.5–3.1 mm long. Petals connivent with the dorsal sepal. Labellum narrowly attached to the column, 3-lobed (rarely 5-lobed), minutely papillose, distinctly concave at base. Column with a bilobed, convex stigma, distal part of rostellum transversely rectangular, viscidia 2, naked; anther firmly attached, thecae not extending from the column; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous. Fruit a capsule. dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>About 30 species constitute this genus. The distribution stretches from Europe through temperate parts of Siberia to Japan and eastern China, from where it continues further south and west to the Himalayas, Thailand, Vietnam and scattered areas in Malesia; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 16–85 cm tall; stem 1–4 mm in diameter. Foliage leaves scattered along the stem, uniformly green, sessile, sheathing at base, linear to linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 3.2–26 by 0.2–1.3 cm. Inflorescence cylindric, lax in its proximal part, denser towards the apex; rachis 5.3–37 cm long; bracts ovate-lanceolate to narrowly lanceolate, long-acuminate, 0.3–1.5 by 0.1–0.2 cm. Sepals glabrous, 1-veined; dorsal sepal ovate to elliptic, boat-shaped, rounded, 2.5–3.1 by 0.8–1.6 mm; lateral sepals obliquely ovate to obliquely elliptic, obtuse to rounded, 2.5–3.1 by 0.8–1.5 mm. Petals falcately linear, subacute, glabrous, 1-veined, 1.8–3 by 0.5–0.6 mm. Labellum 3-lobed from a narrow, 2–4.2 mm long base; side lobes filiform, obtuse, 0.9–7 by 0.2–0.4 mm; midlobe oblong, obtuse, usually much shorter than the side lobes. Column semiterete with distinctly stalked lateral auricles, 0.6–0.9 mm long. Ovary 3.3–3.5 mm long. Capsule erect, ovoid, 3–7 mm long, 1.5–2.5 mm in diameter.

description: Terrestrial, rhizomatous herbs; the creeping stem-like rhizome rooting from its nodes. Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base. Foliage leaves scattered along the stem, petiolate; petiole channelled, sheathing at base. Inflorescence spicate; bracts sparsely glandular pubescent on the dorsal side. Flowers resupinate. Sepals free, 3-veined; dorsal sepal 7–11 mm long. Petals connivent with the dorsal sepal. Labellum basally adnate to the column, straight (i.e., not twisted), simple, spurred at base; spur protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals when the flower is viewed from the side, inside with several small warts; the flat distal part of the labellum provided with two oblongoid calli at base and a median ridge in most of its length. Column straight (i.e., not twisted); stigma bilobed, flat; rostellum triangular, bifid; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glandular-pubescent. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A monotypic genus; distribution as for the species (see below).

description: Flowering shoots 20–39.5 cm tall; lower part of stem 3–6 mm in diameter. Foliage leaves 8–13, uniformly green; petiole (including sheath) 1.5–4.5 cm long; lamina (ovate-)lanceolate, acuminate, 4.5–10 by 1.5–3.cm. Inflorescence glandular-pubescent, subspherical to broadly cylindric, dense; rachis 3.2–8 cm long; bracts boat-shaped, lanceolate-oblong to elliptic, acuminate, exceeding the ovary, 10–23 by 3–11 mm. Flowers 8 to many, sessile, predominantly white (sepals and petals tinged with orange-red to pink). Sepals subsimilar, broadly lanceolate to oblong-obovate, subacute to rounded, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 3-veined, 7–11 by 2.5–4.4 mm; dorsal sepal boat-shaped with recurved tip. Petals connate for some distance in their distal part, obliquely elliptic-lanceolate to obovate, obtuse, 2- to 3-veined, 6–10.2 by 3.8–4.3 mm, entire to minutely erose in their distal half. Labellum basally adnate to the column, broadly spathulate, deflexed from the middle, 5.5–9.3 by 5–6.5 mm (excluding spur); spur parallel to the ovary, cylindric (to subclavate), thinner than the ovary, bifid (to truncate) at apex, 8–10 mm long. Column subclavate, 4–6.5 mm long: anther rounded in front, 3.2–3.6 mm long, 1.5–1.8 mm wide; pollinia elongate. Ovary 10–15 mm long. Capsule sessile, 1.6–2 cm long, 0.4–0.8 cm in diameter.

description: Terrestrial, rhizomatous herbs; the creeping stem-like rhizome rooting from its nodes. Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base, (12–)19–57 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–10, scattered along the stem or crowded on its lower part, petiolate, sheathing at base. Inflorescence spicate to racemose; bracts (glandular-)pubescent on the dorsal side. Flowers 6 to many, non-resupinate. Sepals free or connate at base, 1- to 3-veined; dorsal sepal 3–6.9 mm long. Petals connivent with (and sometimes adherent to the dorsal sepal. Labellum adnate to the column for a short or long distance, straight (i.e., not twisted), 3.2–5.5 mm long along the mid-line, simple or differentiated into hypochile and epichile: basal part concave to saccate (not protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals when the flower is viewed from the side), inside with 1–8 filiform, scale-like or fleshy, appendages on either side; epichile (if recognizable) vestigial to large and bilobed. Column straight (i.e., not twisted), with two small to prominent wings on the front; stigma bipartite, flat; rostellum triangular, bifid, producing a tiny tegule; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary (glandular-)pubescent. Fruit a capsule dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 30 species distributed from tropical Africa to Madagascar and other islands of the Indian Ocean, and from Indomalesia to northeastern Australia and Polynesia (east to Tahiti); 8 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 30–35 cm tall. Foliage leaves 5–10; lamina obliquely lanceolate to obovate, (sub)acuminate, mucronate, 6–12 by 2.3–5.5 cm. Inflorescence (glandular-)pubescent; rachis 6.5–10 cm long, many-flowered; bracts (linear-)lanceolate, acuminate, 3- to 5-veined, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 6.1–9.6 by 1.9–4 mm. Flowers (sub)sessile, mainly green to purplish-brown with cream to white petals and labellum; perianth perpendicular to the ovary. Sepals connate at base, 3-veined, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal boat-shaped with more or less recurved apex, oblong-ovate, obtuse to rounded, 4.1–4.8 by 2.1–3.2 mm; lateral sepals porrect with more or less recurved apices, somewhat boat-shaped, obliquely elliptic, obtuse to rounded, 4.3–5 by 2.4–3.4 mm. Petals obliquely oblanceolate to obovate with wavy margins, rounded, 1- to 2-veined, glabrous, 3.7–5.1 by 1.5–3 mm. Labellum adnate to the whole front of the column, 3.5–4.2 mm long along the mid-line; basal part inside with 1 fleshy, multiarmed appendage on either side; epichile set off from the hypochile by a distinct constriction, irregularly rhomboid to transversely oblong, approximately half as wide as the hypochile. Column 1.8–2 mm long; wings on the front incurved, obliquely oblong to linear triangular, shorter than the rostellum; rostellum 0.5–0.7 mm long, subequal to the anther. Ovary (glandular-)pubescent, 7.3–9.5 mm long. Capsule erect, (sub)sessile, oblongoid, (glandular-) pubescent, 1–1.1 cm long, 0.3–0.4 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots ca. 50 cm tall. Foliage leaves 6–8: lamina obliquely, elliptic-lanceolate, 4.5–9 by 2.3–3.5 cm. Inflorescence (glandular-)pubescent; rachis ca. 11.5 cm long, many flowered; bracts linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 1- to 3-veined, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 8.1–12.1 by 2.7–3.8 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled, mainly orange-yellow with bright yellow petals and labellum; perianth continuing the line of the ovary. Sepals free, 3-veined, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal ovate, obtuse, 5.4–5.5 by ca. 3.2 mm; lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate-oblong, obtuse, ca. 4.7 by ca. 2 mm. Petals obliquely elliptic lanceolate, subacuminate, 3-veined, sparsely glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, ca. 4.6 by ca. 2 mm. Labellum adnate to the proximal half (or more) of the column, 4.4–4.5 mm long along the mid-line; basal part inside with 1–2 fleshy, simple to multiarmed appendages on either side; epichile hardly recognizable (labellum devoid of a distinct constriction below the apex); distal part of the labellum (c. 0.5 mm below the apex) much less than half as wide as the proximal part. Column ca. 3 mm long; wings on the front straight, linear, subequal to the rostellum; rostellum ca. 1 mm long, subequal to the anther. Ovary (including pedicel) glandular-pubescent, 12.7–13.2 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 32–57 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–5; lamina obliquely elliptic-lanceolate, acute to acuminate, sometimes mucronate, 3.6–8.8 by 1.6–3.5 cm. Inflorescence pubescent; rachis 2–12 cm long, 6- to 18-flowered; bracts triangular-ovate, acuminate, 1- to 3-veined, pubescent on the dorsal side, 5.7–8.3 by 3.7–5 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled, mainly (pinkish-) green with white-tipped sepals and petals and white labellum; perianth perpendicular to the ovary. Sepals free, 3-veined, pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal shallowly boat-shaped, oblong, rounded, 4.8–5 by 2.5–2.6 mm; lateral sepals slightly spreading, shallowly boat-shaped, obliquely oblong, obtuse, 5.5–5.7 by 2.7–3.1 mm. Petals obliquely linear, rounded, l-veined, glabrous, 5.1–5.2 by 1–1.1 mm. Labellum adnate to the proximal one third of the column, 4.9–5.5 mm long along the mid-line; basal part inside with 2 scale-like, hooked appendages on either side; epichile set off from the hypochile by a distinct constriction, well-developed, consisting of two strongly recurved, broadly and obliquely obovate lobules, much wider than the hypochile when spread out. Column 3.2–3.5 mm long; wings on the front straight, obliquely triangular oblong, much shorter than the rostellum; rostellum ca. 1.5 mm long, equal to or slightly shorter than the anther. Ovary (including pedicel) pubescent, 9–11.5 mm long. Capsule suberect, sessile, ellipsoid, sparsely pubescent, 0.9–1 cm long, 0.5–0.6 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots ca. 37.5 cm tall. Foliage leaves ca. 4; lamina obliquely elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, acute to acuminate, (3–)7–8.5 by (1–)2.3–4.2 cm. Inflorescence pubescent; rachis ca. 10 cm long, many-flowered; bracts linear-lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 1-veined, pubescent on the dorsal side, 7.4–11.5 by 2.3–3 mm. Sepals free, 3-veined, pubescent on the dorsal side: dorsal sepal boat-shaped, ovate-oblong, obtuse, 4.2–5.3 by 1.8–2 mm; lateral sepals slightly spreading, shallowly boat-shaped, obliquely ovate-oblong, obtuse to subacuminate, 4.7–5.3 by 2.2–2.3 mm. Column 2.2–2.3 mm long; wings on the front incurved, obliquely triangular, shorter than the rostellum; rostellum ca. 0.5 mm long, subequal to the anther. Ovary pubescent, 4.5–9.5 mm long. description: Flowering shoots 34–50 cm tall. Foliage leaves 7–8; lamina obliquely elliptic to lanceolate-oblong, acute to subacuminate, 5.4–11.5 by 2.5–5.1 cm. Inflorescence (glandular-) pubescent; rachis 12–17 cm long, many-flowered; bracts linear-triangular, acuminate, 1-veined, (glandular-)pubescent on the dorsal side, 5.1–13 by 2.2–3.4 mm. Flowers sessile, mainly pinkish green with cream petals and labellum and yellow column; perianth describing an obtuse angle to the ovary. Sepals free, 3-veined, (glandular-)pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal boat shaped with recurved apex, ovate-elliptic, obtuse, 5.1–5.4 by 2.5–3 mm; lateral sepals slightly spreading, shallowly boat-shaped, obliquely ovate-elliptic to oblong, obtuse to rounded, 4.9–5.4 by 2.3–2.6 mm. Petals obliquely (oblanceolate, rounded to subacute, (2–)3-veined, glabrous, (4.3–)4.8–5.4 by (1.6–)1.9–2.1 mm. Column 2.1–2.5 mm long; wings on the front incurved, obliquely oblong, shorter than the rostellum; rostellum ca. 1 mm long, subequal to the anther. Ovary (glandular-)pubescent, 3–7 mm long. description: Flowering shoots 30–44 cm tall. Foliage leaves 6–9; lamina obliquely lanceolate to narrowly elliptic, acute to obtuse, 2.3–5.9 by 0.8–2.5 cm. Inflorescence pubescent; rachis 5–11.2 cm long, 9, to many-flowered; bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 1-veined, pubescent on the dorsal side, 5.8–8 by 1.5–2.1 mm. Flowers subsessile, white; perianth continuing the line of the ovary. Sepals free, 3-veined, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side: dorsal sepal boat-shaped, linear lanceolate to lanceolate-oblong, obtuse, 4.8–5.3 by 1.6–1.8 mm; lateral sepals slightly spreading, shallowly boat-shaped, obliquely (linear-)lanceolate, obtuse (to acute), 4.3–5.1 by ca. 1.4 mm. Column 3.1–3.3 mm long; wings on the front incurved, semicordate, shorter than the rostellum; rostellum 1.3–1.4 mm long, exceeding the anther. Ovary glandular-pubescent, 6.5–6.8 mm long. Capsule (sub)erect, subsessile to short pedicelled, ellipsoid, sparsely glandular-pubescent to subglabrous, 0.6–0.8 cm long, 0.3–0.4 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots (12–)19–46 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–8; lamina obliquely elliptic to (ob)lanceolate-oblong, acute to acuminate, (2.4–)3.3–8.4 by (1–)1.4–4 cm. Sepals free. 1- to 3-veined, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, elliptic-)oblong, obtuse to rounded, 3–3.9 by 1.4–2 mm; lateral sepals slightly spreading, more or less boat-shaped, obliquely (elliptic-)oblong, acute to rounded, 3.5–4 by 1.3–1.8 mm. description: Terrestrial, rhizomatous herbs; the creeping stem-like rhizome rooting from its nodes. Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base. Foliage leaves scattered along the stem, petiolate; petiole channelled, sheathing at base. Inflorescence spicate; bracts ciliate, sparsely pubescent on the dorsal side. Flowers resupinate. Labellum basally adnate to the column, straight (i.e., not twisted), differentiated into hypochile and epichile; hypochile forming a subspherical sac that is hidden by the lateral sepals when the flower is viewed from the side; epichile linear-lanceolate, sulcate. Column straight (i.e., not twisted); stigma bilobed, flat, sometimes subtended by two small digitate appendages; rostellum linear-triangular, bifid; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glandular-pubescent. Fruit not seen.</br></br>A genus of ca. 10 species. The distribution is mainly Malesian, reaching peninsular Thailand in the west, the Philippines in the north and the Solomon Islands in the east; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Terrestrial, achlorophyllous, mycoheterotrophic, rhizomatous herbs; rhizome J-shaped; aerial stem simple or branched, thin, brittle, with sheaths, black, dark purple or brown. Foliage leaves reduced to triangular, scale-like sheaths or bracts. Inflorescences erect, terminal on the new shoot or lateral on the old stem, few- to many-flowered, opening in succession with one or two opening at a time. Flowers not opening widely. Sepals  free, 5- to 7-veined, glabrous. Petals free, 3- to 5-veined, glabrous. Labellum entire or 3-lobed, typically adnate along its margin to the base of the column forming a short tube, rarely free; disc covered with multicellular hairs, giving the distal part of the labellum a bearded appearance. Column elongate, with a pair of small wings on each side of the anther; pollen forming two friable masses. Ovary slender, with a cup-like denticulate calyculus at apex. Fruit a capsule, with persistent calyculus at apex. Seeds slender, with lateral micropyle and small testa cells.</br></br>A genus of ca. 20 species, distributed from Japan to Indo-China, NE India, Bhutan, Myanmar, Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Sumatra, Java, the Philippines and New Guinea; 5 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 20–65 cm tall, erect, dark purple to black, 3–4 mm in diameter at base, branched; nodes with sheaths; sheaths glabrous, ovate, 3–5 mm long, acute, coriaceous, base amplexicaul. Inflorescence glabrous; rachis 1.5–4 cm long, 3- to 15-flowered; bracts ovate, glabrous, 0.5–1.5 by 1–1.5 mm, margin membranous. Flowers long-pedicelled, green to light brown. Sepals glabrous; dorsal sepal oblong-oblanceolate, 6–11 by 1.8–3 mm, 7-veined, apex hooded: lateral sepals oblong, 5.5–11 by 1.5–2.5 mm, 5-veined, apex hooded and apiculate. Petals glabrous, oblong, 5.5–10 by 2–3 mm, 3-veined. Labellum entire, rarely obscurely 3-lobed, 6–10 mm long along the mid-line, free from the column, 5-veined, major veins branched above; side lobes (if present) indistinct, not exceeding the column; midlobe oblong-oblanceolate, 2.5–3 mm wide, hooded, margin irregularly erose, with a small median hairy band. Column ventrally glabrous to finely puberulent, 4–8 mm long; winged at the top, wings semicircular with finely papillose edges; anther ca. 1 mm long, muricate at apex. Ovary (including pedicel) 8–20 mm long; calyculus glabrous, ca. 0.5 mm long, margin irregularly denticulate. Capsule black, fusiform, 2–2.3 cm long, 2–2.2 mm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 15–30 cm tall, erect, light brown to dark brown, 1.5–3.5 mm in diameter at base, branched or not; nodes with sheaths; sheaths glabrous except for the ciliate margin, ovate, 1–7 mm long, acute to acuminate, coriaceous, base amplexicaul. Inflorescence glabrous; rachis 1–4 cm long, 3- to 6-flowered: bracts ovate-lanceolate, glabrous, smooth or minutely muricate, 0.5–5 by 1–1.5 mm. Flowers long-pedicelled. Sepals greenish-yellow, glabrous, smooth or minutely muricate near apex, not or slightly hooded; dorsal sepal oblong-oblanceolate, 12–19 by 2–4 mm, 5-veined, apex acute to obtuse; lateral sepals oblong-oblanceolate, 11–18 by 2–4 mm, 5-veined, apex acute to obtuse. Petals greenish-yellow, glabrous, oblong, 11–17 by 2.5–4 mm, 4 to 5-veined, apex acute to obtuse. Labellum white or light yellow, 3-lobed, 14–18 mm long along the mid-line, base adnate to the column for up to half of the column length, 6- to 7-veined, major veins branched above; side lobes triangular, apex much exceeding the column; midlobe oblong, 3–5 mm wide, hairy except for the erose margin. Column glabrous, 7–12 mm long; winged at top, semicircular, anther ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous. Ovary (including pedicel) 10–20 mm long; calyculus glabrous, 0.5–1 mm long, margin irregularly denticulate. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 15–50 cm tall, erect, black, 3–4 mm in diameter at base, tuberculate, branched; nodes with sheaths; sheaths smooth to tuberculate, ovate, 2–4 mm long, acute, coriaceous, base amplexicaul. Inflorescence smooth to tuberculate; rachis 1–2 cm long, 3- to 12-flowered; bracts ovate, smooth to tuberculate, 0.5–2 by 1–1.5 mm. Flowers long-pedicelled, pale pink. Sepals glabrous, smooth or minutely muricate near apex, hooded; dorsal sepal oblong oblanceolate, 15–17 by 3–4 mm, 5-veined, lateral veins branched above, apex obtuse; lateral sepals oblong-oblanceolate, 16–17 by 3.5–4 mm, 5-veined, lateral veins branched above, apex obtuse. Petals glabrous, oblong-oblanceolate, 16–17 by 3.5–4 mm, 3-veined, lateral veins branched above, apex rounded. Labellum white, 3-lobed, 15–16 mm long along the mid-line, without calli between side lobes, base adnate to the column for more than half of the column length, 7-veined, major veins branched above; side lobes rounded, margin irregularly denticulate, slightly exceeding the column, 8–10 mm wide across side lobes when flattened; midlobe ovate, short, 3–4 mm long, 4–5 mm wide, hairy except for the membranous margin. Column glabrous, 12–13 mm long; winged at top, semicircular; anther ca. 1 mm long, glabrous. Ovary (including pedicel) 10–20 mm long, sparsely tuberculate; calyculus minutely muricate, 0.5–0.8 mm long, margin entire to denticulate. Capsule black, fusiform, 28–30 by 3–3.2 mm.

description: Flowering shoots 40–65 cm tall, erect, dark purple to black, 3–4 mm in diameter at base, branched; nodes with sheaths; sheaths glabrous, ovate, 1–4 mm long, acute to acuminate, coriaceous, base amplexicaul. Inflorescence glabrous; rachis 1–3 cm long, 5- to 15-flowered; bracts ovate, glabrous, smooth or minutely muricate, 0.5–1.5 by 1–1.5 mm. Flowers long pedicelled, dark brown. Sepals pale green, glabrous, smooth or minutely muricate near apex, cucullate; dorsal sepal oblong-oblanceolate, 10–11 by 3–3.5 mm, 5- to 7-veined, apex obtuse; lateral sepals oblong-oblanceolate, 10–10.5 by 2.8–3.2 mm, 5-veined, apex obtuse. Column glabrous, 7–8 mm long; winged at the top, rectangular, wing edges finely papillose; anther ca. 1 mm long, finely papillose. Ovary (including pedicel) 10–20 mm long; calyculus glabrous, 0.5–1 mm long, margin irregularly denticulate. Capsule black, fusiform, 15–20 by 2–3 mm.

description: Flowering shoots 15–40 cm tall, erect, dark brown to black, 1.5–2 mm in diameter at base, branched at base; nodes with sheaths; sheaths glabrous, ovate, 1–3 mm long, acute, coriaceous, base amplexicaul, margin membranous. Inflorescence glabrous; rachis 1–5 cm long, 5- to 25-flowered; bracts ovate, glabrous, 0.5–1.5 by 1–2 mm. Flowers long-pedicelled, greenish-yellow. Petals light greenish-yellow, glabrous, oblong-oblanceolate, 12–15 by 2–3 mm, 3- to 4-veined, apex obtuse. Labellum simple, rarely indistinctly 3-lobed, shortly obovate, 14–16 mm long along the mid-line, 5–8 mm wide, around the middle with 2 faint finely pubescent oblong bands, base adnate to the column for more than half of the column length, slightly gibbous on the anterior side, 7-veined, major veins branched above; epichile hairy, bluish-purple. Column glabrous, 11–12 mm long; winged at the top, semicircular; anther 1–1.5 mm long, glabrous. Ovary (including pedicel) 15–20 mm long; calyculus glabrous, 0.5–1 mm long, margin irregularly denticulate. Capsule fusiform, 1.5–3 by 2–2.5 mm.

description: Lithophytic, rhizomatous herbs; the creeping stem-like rhizome rooting from its nodes. Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base. Foliage leaves petiolate; petiole channelled, sheathing at base. Inflorescence spicate; bracts ciliate, otherwise glabrous. Flowers resupinate. Sepals free, 1-veined; dorsal sepal 7.7–10.4 mm long. Petals connivent with the dorsal sepal, 1-veined, glabrous. Labellum basally adnate to the column, twisted, 8.5–11.5 mm long, differentiated into hypochile, mesochile, and epichile; hypochile saccate (but not protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals when the flower is viewed from the side), sac inside with 1 slightly bilobed appendage on either side; mesochile devoid of lateral flanges; epichile simple, entire. Column twisted in opposite direction to the labellum, clavate; stigma bilobed, flat; rostellum triangular, bifid; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile, bright yellow; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary white, pubescent. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>Monotypic, distribution as for the species (see below).

description: Flowering shoots (6–)9–28 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–7, crowded on the lower part of the stem, dark olive-green with whitish to copper-red variegation above, uniformly green to purplish underneath; petiole (including sheath) 0.8–3.4 cm long; lamina ovate to oblong, acuminate to obtuse, apiculate, 0.8–8.5 by 0.5–4 cm. Inflorescence broadly cylindric to secund, lax, pubescent; rachis (0.8–)1.7–9 cm long; bracts suberect to spreading, boat-shaped, (triangular-)ovate, acuminate, shorter than or subequal to the ovaries, 1-veined, 7–15 by 4.3–9.5 mm. Flowers 2–18, subsessile, predominantly white (anther bright yellow). Sepals glabrous; dorsal sepal suberect (to porrect over the column), boat-shaped, ovate, obtuse, 7.7–10.4 by 4.5–6.5 mm: lateral sepals spreading, obliquely elliptic, obtuse to rounded, 8.9–12 by 4.9–7.1 mm. Petals falcately (linear-) lanceolate, obtuse to rounded, 8–10.8 by 1.6–2.5 mm. Labellum sometimes indented along the mid-line of the hypochile; mesochile channelled, entire; epichile transversely rectangular, 3.2–3.3 times wider than long. Column porrect (more or less continuing the line of the ovary), 4–7 mm long; anther caudate in front, 4–4.5 mm long. Ovary 8–16.5 mm long. Capsule suberect, short-pedicelled, fusiform, pubescent, 1.2–1.6 cm long, 0.3–0.6 cm in diameter.

description: Terrestrial (rarely epiphytic), rhizomatous herbs; the creeping stem-like rhizome rooting from its nodes. Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base. Foliage leaves petiolate; petiole channelled, sheathing at base. Inflorescence racemose. Flowers non-resupinate. Sepals free, more or less boat-shaped, obtuse to rounded; dorsal sepal 5–5.5 mm long. Petals connivent with and adherent to the dorsal sepal, 1-veined, glabrous. Labellum basally adnate to the column, twisted, ca. 5 mm long along the mid-line, differentiated into hypochile, mesochile and epichile; hypochile saccate (not protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals when the flower is viewed from the side), sac inside with 1 cylindric-clavate appendage on either side; mesochile flat; epichile simple, entire. Column twisted, irregularly subterete; stigma bilobed, flat; rostellum linear-triangular, bifid; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glandular-pubescent. Fruit not seen.</br></br>A genus of ca. 10 species. The distribution is mainly Malesian, reaching peninsular Thailand, Vietnam and the Philippines in the northwest and Vanuatu in the east; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 20–39 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–7, crowded on the lower part of the stem, dark green with golden to copper-red reticulation above, whitish-green (sometimes with pale purplish markings) underneath; petiole (including sheath) 1–4.5 cm long; lamina ovate to elliptic, obtuse to acute or very shortly acuminate, 3.8–8 by 2.5–7 cm. Inflorescence cylindric, lax (to fairly dense), glandular-pubescent; rachis 5.3–13 cm long; bracts suberect, more or less boat-shaped, oblong-triangular, acuminate to acute, shorter than the ovaries, 3.8–9 by 2.5–4 mm. Flowers 9 to many, subsessile, predominantly reddish-brown with pale petals, partly white labellum and yellowish anther. Sepals glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal porrect over the column, strongly boat-shaped, ovate, obtuse, 5–5.5 by 2–3.3 mm; lateral sepals spreading, somewhat boat-shaped, obliquely ovate, obtuse to rounded, 5.5–8.5 by 3–5.5 mm. Petals obliquely linear, rounded to obtuse, 5–6.3 by 0.7–1.5 mm. Labellum slightly indented along the mid-line of the hypochile; hypochile with erect sides, subquadrate when spread out, each apex forming an obtuse lobe; mesochile narrow; epichile transversely elliptic. Column partly reflexed (nearly perpendicular to the ovary), 3–4 mm long; anther incurved and acuminate in front, ca. 2.6 mm long. Ovary 7.5–8.8 mm long.

description: Small, terrestrial, rhizomatous herbs: the creeping stem-like rhizome rooting from its nodes. Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base. Foliage leaves petiolate; petiole channelled, sheathing at base. Inflorescence spicate; bracts ciliate, sparsely pubescent on the dorsal side. Flowers 1–6, resupinate. Sepals cohering, 1-veined; dorsal sepal 4–8 mm long. Petals connivent with and adherent to the dorsal sepal. Labellum straight (i.e., not twisted), 5–12 mm long along the mid-line, differentiated into hypochile, mesochile, and epichile; hypochile slightly concave, inside with 1 small appendage on either side; mesochile devoid of lateral flanges, epichile bilobed. Column straight (i.e., not twisted); stigma bipartite, raised on short stigmaphores; rostellum triangular, bifid; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary subglabrous. Fruit not seen.</br></br>A genus of ca. 15 species distributed from the Himalayas in the northwest to Japan in the northeast and New Guinea in the southeast (but apparently with several gaps); 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 10–13 cm tall; lower part of stem 0.5–2 mm in diameter. Foliage leaves 5–7, scattered along the stem to somewhat crowded on its lower part; petiole (including sheath) 2–7 mm long; lamina ovate, rounded to acute, 0.8–2.2 by (0.5–)0.7–1.2 cm. Inflorescence pubescent, lax; rachis 2–3.7 cm long; bracts lanceolate to ovate, (sub)acute to acuminate, shorter than the ovary, 2.5–6(–7.7) by 1–2(–2.8) mm. Flowers 4–6, white, not opening widely. Sepals subsimilar, ovate, obtuse to subacute, (sub)glabrous, 4–6.5 by 1.9–3 mm, entire; dorsal sepal slightly boat-shaped. Petals oblanceolate-oblong, obtuse, apiculate, 1-veined, 3–4.5 by 1.2–2 mm, entire to finely erose. Labellum basally adnate to the column, 7–8 mm long along the mid-line; mesochile with margins incurved to meet in the middle; epichile with entire margins. Column semiterete, 1–2 mm long; anther obtuse in front, ca. 1.8 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm wide; pollinia elongate. Ovary 3–6 mm long.

description: Terrestrial, rhizomatous, sometimes mycoheterotrophic herbs; the creeping stem-like rhizome rooting from its nodes. Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base, 4–40 cm tall. Foliage leaves (if present) 3–11, scattered along the stem or somewhat crowded, petiolate, sheathing at base. Inflorescence spicate; bracts glabrous, (erose-)ciliate or papillose to (glandular-)pubescent on the dorsal side. Flowers 1 to many, resupinate or non-resupinate. Sepals free or lateral sepals connate at base, 1- to 3-veined; dorsal sepal 4.5–16 mm long. Petals adherent to the dorsal sepal. Labellum basally adnate to the column, straight or twisted, 7.7–19 mm long along the mid-line, differentiated into hypochile, mesochile, and epichile; hypochile saccate (but not protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals when the flower is viewed from the side), often containing a low median keel and 1 stalked appendage on either side; mesochile with one or two pairs of entire to pectinate lateral flanges; epichile bilobed or simple and rounded-truncate. Column straight or twisted; stigma bilobed to bipartite, flat; rostellum triangular, bifid; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous to (glandular-)pubescent. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 40 species distributed from the Himalayas and Japan across tropical Southeast Asia, Malesia and the Pacific islands (northeast to Hawaii); 8 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots (6–)10–15(–25) cm tall, often branched. Foliage leaves 3–6, crowded on the middle to lower part of the stem, green; lamina obliquely (lanceolate-)ovate, acute, sometimes mucronate, (1.9–)2.6–7 by (1.1–)1.3–3.2 cm. Inflorescence pubescent, (1–)2- to 10-flowered; rachis up to 3 cm long; bracts ovate, acuminate, shorter than or subequal to the ovaries, 1-veined, entire, pubescent on the dorsal side, 7–10 by 4–6 mm. Flowers resupinate, mainly green with white labellum. Sepals pubescent on the dorsal side, 1-veined; dorsal sepal narrowly ovate, acuminate to subacute, 6.2–6.5 by 2.8–3.2 mm; lateral sepals free, obliquely ovate-oblong, obtuse, 6.8–8.5 by 3.5–4.1 mm. Labellum straight (i.e., not twisted), 9.2–11 mm long along the mid-line; sac of hypochile straight, indented along the mid-line, containing a low median keel and 1 compressed falcate appendage on either side; mesochile with one pair of erose-dentate to somewhat pectinate flanges; epichile deeply bilobed, with the slightly erose-dentate (to entire) lobules 5.6–7.6 mm long, 1.1–1.6 times as long as wide, describing an acute angle to each other. Column 3–3.9 mm long; anther acuminate in front, 3.2–3.6 mm long. Ovary 6.8–10 mm long, glabrous. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 8–14 cm tall, sometimes branched. Foliage leaves 3–6, more or less concentrated on the middle to lower part of the stem, green; lamina obliquely (ovate-)lanceolate, acute to subacuminate, mucronate, 2–5.2 by 0.9–2.1 cm. Inflorescence (glandular-)pubescent, 2 to 6-flowered; rachis 0.9–4.2 cm long; bracts ovate, acuminate, shorter than the ovaries, 3-veined, subentire, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, ca. 8 by ca. 4 mm. Flowers resupinate, mainly green with white labellum. Sepals glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 1-veined; dorsal sepal ovate, obtuse, ca. 6 by ca. 3 mm; lateral sepals free, obliquely lanceolate-oblong, obtuse, ca. 8.1 by ca. 2.8 mm. description: Flowering shoots 8–30 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–7, crowded on the lower part of the stem, reddish brown (to blackish-green) above, paler underneath; lamina obliquely (ovate-)elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, acute to acuminate, mucronate, 1.5–5.6 by 0.9–2.3 cm. Inflorescence (glandular-)pubescent, 1- to 4-flowered; rachis up to 4.5 cm long; bracts ovate to lanceolate, acuminate, shorter than to longer than the ovaries, 1- to 3-veined, entire, (glandular-)pubescent on the dorsal side, 8.5–11.6 by 4.8–6.4 mm. Flowers (non-)resupinate, mainly green (petals and labellum white with brown to deep red marks on the mesochile). Sepals (glandular-)pubescent on the dorsal side, 1- to 3-veined; dorsal sepal ovate, rounded to subacute, 5.7–8.3 by 3.7–4.8 mm; lateral sepals free, falcately elliptic to obliquely (linear-)oblong, rounded to subacute, 9.3–14 by 3.4–5.2 mm. Petals very obliquely (rhomboid-)obovate, subacuminate. 5.8–8 by 3.5–4.4 mm. Labellum straight (i.e., not twisted), 11.8–13.5 mm long along the mid-line; sac of hypochile straight, sometimes indented along the mid-line, containing a low median keel and 1 retuse to bilobed appendage on either side; mesochile with one pair of dentate-pectinate to laciniate flanges: epichile deeply bilobed, with the subentire to slightly erose lobules 7–14.5 mm long, 1.3–2.2 times as long as wide, describing an obtuse to acute angle to each other. Column 3–4.5 mm long; anther subacute to acuminate in front, 3–4.2 mm long. Ovary 7–15.5 mm long, (glandular-)pubescent. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 13–40 cm tall. Foliage leaves (3–)5–7, scattered on the stem or somewhat crowded at the middle, green with white reticulation above; lamina broadly lanceolate to ovate or narrowly elliptic, oblique, acute to acuminate, (2–)3.5–10.5 by (1–)1.7–4 cm. Inflorescence pubescent, 4- to many-flowered; rachis 3–12 cm long; bracts triangular-lanceolate to ovate, acute to acuminate, longer than the ovaries, 1-veined (rarely 3-veined), finely erose ciliate (at least at base), otherwise glabrous, 8.5–17.3 by 3.2–8.8 mm. Flowers resupinate, mainly pale green to brownish with yellow labellum and pink anther. Sepals glabrous, 1-veined; dorsal sepal ovate, obtuse, 4.5–5.1 by 3.3–3.6 mm; lateral sepals connate at base, obliquely to falcately elliptic-oblong, obtuse to subacuminate, 6.6–8 by 3.6–4.1 mm. Petals very obliquely ovate, subacuminate, 5.1–6 by 2.4–3.2 mm. Labellum straight (i.e., not twisted), 7.7–12.5 mm long along the mid-line; sac of hypochile straight, indented along the mid-line, containing a low median keel and 1 subterete, straight to distally hooked appendage on either side; mesochile with one pair of dentate-pectinate flanges; epichile deeply bilobed, with the entire lobules 3.7–8.1 mm long, 1.1–1.8 times as long as wide, describing an acute (to right) angle to each other. Column 1–3 mm long; anther acuminate-caudate in front, ca. 4.2 mm long. Ovary 5–11 mm long, glabrous. Capsule erect, ellipsoid-fusiform, 10–12 mm long, 3–5 mm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 5–15 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–8, scattered on the stem, very dark greenish-brown with green spots above, pale greenish-brown underneath; lamina ovate to lanceolate, acute to acuminate, often mucronate, 1.3–2.6 by 0.6–1.1 cm. Inflorescence glabrous, 1- to 2-flowered; rachis up to 0.7 cm long; bracts (linear-)lanceolate, acuminate, subequal to the ovaries. 1-veined, entire, glabrous, 11–12 by 2–5 mm. Flowers resupinate, mainly pink with pale yellow petals and labellum. Sepals glabrous, 1-veined: dorsal sepal linear-lanceolate, subacuminate, 13–16 by 3.3–4 mm; lateral sepals connate at base, obliquely triangular-lanceolate to falcately linear-lanceolate, acute to rounded, 14.5–18 by 3.9–4.5 mm. Petals very obliquely obovate, caudate, 14.6–16 by 3.5–4 mm. Labellum straight (i.e., not twisted), 17–19 mm long along the mid-line; sac of hypochile straight, not indented along the mid-line, containing 1 sessile, oblongoid to somewhat compressed appendage on either side; mesochile with one pair of entire (to slightly dentate) flanges; epichile obreniform to broadly obovate with more or less upcurved sides, 5–7.2 mm long, 0.9–1.3 times as wide as long, retuse to rounded, with more or less crenulate-undulate hind margins. Column 9–10 mm long; anther acuminate in front, 8.5–9.5 mm long. Ovary 8–17 mm long, glabrous. Capsule not seen.

description: Plant mycoheterotrophic, all leaves reduced to sheaths. Flowering shoots 8.3–19 cm tall; vegetative parts bright red. Inflorescence finely papillose-pubescent, 5- to 15-flowered; rachis 2.8–9.5 cm long; bracts (triangular-)ovate, obtuse to subacute, shorter than or subequal to the ovaries, 1-veined, erose-ciliate, finely papillose-pubescent on the dorsal side, 8.5–11.6 by 4.6–9.3 mm. Flowers non-resupinate or nearly so, predominantly bright red (labellum yellow tinged with red). Sepals sparsely pubescent on the dorsal side, l-veined; dorsal sepal ovate, obtuse to rounded, 5.9–6.2 by 3.1–4.1 mm; lateral sepals free, broadly and falcately ovate to elliptic oblong, rounded to obtuse, 7.4–9.3 by 4.5–5.1 mm. Petals falcately linear-lanceolate, obtuse, 6.4–7 by 1.1–1.9 mm. Labellum straight (i.e., not twisted), 11–15 mm long along the mid-line; sac of hypochile straight, not indented along the mid-line, devoid of ornaments or with 1 fleshy papilla-like appendage on either side; mesochile with one pair of (pectinate-)erose flanges: epichile dentate-laciniate, in front with a deep V-shaped incision framed by a pair of particularly long laciniae. Column 2–4 mm long; anther long-acuminate and recurved in front, 3.5–3.8 mm long. Ovary 8.4–12.2 mm long, papillose-pubescent. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 9–30 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–8, scattered on the stem, green above, pale light green underneath; lamina obliquely (obovate-)elliptic to ovate-lanceolate, acute to acuminate, sometimes mucronate, 1.6–10.8 by 0.9–5.9 cm. Inflorescence glandular-pubescent, (2–)5- to many-flowered; rachis (2–)5–12.9 cm long; bracts lanceolate, acuminate, shorter than or subequal to the ovaries, 3-veined, entire, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 9.6–15 by 3–5 mm. Flowers resupinate, mainly (yellowish-)green with white to cream labellum and pale brown anther. Sepals glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, l-veined; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, ovate-lanceolate, obtuse, 6.6–8.5 by 3.1–4.7 mm; lateral sepals free, obliquely linear-oblong, obtuse to subacute, 9.1–11 by 3.4–4.7 mm. Petals falcately and very obliquely oblong-(ob) lanceolate, subacuminate to obtuse, 6.7–8.8 by 2.2–3.3 mm. Labellum twisted, 8.9–13.6 mm long along the mid-line: sac of hypochile straight, not or only obscurely indented along the mid line, containing 1 compressed subpalmate appendage on either side (and sometimes a vestigial median keel); mesochile with one pair of pectinate flanges; epichile twisted, deeply bilobed, with the (sub)entire lobules 7–8 mm long, 1.7–2.3 times as long as wide, describing an acute angle to each other. Column 2–5 mm long: anther acuminate in front, 3.1–3.5 mm long. Ovary 9–12 mm long, sparsely pubescent. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 4–15 cm long. Foliage leaves 4–11, scattered along the stem, purplish green; lamina ovate (to lanceolate), acute, mucronate, 0.3–0.7 by 0.2–0.4 cm. Inflorescence pubescent, 1- to 3-flowered; rachis up to 0.7 cm long; bracts (ovate-)lanceolate, acuminate, subequal to the ovaries, 3-veined, subentire, ciliate, otherwise glabrous, 6–8 by 2.2–3 mm. Flowers resupinate, mainly white to pale pink with white labellum and green mentum. Sepals glabrous, 1-veined; dorsal sepal somewhat boat-shaped, lanceolate, obtuse, ca. 6 by ca. 2.2 mm; lateral sepals connate at base, somewhat boat-shaped, obliquely linear-lanceolate, acute, 6.9–7 by ca. 1.8 mm. Petals obliquely oblanceolate, subacuminate, ca. 5.2 by ca. 1.2 mm. Labellum straight (i.e., not twisted), 8.1–11 mm long along the mid-line; sac of hypochile with upturned apex, indented along the mid-line, containing a low median keel and 1 sessile oblong obtuse fleshy appendage on either side; mesochile with one pair of dentate flanges; epichile transversely oblong, about twice as wide as long, apiculate, entire. Column ca. 2 mm long; anther acuminate in front, ca. 1.6 mm long. Ovary 5.3–5.6 mm long, glabrous. Capsule not seen.

description: Small to large terrestrial, lithophytic or epiphytic herbs with elongate, fibrous roots arising from a short to elongate rhizome; erect shoots leafy, clustered or less frequently well spaced. Leaves one to several, coriaceous, conduplicate, spreading or suberect, ligulate, elliptic, or oblong, obtuse to acute, often tridenticulate at apex, green or tessellated with dark and lighter green on upper surface, lighter green below, more or less ciliate. Inflorescence terminal, one-to many-flowered; rachis terete, hairy, glandular or glabrous; bracts conduplicate, green, sometimes spotted or flushed or striped with purple. Flowers deciduous, usually showy; pedicel short. Dorsal sepal erect to hooded over lip, entire, glabrous or pubescent. Lateral sepals fused to form a concave, entire synsepal. Petals free, spreading or pendent, flat, reflexed or spiralling, often pubescent in basal half within, usually ciliate. Labellum deeply slipper-shaped or urn shaped, with more or less pronounced incurved side lobes, hairy within especially towards the base, glabrous or hairy on outer surface. Column short, porrect; anthers two, bilocular, borne on short filaments; pollen powdery or viscid: staminode terminal on column, sessile or shortly stalked, transversely reniform, oblong, ovate, obcordate or linear, flat, convex or longitudinally conduplicate, glabrous to papillose or finely pubescent; stigma stalked, dependent, tripartite, more or less papillose. Fruit an erect to pendent capsule, three-ribbed, cylindrical to almost ellipsoidal.</br></br>A genus of ca. 75 species ranging from southern India, Nepal, NE India and Myanmar across to southern China to Hong Kong, SE Asia, the Malay archipelago, the Philippines, New Guinea and the Solomon Islands; 14 species in Thailand.

description: A terrestrial herb. Leaves 5–8, narrowly elliptic to oblong-elliptic, subacute to obtuse at tridenticulate apex, 7–25 cm long, 2–4 cm wide, sparsely ciliate at base, obscurely tessellated pale and darker green, more or less purple-marked at base on lower side. Inflorescence erect, 1-flowered (rarely 2-flowered): peduncle 17–48 cm long, purple, shortly pubescent; bract lanceolate, acute, 1.5–2.1 cm long, green, ciliate. Flower 6–10 cm across; sepals whitish-green or pale green, longitudinally veined with green; dorsal sepal faintly purple-tinged towards base; petals green below with darker green and brown stripes and maroon-black spots in basal half, purple above; labellum ochre to pale purple with darker veins and a yellowish or greenish margin; pedicel and ovary 3–6 cm long, pubescent. Dorsal sepal ovate, cordate at base, apiculate above, 2.7–4.5 cm long, 2–3.2 cm wide, with recurved basal margins. Synsepal elliptic-lanceolate, acuminate, 2–3 cm long, 1.1–1.5 cm wide. Petals spathulate, acute or tridenticulate at apex, 4.4–5.8 cm long, 1.2–1.8 cm wide, half-twisted in apical half, with marginal warts in basal part of upper margin. Labellum 3.6–4.6 cm long; front margin obliquely bluntly dentate. Staminode transversely elliptic, tridentate at apex, 7–9 mm long, 8–9 mm wide; lateral teeth falcate, divergent, longer than middle tooth.

description: A terrestrial herb, usually of clustered growth. Leaves 4–5, oblong-elliptic, rounded and minutely emarginate at apex, usually up to 14 cm long, 5 cm wide, very dark green, mottled with pale green above, heavily purple-spotted below. Inflorescence 1-flowered (rarely 2-flowered), very short, usually arcuate; peduncle 2–4.5 cm long, arcuate, white-pubescent, purple or green, mottled maroon; bract conduplicate, elliptic-ovate, acute to obtuse, 23–27 mm long, 15–25 mm wide, pubescent, pale green, spotted purple. Flower subcampanulate, large for size of plant, about 5.5–8 cm in diameter, white or creamy yellow, usually heavily spotted on all segments with large maroon spots, shortly pubescent on outside; ovary about 3 cm long, green, spotted dull maroon. Dorsal sepal concave, broadly transversely elliptic to broadly ovate, obtuse to retuse, 2.7–4 cm long. 3.3–5.6 cm wide. Synsepal deeply concave, cordate, obtuse to rounded at apex, 2–3.1 cm long, 2.2–3.3 cm broad. Petals somewhat concave, broadly elliptic, rounded at apex, 4.5–6.3 cm long, 2.7–5.3 cm wide. Labellum narrowly ovoid to ellipsoidal, 2.5–4.2 cm long, 1.5–2 cm wide, all margins strongly incurved. Staminode subquadrate-obcordate, with a short apical tooth, 8–11 mm long, 8–9 mm wide.

description: A terrestrial herb. Leaves 3–5, narrowly elliptic, oblong-elliptic or obovate, tridenticulate at acute apex, 10–20 cm long, 3.2–4.8 cm wide, ciliate at base, tessellated pale and dark above, sometimes purple at base on lower surface. Inflorescence 1-flowered (rarely 2-flowered), 20–40 cm tall; peduncle purple, purple-pubescent, 12–25 cm long; bract ovate to elliptic, acute to subacute, 1.5–2.8 cm long, 1.5–2 cm wide, green, sometimes marked with purple, ciliate. Flower large, 8–11 cm across; sepals white flushed with purple in lower half, veined with purple and green; petals white to yellow-green with a purple apical third, spotted with maroon on upper margin and sometimes in basal half; labellum green, heavily flushed deep maroon; staminode pale green with darker veins, flushed purple; pedicel and ovary 3–6.5 cm long, green, flushed with purple, purple-pubescent. Dorsal sepal broadly ovate to subcircular, apiculate, 4–5.5 cm long, 4.2–6 cm wide, with recurved ciliate margins. Synsepal concave, elliptic or lanceolate, acute, 2.7–3.2 cm long, 1.6–2.5 cm wide. Petals sometimes reflexed, subsigmoid, ligulate, obtuse or rounded at apex, 4.6–6.8 cm long, 1.2–1.8 cm wide, maroon-ciliate. Labellum 2.5–4.4 cm long, 2–2.5 cm wide, warty on incurved side lobes. Staminode lunate, 11 mm long, 7 mm wide, apical lateral teeth falcate, acute to obtuse.

description: A terrestrial herb. Leaves oblong-elliptic or linear-oblong, acute and tridenticulate at apex, up to 15 cm long, 2.8 cm wide, green above, spotted purple near base below. Inflorescence 1-flowered; peduncle 8–15 cm long, shortly pubescent, pale green, heavily spotted maroon; bract obovate, very obtuse, 2.9–3.2 cm long, 1.4–2 cm wide, pale green, spotted deep maroon, ciliate. Flower up to 8 cm across; dorsal sepal pink with darker veins or rarely white; petals pale yellow green with brown, reticulate venation; labellum pinkish-brown with darker veins, staminode white; pedicel and ovary 2.8–3.9 cm long, with maroon hairs, pale green, spotted dark maroon. Dorsal sepal transversely elliptic to circular, obtuse, 4.4–5.7 cm long, 4.7–6.6 cm wide, sides spreading or reflexed, finely pubescent on outer surface. Synsepal much smaller, elliptic, subacute, 3.8–4 cm long, 2–2.8 cm wide, pale yellow, flecked and veined pale purple, finely pubescent without. Petals spreading, more or less horizontal, slightly incurved, ligulate-spathulate, obtuse, 4–4.4 cm long, 1–1.6 cm wide, slightly ciliate towards apex. Labellum with a wide mouth to sack, 3.8–4.3 cm long, 2.6–2.7 cm wide, very hairy within. Staminode obovate, 9–10 mm long, 10 mm wide, glabrous, with a central raised yellowish boss.

description: A terrestrial herb of clustered growth. Leaves 4–6, oblong to elliptic-oblong, rounded and minutely emarginate at apex, up to 14 cm long, 4 cm wide, upper surface tessellated dark and pale green, finely purple-spotted on lower surface. Inflorescence 1- to 2-flowered (rarely 3-flowered); peduncle up to 8 cm long, finely white-pubescent, purple or green, heavily spotted purple; bracts ovate, 1–1.5 cm long, 1–1.6 cm wide, pubescent, green, spotted purple. Flowers large, pubescent, 5.5–7 cm in diameter, yellow, rarely ivory or white, finely spotted all over with purple; ovary 3–5 cm long, pubescent, dull purple or green, spotted purple. Dorsal sepal broadly obovate, obtuse to emarginate, 2.5–3.7 cm long, 2.5–3.5 cm wide. Synsepal concave, elliptic to ovate, obtuse to retuse, 2.1–3.5 cm long, 2.1–3.1 cm wide. Petals elliptic, rounded at apex, 3.5–4.5 cm long, 2.3–2.7 cm wide. Labellum ellipsoidal, very fleshy, with incurved margins, 3–3.8 cm long, 1.3–1.8 cm wide. Staminode shortly trullate to subtriangular, toothed to subacute at apex, minutely ciliate, 10–13 mm long, 10–12 mm wide.

description: Aterrestrial or lithophytic herb. Leaves suberect, 4–5, linear, obtuse to rounded at unequally bilobulate apex, up to 35 cm long, 1.8–3 cm wide, yellowish-green. Inflorescence 1-flowered; peduncle 13–18 cm long, slender, green, shortly purple-pubescent; bract narrowly elliptic to elliptic, obtuse, 4–4.4 cm long, 2–2.4 cm wide, green to yellow-green. Flower ca. 6.5 cm across; dorsal sepal white, with raised maroon spots on yellow central half; synsepal pale yellow-green with darker veins; petals glossy, pale buff-yellow with darker veins; labellum glossy, buff with darker veins, pedicel and ovary yellow-green, pubescent, 2.2–4 cm long. Dorsal sepal ovate elliptic, obtuse, 3–4.8 cm long, 2.8–3 cm wide, pubescent on outer surface. Synsepal oblong elliptic, obtuse, 3.4–4.7 cm long, 1.6–2.5 cm wide. Petals incurved, subhorizontal, oblanceolate to narrowly oblong, obtuse, 4.3–5 cm long, 1.4–1.7 cm wide, ciliate, purple-pubescent at base, margins undulate. Labellum 3–3.5 cm long, 1.9 cm wide. Staminode obovate, obtuse to rarely retuse, 6–8 mm long, 7–9 mm wide, with a central glossy boss.

description: A terrestrial or lithophytic herb of clustered growth. Leaves 4–6. oblong-elliptic, retuse at the obtuse apex, up to 14 cm long, 2.9 cm wide, sparsely ciliate on basal margins, tessellated dark and pale green above, usually purple-spotted below. Inflorescence 1- to 2-flowered, erect; peduncle 4–8 cm long, purple, very shortly pubescent; bract conduplicate, ovate, subacute, 1.5 cm long, purple, shortly pubescent. Flowers large, white or ivory-white, usually spotted with purple on all segments, ca. 4.6–9 cm across; ovary 4 cm long, pubescent, purple. Dorsal sepal concave, broadly ovate, obtuse or rounded, 2.5–4.6 cm long, 2–4.6 cm wide. Synsepal ovate, obtuse, 2–4.5 cm long, 1.7–4 cm wide. Petals oblong-elliptic, rounded to retuse at apex, 3.5–5.9 cm long, 2–4 cm wide, margins often undulate and somewhat recurved. Labellum ellipsoidal, 2.5–4.2 cm long, 16–2 cm wide, margins strongly incurved. Staminode transversely elliptic, one-to three-toothed on apical margin, 7 mm long, 9–11 mm wide, pubescent and ciliate.

description: A terrestrial or rarely epiphytic herb. Leaves 5–6, linear-ligulate, obtuse at obliquely bilobed apex, up to 45 cm long, 1.5–2 cm wide, green, more or less spotted with purple on lower surface. Inflorescence 1-flowered; peduncle 17–25 cm long, shortly purple-pubescent, subtended at base by a sheath up to 11 cm long; bract elliptic, subacute to obtuse, 1.5–2.8 cm long, pubescent. Flower 13–16 cm across; sepals pale yellow to pale green, heavily suffused with glossy dark brown almost to margins; petals pale yellow, spotted purple-brown in lower half, flushed rose-purple in apical half; labellum pale yellow to pale green, spotted with rose-purple; staminode pale yellow, purple-spotted towards base, glossy dark brown towards middle; pedicel and ovary 5–7.5 cm long, shortly purple-pubescent. Dorsal sepal ovate-elliptic, obtuse to emarginate, 4.2–5.2 cm long, 3.4–4.5 cm wide, with undulate margins, ciliate. Synsepal similar, 4.2–4.5 cm long, 2.9–4 cm wide. Petals horizontal to deflexed, spathulate, rounded at apex, 6.9–8 cm long, 2.1–3 cm wide, half twisted towards apex, strongly undulate on basal margins, pubescent, ciliate. Labellum 3.8–5.2 cm long, 1.5–2.8 cm wide. Staminode subquadrate, obtuse, convex, 10 mm long, 8 mm wide.

description: Terrestrial herb, often of clustered growth. Leaves 4–5, strap-shaped to narrowly elliptic, rounded and minutely emarginate at apex, 8–19 cm long, 2.4–3.6 cm wide, mottled very dark and pale green above, heavily dotted purple below, ciliate at the base. Inflorescence 1- or 2-flowered, 6–25 cm long; peduncle up to 20 cm long, purple, shortly but densely white pubescent; bracts conduplicate, broadly ovate, obtuse. 1.1–1.4 cm long, 1–1.2 cm wide, white to pale green, spotted purple. Flowers white, often highly dotted purple towards base of segments and on front of labellum, with a yellow centre to the staminode. 6–8 cm diameter, pubescent on outside and at base of petals within, ovary 4.5 cm long, green flushed with dark purple, densely shortly pubescent. Dorsal sepal very broadly ovate, obtuse to emarginate, 2.7–4.2 cm long, 3–5 cm wide. Synsepal concave, ovate, obtuse, 2–3 cm long, 1.5–3 cm wide. Petals elliptic, rounded, 3.3–4.3 cm long. 2.2–3.9 cm wide, shortly ciliate on margins. Labellum rather small, ovoid to ellipsoidal, with incurved margins, 2.2–3.6 cm long, 1.5–1.8 cm wide. Staminode broader than long, transversely subelliptic, one-to three-toothed at apex, 6–9 mm long, 10–12 mm wide.

description: An epiphytic or occasionally lithophytic herb. Leaves 5–8, ligulate, rounded at asymmetric apex, up to 45 cm long, 4–7.5 cm wide, green. Inflorescence arcuate to suberect, 30–50 cm long, 3- to 9-flowered (rarely 2-flowered); peduncle densely pubescent, 20–26 cm long, pale green, white-pubescent; bracts large, conduplicate, broadly elliptic, obtuse to subapiculate, 3–4 cm long, 2–3.5 cm wide, margins undulate. Flowers 9–10.5 cm across, up to 13.5 cm long; sepals cream to green with darker veins: petals green below and spotted with blackish-maroon, dark maroon on margins and in apical half; labellum yellow-green to green or purplish flushed; pedicel and ovary 5 cm long, green, pubescent. Dorsal sepal elliptic, obtuse, 3.5–5.2 cm long, 1.8–3.5 cm wide, basal margins recurved, apical margins incurved. Synsepal ovate, acute, 2.6–4.1 cm long, 1.5–3.5 cm wide, with recurved margins, 2-keeled on outer surface. Petals decurved-pendent, linear-tapering, rounded at apex, 7–11.2 cm long, 0.6–1.6 cm wide, spirally twisted in apical half; basal margins undulate, maroon spots on lower basal margin, with cilia in distinct dense tufts. Labellum tapering to rather narrow apex, 3–4.5 cm long, 1.5–2.3 cm wide. Staminode obcordate, 11–14 mm long, 7–9 mm wide, umbonate at base, cream with dark green venation.

description: A terrestrial herb with thick pubescent roots. Leaves 3–4, narrowly oblong-elliptic, acute at tridenticulate apex, up to 13 cm long, 3–4.5 cm broad, tessellated dark green and yellow-green above. Inflorescence 1-flowered; scape purple, covered with fine white hairs; bract lanceolate, acute, 1.8–2 cm long, 0.9 cm broad, green, pubescent. Flower 11–14.3 cm across; ovary and pedicel 3.5–6 cm long, green, pubescent. Dorsal sepal concave, ovate, acuminate, 3.8–5.4 cm long, 2.6–4.4 cm broad, ciliate, pubescent on outside, white, veined with green and spotted purple at base. Synsepal lanceolate, acuminate, 3.4–4.2 cm long, 1.6–2.6 cm broad, similar in coloration and indumentum to dorsal. Petals subhorizontal, oblong-ligulate to oblanceolate, acute, 5.4–7.3 cm long, 1.5–2.4 cm broad, green heavily spotted with maroon, margins ciliate. Labellum saccate. 4.8–6.1 cm long, 2.3–3.2 cm broad, green heavily flushed and veined maroon, warty on side lobes. Column pale green, 5 mm long. Staminode with a tridentate lower margin with incurved acute lateral teeth, 8 mm tall, 11 mm broad, pubescent.

description: A terrestrial herb, often of clustered growth. Leaves 3–5, narrowly elliptic to oblong rounded and minutely tridentate at apex, 3.5–9.5 cm long, 1–2.4 cm wide, mottled very dark and pale green above, heavily mottled purple below, ciliate at the base. Inflorescence 1-flowered (rarely 2-flowered), 6–17(–23) cm long; peduncle 4–15 cm long, purple, shortly but densely white-pubescent; bracts conduplicate, broadly ovate, obtuse, 7–8 mm long, 3.5–3.9 mm wide, pale green, spotted purple. Flowers 3.3–4.2 cm in diameter, white, often highly dotted purple towards base of segments and on front of labellum, with a yellow or yellow-green centre to the staminode, pubescent on outside and at base of petals within; ovary 3.5–5.6 cm long, green flushed with dark purple, densely shortly pubescent. Dorsal sepal very broadly ovate, obtuse, 1.7–2.1 cm long, 1.8–2.2 cm wide. Synsepal concave, ovate, obtuse, 1.3–1.8 cm long, 0.8–1.6 cm wide. Petals elliptic, rounded, 2.2–2.6 cm long, 1.4–1.5 cm wide, shortly ciliate on margins. Labellum rather small, ovoid to ellipsoidal, with incurved margins, 2–2.1 cm long, 1–1.4 cm wide. Staminode shortly trullate to transversely subelliptic, one-to three-toothed at apex, 5.5–7.7 mm long, 7.2–8.3 mm wide.
