description: A terrestrial herb. Leaves suberect, 4–6, linear, obtuse to rounded at unequally bilobulate apex, 10–35 cm long, 1.2–1.5 cm wide, green, intensely purple spotted towards the base beneath. Inflorescence 1-flowered; peduncle 16–20 cm long, slender, green, purple-spotted; bract narrowly elliptic to elliptic, obtuse, 4–4.4 cm long, 2–2.4 cm wide, green to yellow-green, heavily spotted with dark purple. Flower 6.8–7.5 cm in diameter; dorsal sepal white, with the centre flushed red-brown, yellow at the base; synsepal pale yellow-green with darker veins: petals glossy, pale buff-brown with darker veins; labellum glossy, buff with darker veins, pedicel and ovary green, pubescent, 2.2–4 cm long. Dorsal sepal ovate-elliptic, obtuse, 3.8–4.2 cm long, 2.8–3.2 cm wide, pubescent on outer surface. Synsepal oblong-elliptic, obtuse, 1.8–2.3 cm long, 1–1.5 cm wide. Petals incurved, subhorizontal, oblanceolate, rounded at apex, 3.5–3.6 cm long, 0.7–0.9 cm wide, ciliate, purple-pubescent at base, upper margins strongly undulate. Labellum 2.8–3.2 cm long, 1.4–1.6 cm wide. Staminode obovate, obtuse to rarely retuse, 10 mm long, 6 mm wide, with a glossy boss two thirds of the way.

description: An epiphytic or rarely lithophytic herb, often forming clumps. Leaves 4–5, linear-ligulate, acuminate to acute at unequally bilobulate apex, 14–42 cm long, 2.5–4 cm wide, mid-green on undersurface, purple-spotted at the base, basal margins ciliate. Inflorescence suberect to arcuate, 1-flowered; peduncle 7–24 cm long, green, often spotted purple, with long villose purple hairs; bract elliptic, obtuse, 3.7–6.5 cm long, 3–3.8 cm wide, green, spotted with maroon, glabrous. Flower 7.5–13.5 cm across; dorsal sepal green with a white margin and central glossy deep maroon areas; synsepal pale green; petals glossy reddish brown with a central maroon stripe; labellum ochre, flushed with pink or reddish; staminode yellow, with a yellow or green central knob; pedicel and ovary triangular in cross-section, 3–6 cm long, ochre-coloured, densely covered with purple villose hairs. Dorsal sepal obovate, obtuse, 4.5–7 cm long, 3–4.6 cm wide, with reflexed basal margins. Synsepal adpressed to ovary, ovate, subacute, 3.8–7.6 cm long, 1.8–2.6 cm wide. Petals incurved, obovate-spathulate, retuse-emarginate, rounded at apex, 4.7–8.6 cm long, 2.5–4.6 cm wide, glossy, ciliate, purple-villose at base. Labellum tapering to apex, 4–6.8 cm long, 3–3.8 cm wide. Staminode obcordate-obovate, truncate, ca. 16 mm long, 14 mm wide, verrucose, hirsute, with a central glossy wart-like boss.

description: Terrestrial herbs with underground tubers. Flowering shoots 10–120 cm tall; stem glabrous. Foliage leaves (1–)2–14, sessile, sheathing at base, scattered along the stem or crowded at its base; upper part of stem sometimes carrying 1–5 small non-sheathing leaves. Inflorescence racemose; bracts much smaller than the foliage leaves, boat-shaped, acuminate, glabrous, at least those in the distal part of the inflorescence shorter than the flowers. Flowers 1–17, resupinate, predominantly white to pale yellowish-green, more or less fragrant. Sepals plain (i.e. not saccate), glabrous, dorsal sepal 7–30 mm long. Petals recurved or suberect. Labellum narrowly attached to the column, ovate to deeply 3-lobed to irregularly flabellate, smooth on the ventral side, spurred at base; spur longer than the labellum lamina, not constricted at base. Column complanate, with a flat to slightly concave stigma consisting of two hardly coherent lobes; distal part of rostellum broad; viscidia 2, naked; anther firmly attached, thecae basally extending from the column together with the lateral parts of the rostellum; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous. Fruit not seen.</br></br>A genus of ca. 7 species distributed in mainland Southeast Asia south of a line from the southern Himalayas to Japan, and in Indonesia (except Kalimantan and Papua); 3 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 10–30 cm tall. Foliage leaves (1–)2–6, crowded on (and increasing in size towards) the base of the stem, fleshy, widely spreading, (ovate- elliptic (to broadly lanceolate), subacuminate (to rounded), mucronate, (2.2–)3.2–15 by 1–9 cm. Inflorescence fairly dense, 2- to 17-flowered; rachis (0.5–)2–17 cm long; bracts narrowly lanceolate, 11–64 by 2.5–12 mm. Flowers white with yellowish-green spur apex and a small to large yellow blotch on the labellum. Sepals (sub)acuminate, mucronate, 3-veined from the base; dorsal sepal elliptic to ovate, 15.1–24 by 10.5–14.5 mm; lateral sepals twisted, narrowly and obliquely (oblong-) ovate, less than twice as long as the petals, 18.6–27 by 7.1–9.5 mm. Petals somewhat recurved, obliquely (oblong-)lanceolate, more than half as wide as the lateral sepals, acuminate to acute, 3-veined from the base, 17–21 by 5.7–9 mm. Labellum ovate to obscurely three-lobed with entire margins, acute to obtuse, 18.8–24 by 13.5–20 mm, devoid of ornaments, spur cylindric to subclavate, 36–44 mm long. Column 7–10 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 14–28 mm long, provided with minutely erose-dentate (to subentire) longitudinal keels.

description: Flowering shoots (32–)45–98 cm tall. Foliage leaves (6–)9–14, scattered along the stem, erect (above) to spreading (below), lanceolate-oblong to (linear-)lanceolate, acute, mucronate, (3–)4.5–17 by 0.8–3 cm. Inflorescence lax, 2- to 4-flowered (rarely 5-flowered); rachis 2–4(–8.5) cm long; bracts (narrowly) lanceolate, (27–)30–79 by 7–14 mm. Flowers white. Sepals rounded to subacute, 5- to 9-veined from the base; dorsal sepal broadly (obovate-helliptic, 16.7–19.5 by 15–17.1 mm; lateral sepals obliquely to falcately (elliptic-)ovate, less than twice as long as the petals, 18.6–22.7 by 12.1–14 mm. Petals recurved, falcately linear, much narrower than the lateral sepals, (sub)acute, 2- to 3-veined from the base, 16.6–21 by 2.2–3.1 mm. Labellum deeply three-lobed, with a tiny conical callus at base; midlobe linear, entire, 15.6–21.5 by (2–)3.1–3.6 mm; side lobes obliquely flabellate, laciniate, 17.4-21 by 12–15.1 mm; spur cylindric, 87–120 mm long. Column 7.2–8.3 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 27–40.5 mm long, provided with (sub)entire longitudinal keels.

description: Flowering shoots (18–)38–120 cm tall. Foliage leaves 6–10(–13), scattered along the stem, erect (above) to somewhat spreading (below), (ob)lanceolate-oblong to (ob)ovate-oblong, acute to obtuse, mucronate, 4–15 by 1.8–7 cm. Inflorescence lax, 2- to 5-flowered (rarely up to 10-flowered); rachis 1.6–13(–21.5) cm long; bracts (ovate-)lanceolate, 35–85 by 11.5–23 mm. Flowers white to pale yellowish-green. Sepals rounded to subacute, 7-veined from the base; dorsal sepal suborbicular (to broadly elliptic), (20–)25–30 by (17–)25–31 mm; lateral sepals broadly and falcately ovate, more than twice as long as the petals, (20–)28–35 by (15–)22–28 mm. Petals suberect, falcately linear-triangular, much narrower than the lateral sepals, subacute, 1-veined from the base, 7–13 by 2–3 mm. Labellum deeply three-lobed, devoid of ornaments; midlobe linear to oblong (sometimes slightly spathulate), entire, 30–45 by 5–9.5 mm; side lobes obliquely flabellate, laciniate, 20–35 by 20–30 mm; spur cylindric, 70–155 mm long. Column 9–13 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 25–60 mm long, provided with finely erose-dentate (very rarely subentire) longitudinal keels.

description: Terrestrial, deciduous, tuberous herbs, glabrous in the Flora area. Flowering shoots 12–60(–108) cm tall, unbranched. Foliage leaves one to several, basal or cauline and scattered along the stem or clustered in its middle, lanceolate, ovate or oblong, sessile. Usually with one to several erect, suberect or spreading sterile bracts above the foliage leaves, their margins sometimes glandular-papillose or shortly hairy. Inflorescence terminal, racemose; floral bracts lanceolate, margins sometimes shortly hairy. Flowers few to many, resupinate, small to medium sized, mostly with greenish, yellowish or whitish colours. Sepals free; dorsal sepal erect, usually forming a hood with the petals. Petals unlobed. Labellum 3-lobed or rarely entire, spur short or rarely long, cylindric, clavate, fusiform or globular, usually with a constriction at the base. Column short, anther canals absent or very short, pollinia 2, sectile: stigmas short or long, connate with or adpressed to the labellum base; central rostellum lobe insignificant. Ovary glabrous or papillose, normally not distinct from the pedicel.</br></br>A genus of ca. 105 species widely distributed from the Mascarenes through tropical and subtropical Asia to the Pacific; 17 species in Thailand.</br></br>Notes: A more comprehensive version of this account was published in Nord. J. Bot. 28: 21–46. 2010.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 14–38 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–3, cauline, clustered or scattered in the stem middle, elliptic-ovate, acute, mucronate, (2–)3–5 by 1.1–1.7 cm; stem below the foliage leaves with 2–3 tubular leaves. Sterile bracts 1–3, spreading or suberect, lanceolate, acuminate, 0.9–2.3 cm long. Petals erect, obliquely ovate-elliptic, acute, 2.5–2.8 by 1.3–1.7 mim. Column 0.8–1 mm long; stigmas clavate and connate with the labellum, ca. 1.3 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 4.6–5.3 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 7.5–16 cm tall, slender. Foliage leaves 2–3, cauline and scattered along the stem, lanceolate-linear, acute, mucronate, 2.5–6.2 by 0.4–0.6 cm. Column ca. 0.8 mm long; anther loculi parallel; stigmas ca. 0.25 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 2.8–4 mm long, smooth or with obtuse ridges. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 29–60(–81) cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–5, cauline, clustered in the stem middle, elliptic-ovate to elliptic-oblong, subacute or acute, 4–13(–16) by 2.3–5.5(–6.5) cm; stem below the foliage leaves with 2–4 tubular leaves. description: Flowering shoots glabrous, (15–)25–53(–70) cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–6, cauline, scattered in the lower half of the stem, oblong to lanceolate, acute, mucronate, 2.5–11(–15) by 0.8–1.8 cm, drying blackish or dark brown. Sterile bracts 1–4, spreading or suberect, lanceolate, acuminate or acute, 0.9–3.3 cm long. Inflorescence semi-dense or lax, 10-to 35-flowered; rachis 8–19 cm long; floral bracts broadly lanceolate, acuminate or acute, 7.2–15 by 3–5 mm. description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 20–52 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–6(–9), cauline, usually scattered in the lower half of the stem, oblong-lanceolate, acute, mucronate, 4–13.5 by 1–2.5 cm. description: Flowering shoots glabrous, (12–)20–40(–56) cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–3, basal, oblong-lanceolate, acute, mucronate, 3.5–14 by 1–2.6(–3.3) cm. Sterile bracts 3–13, suberect or spreading, lanceolate, acuminate, 1–3.8 cm long. Inflorescence lax, (6–)10- to 20-flowered; rachis 4–17 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 5–14 by 1.5–3.5 mm. Flowers 2–3 mm in diameter, whitish-green, cream or white. Sepals obtuse or subacute; dorsal sepal erect, elliptic, 2.5–3.5(–4.5) by 1.5–2.5 mm; lateral sepals spreading, oblong, 2.5–3.5(–4.3) by 1–1.5 mm; basally connate with the labellum and the petals. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, oblong, obtuse to acute, 2.6–3.7(–4.3) by 1.3–1.7 mm. Labellum 3–6(–6.8) mm long, 3-lobed above a basal part of 2–3 by 0.7–0.8 mm, base with a prominent callus; midlobe lorate or triangular, obtuse, 1–1.7 by 0.3–0.8 mm; side lobes triangular, usually 1–2.5 by 0.3–0.5 mm, shorter or longer than the midlobe; spur carrot-shaped, 1.2–2.2 mm long, forwards-bent, entire, apex subacute or acute. Column 1.2–2.2 mm long; stigmas clavate, united with the labellum base. Ovary (including pedicel) 5–10 mm long. Capsule sessile, elliptic-fusiform, 8.5–15.5 mm long, 2–3.4 mm in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Peristylus lacertiferus . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 238. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, to 25 cm tall. Foliage leaves 1–3, basal, lanceolate-oblong, acute, 6–8 by 2–2.5 cm. Sterile bracts 3–5, narrowly lanceolate, erect or suberect and top portion spreading, acuminate, 0.8–1.1 cm long. Inflorescence lax to semi-dense, 8–20-flowered; rachis 5–10 cm long; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, ca. 9 by 3.8 mm, exceeding the ovary. Flowers white, not opening very widely. Sepals obtuse, with obscure subapical mucros, dorsal sepal erect, elliptic, ca. 5.1 by 2.9 mm; lateral sepals not much spreading, narrowly elliptic, ca. 4.9 by 2.3 mm, basally united with the labellum. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, elliptic-ovate, obtuse, ca. 5 by 2.4 mm, upper third slightly fleshy. Labellum ca. 5.4 by 3.5 mm, 3-lobed above a united basal portion of ca. 4 by 2.9 mm, with a prominent fleshy callus ca. 2.7 mm from the apex, entirely glabrous; midlobe rounded triangular, ca. 1.2 by 1.4 mm; side lobes similar, ca. 1.2 by 1.4–1.7 mm; spur ovoid, obtuse or subacute, ca. 2.4 mm long. Column ca. 2.7 mm long; stigmas clavate and ca. 1.8 mm long; central rostellum lobe ca. 1.5 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) ca. 8 mm long. Capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Peristylus maingayi . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 239. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 20.5–28 cm tall, slender. Foliage leaves 2–3, cauline, scattered in the lower stem part, grass-like, linear or narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, blades 3–9.3 by 0.23–0.28 cm. Sterile bracts 1–2, suberect or spreading, lanceolate, 0.8–1.3 cm long. Inflorescence lax, 10- to several-flowered: rachis 7–10 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate to ovate, acuminate, 4–6 by 1.8–2 mm. Flowers pale yellow or green, to 6 mm in diameter. Sepals obtuse; dorsal sepal erect, concave, oblong-ovate, 3.2–3.5 by 1.6–2 mm; lateral sepals narrowly elliptic ovate, spreading, 3–3.7 by 1–1.3 mm. Petals cohering with the dorsal sepal, narrowly lanceolate ovate, obtuse or subacute, 2.8–4 by 1.4–1.7 mm, distally fleshy. Labellum 3.8–4.5 mm long. 3-lobed with a basal undivided part 1.3–1.8 mm long, base with an obscure rounded transversal ridge; midlobe lorate or linear, obtuse, 1.9–2.8 by 0.7–0.9 mm; side lobes lorate, obtuse, 1.7–2.2 by 0.3–0.5 mm; spur stout, clavate-cylindric, obtuse, 1.7–1.8 mm long, 1–1.1 mm thick when seen from the side. Column 1–1.2 mm long; stigmas ca. 0.2 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) cylindric-fusiform, 5–6 mm long. Capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Peristylus mannii . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 240. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 26–64 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–4, cauline, clustered in the stem middle, ovate-lanceolate, acuminate or acute, mucronate, 4.5–18 by 1.2–3.5 cm; stem below the foliage leaves with 3–5 tubular leaves. Sterile bracts 2–8, spreading or suberect, lanceolate, acuminate, 1–3 cm long. Inflorescence lax, many-flowered: rachis 9–31 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate to ovate, acuminate, 7.7–15 by 1.8–2.5 mm. Flowers about 5 mm in diameter, green, greenish-brown, pinkish-brown, cream or white. Sepals elongate-elliptic, obtuse or subacute; dorsal sepal erect, 3.3–5(–6) by 1.5–2.3 mm; lateral sepals spreading or reflexed, sometimes mucronate, 3.6–6 by ca. 1.5 mm, partly rolled-in. Petals erect, basally connate with the labellum, lorate-elliptic, obtuse, 3.6–5 by 1.8–2 mm. Labellum 3.2–5.5 mm long, 3-lobed above an entire basal part 2.2–4 mm long, base slightly concave; midlobe elliptic-oblong, 1–1.8 by 0.6–1 mm; side lobes obtusely triangular, 0.8–0.9 by 0.6–0.8 mm; spur fusiform with minute mouth, 2–2.8 mm long. Column 1–1.2 mm long; stigmas ca. 1 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 5.5–12 mm long. Capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Peristylus parishii . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 242. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 21–35 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–4, cauline, clustered or scattered in the stem middle, ovate, acute, mucronate, 5.5–12 by 1.8–5.8(–6.5) cm; stem below the foliage leaves with 3–5 tubular leaves. Sterile bracts 1–3, spreading or suberect, lanceolate, acuminate, 1.3–2.2(–3.3) cm long. Inflorescence lax, 9- to 30-flowered; rachis 5–20 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate to ovate, acuminate, 5–9 by 2–3.3 mm. Flowers 3–5 mm in diameter, green, greenish-white or brownish-green, also green with yellow labellum, sometimes sepals pinkish-brown with white petals and labellum. Sepals obtuse; dorsal sepal erect, elliptic, 2–5 by 1.8–3(–3.5) mm; lateral sepals oblong, not much spreading, often mucronate, 2–4(–5.5) by 1.6–2.2(–2.5) mm. Petals erect, elliptic, obtuse, 2–4.5(–5.2) by 1.4–3(–3.4) mm. Labellum 3.8–5(–6) mm long, 3-lobed with an undivided basal portion 2.5–3.3 mm long; midlobe ovate, 1–1.7 by 1.5–2(–2.5) mm; side lobes ovate, 0.5–1(–1.5) by ca. 1 mm; spur globular, 1–2.7 mm long. Column ca. 1.5 mm long; stigmas stout, ca. 0.8 mm long, connate with the labellum base. Ovary (including pedicel) 5–8 mm long. Capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Peristylus prainii . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 245. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 55–69 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–4, cauline, scattered in the lower part of the stem, lanceolate, subacute or acute, 5–16 by 1.8–3.1 cm. Sterile bracts 3–7, suberect, lanceolate-oblong, acuminate, 1–2(–3.8) cm long. Inflorescence lax, many-flowered; rachis 19–36 cm long; floral bracts broadly lanceolate, acuminate, 11–15 by 2–3 mm. Flowers 6–10 mm in diameter, colour unknown. Sepals elliptic-oblong, subacute or obtuse; dorsal sepal erect, 3.5–5 by 2.1–2.4 mm; lateral sepals reflexed or spreading, 3.8–5.6 by 1.3–1.9 mm, rolled-in. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, elliptic-lorate, subacute or obtuse. 3.5–5.3 by 1.2–2 mm, front margins connate with the base of the labellum. Labellum 5–5.5 mm long, the suberect 1.1–2 mm long hypochile and the spreading 3-lobed epichile separated by a prominent transversal ridge; midlobe lorate, 3–4 by ca. 1 mm; side lobes pointing upwards, linear, stiff, 3.5–4 by 0.55–0.8 mm; spur globular, obscurely stalked, entire or bifid, 2.9–4 mm long and 1.9–3 mm thick. Column ca. 1 mm long; stigma 1.2–1.4 mm long, adnate to the labellum. Ovary (including pedicel) 9–11 mm long, smooth. Capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Peristylus rigidus . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 245. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, (15–)25–70 cm tall. Foliage leaves 2–5, ranging from basal to cauline and scattered in the lower half of the stem, lanceolate-oblong, acute, mucronate, 5.2–17 by 1.2–2.9 cm. Sterile bracts 1–6, suberect or spreading, lanceolate, acuminate or acute, 0.9–2.3(–3) cm long. Inflorescence lax, few- to many-flowered; rachis (5–)8–24(–30) cm long; floral bracts broadly lanceolate, acuminate, 4.5–10 by 1.5–3 mm. Flowers 5–8 mm in diameter (labellum side lobes excluded), green or yellow-green, rarely whitish. Sepals elliptic-oblong, obtuse, occasionally mucronate; dorsal sepal erect, 3.2–5 by 1.5–2.2 mm; lateral sepals reflexed, 3.2–5.2 by 1–1.6 mm, sometimes rolled-in. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal, elliptic, subacute or obtuse, 3.5–5 by 1.3–1.7 mm, basally connate with the labellum. Labellum 4–5.5 mm long, the hypochile and 3-lobed epichile separated by a prominent transversal ridge; midlobe lorate, 1.9–3(–3.6) by 0.6–1.2 mm; side lobes thread-like and forming a right angle with the midlobe, spreading or pointing upwards, 13–28 by 0.3–0.4 mm, often curled; spur globular, stalked, entire or apically bifid, 2.5–3.8(–4.3) mm long, 1–2.5(–4) mm thick. Column 1–1.5 mm long; stigma 1.2–1.4 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 5–8 mm long. Capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Peristylus tentaculatus . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 248. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Terrestrial (rarely epiphytic) herbs with tubers or fasciculate fleshy roots. Flowering shoots 7–120 cm tall; stem glabrous. Foliage leaves 1–7, sheathing at base, scattered along the stem or crowded on its lower part; upper part of the stem bearing 1–3 small non-sheathing leaves. Inflorescence spicate; bracts much smaller than the foliage leaves, at least those in the distal part of the inflorescence shorter than the flowers. Flowers 2 to many, resupinate, white to (yellowish-)green. Sepals plain (i.e., not saccate), glabrous; dorsal sepal 2–9 mm long. Petals connivent with the dorsal sepal. Labellum narrowly attached to the column, linear, entire. smooth on the ventral side, spurred at base; spur longer than the labellum lamina, subacute, not constricted at base. Column semiterete, with a slightly bilobed, concave stigma; distal part of rostellum broad; viscidia 2, naked; anther firmly attached, thecae not extending from the column; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 200 species. The very wide distribution mainly encompasses subarctic, temperate and subtropical areas of the northern hemisphere, but it also extends southward through tropical regions to Central America and to major parts of Malesia, including New Guinea; 2 species in Thailand.
bibliographicCitation: Platanthera  . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 250. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Flowering shoots 30–120 cm tall, with fasciculate fleshy roots at base. Foliage leaves 3–7, light green with slightly darker veins, the basal ones with a 1–10 cm long petiole, those on the stem sessile; lamina narrowly ovate to elliptic or lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 2.2–13.5 by 1.1–7 cm; uppermost foliage leaf not surpassing the base of the rachis if held against the stem; upper part of stem with ca. 3 small non-sheathing leaves. Inflorescence very lax, 7- to many flowered; rachis 6–30 cm long; bracts ovate to lanceolate, acuminate, 4–22 by 2–9 mm, those in the mid-portion of the inflorescence shorter than or subequal to the ovaries. Flowers (pale) green. Sepals  3-veined; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, elliptic to ovate, obtuse to rounded, 4–8.5 by 1.8–6 mm; lateral sepals reflexed, lanceolate-oblong, subacute to rounded, 5.3–9 by 1.6–3.5 mm. Petals obliquely ovate to lanceolate, acute, 3-veined, 4.1–4.6 by 1.4–1.6 mm. Labellum fleshy, obtuse, 6.5–11.5 by 1.2–3 mm; spur down-curved parallel to the ovary, filiform. 14–16.5 mm long. Column 2.7–5 mm long. Ovary 7–16 mm long. Capsule erect, oblongoid. 10–18 mm long, 4–6 mm in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Platanthera angustata . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 250. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots 7–20 cm tall, with 1–3 cylindric-fusiform tubers at base. Foliage leaves 1–3, mid-green, sessile, linear to (ob)lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 4.1–15 by 0.8–4.1 cm; uppermost foliage leaf surpassing the base of the rachis if held against the stem; upper part of stem with 1–2 non-sheathing leaves. Inflorescence fairly lax, 2- to 12-flowered; rachis 0.8–15 cm long; bracts ovate-oblong to linear-lanceolate, acuminate to acute (rarely obtuse), 8–38 by 3.5–14 mm, those in the mid-portion of the inflorescence distinctly longer than the ovaries. Flowers (yellowish-)green with a whitish-green labellum. Sepals 3- to 5-veined; dorsal sepal cordate-triangular, rounded to subacute, 5.4–9 by 6.5–9.5 mm; lateral sepals recurved, falcately lanceolate, obtuse to subacute, 8–12 by 2.9–4.5 mm. Petals very obliquely ovate-lanceolate, obtuse to subacute, 2-veined, 6.5–9 by 3.8–5.7 mm. Labellum obtuse to acute. 10.2–16 by 2.8–4.5 mm; spur straight, cylindric, 15–25 mm long. Column 5–6 mm long. Ovary 9–17 mm long. Capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Platanthera angustilabris . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 252. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Terrestrial, rhizomatous herbs; the creeping stem-like rhizome rooting from its nodes. Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base, 20–51.8 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–7, scattered to crowded on the stem, petiolate, sheathing at base. Inflorescence spicate; bracts glabrous to pubescent on the dorsal side. Flowers 7 to many, more or less resupinate. Sepals free, 1- to 2-veined, glabrous; dorsal sepal 2.5–7.8 mm long. Petals adherent to the dorsal sepal. Labellum basally adnate to the column, straight (i.e., not twisted), 4.2–9 mm long along the mid line, differentiated into hypochile, mesochile, and epichile; hypochile saccate (but not protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals when the flower is viewed from the side), inside with 1 stout appendage on either side and divided longitudinally by a low keel that raises abruptly in the apical two-thirds to three-fourths into an erect bicarinate semi-discoid callus; mesochile usually with one pair of (sub)entire lateral flanges; epichile bilobed or simple and rounded-truncate. Column straight (i.e., not twisted); stigma bipartite, flat; rostellum triangular, bifid; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile: pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous. Fruit a capsule dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 22 species. The largely Indomalesian distribution reaches Sri Lanka and the Himalayas in the west, Japan in the north and Vanuatu and New Caledonia in the southeast; 3 species in Thailand.
bibliographicCitation: Rhomboda  . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 253. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots 20–34 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–7, crowded on the lower part of the stem, dark olive-green with a whitish band along the mid-vein above, pale greyish-green underneath; petiole (including sheaths) 1.6–3.3 cm long; lamina obliquely (ovate-)lanceolate, acute to acuminate, sometimes mucronate, 2.5–8 by 1.2–2.8 cm. Inflorescence finely pubescent, narrowly cylindric, fairly lax, 7- to many-flowered; rachis 4.5–11.1 cm long; bracts ovate, acute to acuminate, shorter than the ovaries, ciliate, otherwise glabrous, 5.5–9 by 2.2–5 mm. Flowers barely opening, olive-green with white petals and labellum. Sepals 1-veined; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, ovate, obtuse, 3.5–4 by 2.5–2.6 mm; lateral sepals boat-shaped, obliquely ovate, somewhat falcate, obtuse to acuminate, 4.4–4.7 by 2.4–2.8 mm. Petals very obliquely elliptic-ovate, acute to subacuminate. 4–4.1 by 1.9–2.2 mm. Labellum 4.2–4.7 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with 1 clavate, irregularly dentate appendage on either side; epichile transversely elliptic to subquadrate, entire, as wide as or narrower than the hypochile when flattened. Column 1.8–2.1 mm long; anther acuminate in front, ca. 1.8 mm long, 1.3–1.6 mm wide. Ovary 8–11 mm long. Capsule sessile, ellipsoid to subspherical (extended in a short beak), glabrous, 9–11 mm long (including perianth remnants), 6–8 mm in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Rhomboda abbreviata . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 254. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots 24–41 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–5, crowded on the lower to middle part of the stem; petiole (including sheath) 2–3.7 cm long; lamina obliquely lanceolate, acute, mucronate, 6.2–7.8 by 2.6–3.3 cm. Inflorescence pubescent, cylindric, lax, 18- to many flowered; rachis 7.7–10.3 cm long; bracts ovate to lanceolate-triangular, acute, shorter than or subequal to the ovaries, ciliate, papillose-pubescent on the dorsal side, 6.7–10 by 3.4–4.4 mm. Flowers mainly dull reddish-brown with white petals and labellum. Sepals 1-veined; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, ovate, subacuminate, 3.8–4.6 by 2.5–3 mm; lateral sepals strongly boat-shaped, obliquely elliptic-ovate, subacuminate, 4.5–4.8 by 2.3–2.6 mm. Petals very obliquely elliptic, subacute to abruptly subacuminate, sometimes mucronate, 4.6–5.2 by 2.5–3 mm. Labellum 4.2–4.6 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with 1 stalked, shield-like, irregularly lobed appendage on either side, epichile bilobed, distinctly wider than the hypochile when flattened, lobules obliquely linear-triangular, entire. Column 2.1–2.4 mm long; anther acuminate in front, 2.2–2.3 mm long, 1.5–1.8 mm wide. Ovary 10–11 mm long. Capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Rhomboda lanceolata . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 255. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots 45–51.8 cm tall. Foliage leaves 4–7, scattered on the lower to middle part of the stem; petiole (including sheeath) 4–5 cm long; lamina obliquely elliptic-lanceolate to ovate, acute, mucronate, 7.2–11 by 3.2–4.9 cm. Inflorescence pubescent, cylindric, lax to fairly dense, many-flowered; rachis 12–16.6 cm long; bracts ovate-triangular, acuminate to acute, shorter than or subequal to the ovaries, (erose-)ciliate, pubescent to subglabrous on the dorsal side, 8–10 by 6–7.2 mm. Flowers mainly brownish-green to reddish-brown with white to yellow petals and labellum. Sepals 1-veined (to 2-veined); dorsal sepal slightly boat-shaped, ovate to broadly lanceolate, subacuminate, 6.2–7.8 by 3–3.9 mm; lateral sepals strongly boat-shaped, broadly and obliquely ovate, subacuminate, 6.5–7.3 by 4–5.8 mm. Petals very obliquely ovate to elliptic, abruptly acuminate to acuminate-caudate, 5.5–7.5 by 2.8–4.1 mm. Labellum 6.8–9 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with 1 clavate, irregularly lobed appendage on either side; epichile bilobed, distinctly wider than the hypochile when flattened, lobules obliquely obtriangular-obovate with erose hind margins. Column 2.5–3.8 mm long; anther long-acuminate in front, 2–3.5 mm long, 1–2 mm wide. Ovary 12–16 mm long. Capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Rhomboda moulmeinensis . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 257. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Terrestrial, deciduous, tuberous herbs, usually glabrous. Flowering shoots unbranched. Foliage leaves one to few, in the Asian species cauline and scattered in the lower portion of the stem, ovate-lanceolate or elliptic. Usually with one to few erect or deflexed sterile bracts above the foliage leaves. Inflorescence terminal, racemose; floral bracts deflexed, much longer than the ovary. Flowers many, not resupinate, in the Asian species ranging from pink to white or yellow. Sepals and petals unlobed, spreading, basally fused to each other and to the labellum for about one fifth to one quarter of their length, margins often denticulate or erose. Labellum unlobed, deeply galeate, size of the entrance ranging from one half to two thirds of the galea width, with an apical flap; spurs two, pendent, on both sides of the ovary and shorter to somewhat longer than it. Column with elongate undifferentiated column-part; anther pendent, pollinia 2, sectile; stigma as a flap; rostellum shield-like, in the Asian species with 2 lateral viscidia. Ovary (including pedicel) with pronounced ridges.</br></br>A genus of ca. 90 species distributed mainly in Africa with two widespread species in India, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar, Thailand and China; predominantly found in grassland or savanna, less commonly in forested habitats: a single species recently recorded in Thailand.
bibliographicCitation: Satyrium  . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 258. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Terrestrial herbs with underground tubers. Flowering shoots 10–40 cm tall; stem papillose-pubescent. Foliage leaves 1(–2), basal, green with purple (to dark green) spots above, mottled purple/green underneath; petiole not perceptible for most of the flowering period, but later elongating to 3–5.5 cm; lamina acute to acuminate. Inflorescence spicate, lax; rachis 2–15 cm long; bracts much smaller than the foliage leaves, shorter than the flowers. Flowers 2 to many, resupinate, predominantly pink to rose-coloured. Sepals plain (i.e. not saccate), rounded to subacute; dorsal sepal (narrowly) elliptic-oblong, 2.8–9 mm long; lateral sepals obliquely (ovate-) elliptic. Labellum narrowly attached to the column, 3-lobed, smooth or with numerous tufts of papillae on the ventral side, spurred at base; spur approximately as long as the labellum lamina, not constricted at base. Column with a bilobed, concave stigma; distal part of rostellum narrow, straight, squeezed in between the thecae; viscidia 1–2, contained in one versatile bursicle; anther firmly attached, thecae not extending from the column; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary papillose-pubescent. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of 3 species distributed in the Shan State of Myanmar, northwestern Thailand and Yunnan; 3 species in Thailand.
bibliographicCitation: Sirindhornia  . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 1, 2011. Pg. 260. Accessed 2022-04-21
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots 27–34 cm tall. Foliage leaf narrowly (ovate- elliptic, 9.7–12 by 4–6 cm. Inflorescence 16- to 20-flowered; bracts ovate-triangular, acute, (1-to) 3-veined from the base, 7.2–10.7 by 4.5–5.5 mm. Sepals more or less papillose-ciliate, slightly and irregularly papillose on the dorsal surface; dorsal sepal 7.5–9 by 3.1–3.8 mm; lateral sepals reflexed, 8.8–9.4 by 4.2–4.6 mm. Petals porrect, linear-oblong, slightly oblique, rounded to obtuse or irregularly truncate, 2- to 3-veined from the base, glabrous, 9–9.4 by 2.4–2.5 mm. Labellum deeply three-lobed in its proximal part (incisions 2.5–2.6 mm deep), pink with purple markings in its basal and central part (side lobes green), glabrous, 10.9–11.5 by 7.3–7.6 mm; side lobes obliquely and broadly rectangular, truncate; midlobe subspathulate, rounded; spur straight with abruptly downcurved and vertically inflated apex, 8.1–8.8 mm long. Column abruptly tapering from a broad base, abruptly recurved at the middle, 3.4–4.4 mm long; pollinia with one common viscidium. Ovary 14–15 mm long.

description: Flowering shoots 12–40 cm tall. Foliage leaf (broadly) elliptic to (ob)ovate, 2.4–11.5 by 1.8–5.4 cm. Inflorescence 7-to many-flowered; bracts lanceolate to triangular-ovate, (sub) acute to acuminate, 1- to 3-veined from the base, 4.2–16 by 1.7–3.5 mm. Sepals (sub)glabrous; dorsal sepal 2.8–4.5 by 1.5–2.6 mm; lateral sepals slightly spreading, 3.5–4.8 by 1.6–2.8 mm. Petals connivent with the dorsal sepal, (ovate-)oblong, slightly oblique, rounded to truncate, glabrous or somewhat ciliate, 2-veined (rarely 3-veined) from the base, 3–4.7 by 1.4–2.3 mm. Labellum more or less obtriangular, somewhat three-lobed in its distal part (incisions 1–2.3 mm deep), rose-coloured to white with numerous tufts of purple papillae on the ventral side, 3.4–6.8 by 4.1–8.4 mm; side lobes rounded to nearly truncate; midlobe truncate to rounded; spur slightly downcurved, cylindric, often slightly widened towards the rounded apex, 4.5–7.7 mm long. Column clavate, 1.5–2.8 mm long; pollinia with separate viscidia. Ovary 5–10.9 mm long.

description: Flowering shoots 10–25.5 cm tall. Foliage leaf elliptic to (ob)ovate or broadly lanceolate, 4.4–13.4 by 1.7–5.4 cm. Inflorescence 2- to 17-flowered; bracts lanceolate-triangular, acute, 3- to 6-veined from the base, 6–17.5 by 2–5.1 mm. Sepals glabrous; dorsal sepal 5.8–6.8 by 3–3.3 mm; lateral sepals spreading to reflexed, 6.4–7.2 by 4.4–4.8 mm. Petals converging to form a hood over the column, oblong to elliptic, slightly oblique, rounded to nearly truncate. 3-veined from the base, ciliate, 6.3–7 by 3.4–3.7 mm. Labellum broadly obovate to flabellate or suborbicular, shallowly three-lobed in its distal part (incisions 1–1.5 mm deep), pink with purple spots, glabrous, 10.5–13.5 by 11–15.3 mm; side lobes and midlobe rounded; spur straight to slightly up- or downcurved, cylindric, slightly tapering towards the rounded apex, 11–13.9 mm long. Column subterete, 3.5–4.4 mm long; pollinia with separate viscidia. Ovary 11.5–21.5 mm long.

description: Terrestrial herbs producing fasciculate fleshy roots from the base of an erect, more or less glandular-pubescent stem. Foliage leaves crowded on the basal part of the stem, petiolate (below) to sessile (above). Inflorescence racemose, spirally twisted. Flowers many, resupinate, translucent, white to predominantly pink. Sepals free. Petals connivent with the dorsal sepal. Labellum straight (i.e., not twisted), 3.5–6 mm long, oblong-pandurate with rounded apex, concave at base, inside provided with 1 lateral appendage on either side. Column straight (i.e. not twisted); rostellum triangular, bifid; viscidium 1, naked, anther versatile; pollinia 2, deeply cleft, acrotonous. Ovary more or less glandular-pubescent. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 40 species distributed throughout most of North America and Eurasia (except the arctic and some of the northernmost temperate regions); in the south reaching northernmost South America, Mediterranean North Africa, eastern Australia and New Zealand; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 16–59 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–5, sheathing at base, (linear-)lanceolate, acute, 6.5–16.9 by 0.3–1.1 cm. Inflorescence dense; rachis 5.6–16.6 cm long; bracts lanceolate triangular, acuminate, longer than the ovary, subglabrous, 4–11 by 2.5–4 mm. Flowers short pedicelled to subsessile, not opening widely. Sepals subsimilar, ovate-lanceolate, obtuse to acute, more or less glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 3-veined, 3.5–5.7 by 1–2.2 mm. Petals linear to linear-oblong, obtuse to rounded, 1-veined, 3–5 by 0.9–1.3 mm, entire. Labellum partly enveloping the column at base, sessile to shortly clawed, recurved, 3.5–5.6 by 2–3.8 mm; proximally with entire margins; distally flat, more or less glandular-setose on the ventral side, with erose-undulate margin. Column subclavate, 2–2.3 mm long; anther obtuse to acute in front, 1.3–1.6 mm long. Ovary 3–6 mm long. Capsule short-pedicelled, ellipsoid to obovoid, glandular-pubescent to subglabrous, 4–7 mm long, 2.5–3.5 mm in diameter.

description: Terrestrial or hemiepiphytic, chlorophyllous, climbing herbs; aerial roots produced one at each node; stems branched, cylindric or quadrangular, sometimes longitudinally grooved, thin to thick, succulent, smooth, glabrous, green. Foliage leaves large and fleshy or reduced to small scales and caducous, base not sheathing, one at each node, distichous or spirally arranged, glabrous; petiole usually twisted at intersection to stem. Inflorescences axillary, racemose, few to many-flowered; rachis with scale-like bracts. Flowers large, showy, short-lived, opening in succession. Sepals free, spreading, smooth, 5- to 7-veined. Petals free, spreading, 5-veined, often with strong midvein. Labellum adnate to the sides of column with its basal margins, forming a chamber, the free part entire or 3-lobed, usually with hairy appendages inside, often longitudinally grooved outside. Column long, slender, curved near the top; anther pointing downwards on the front of the column; pollen forming up to 4 sticky pollen smears without caudicles or viscidium, rostellum broad below anther. Ovary slender, articulate to sepals and petals. Fruit fleshy, cylindric, indehiscent. Seeds large, with stout testa.</br></br>A genus of ca. 107 species, distributed throughout tropical America, Africa, Madagascar to tropical Asia and the Pacific Islands (absent from Australia); 5 species in Thailand.

description: Stems climbing up to several meters high, cylindric, green, 3–6 mm in diameter, longitudinally grooved; each aerial root perpendicular to a petiole. Foliage leaves lanceolate, 8–25 by 2–8 cm, apex acute to acuminate, coriaceous, glabrous; petiole 8–20 mm long. Inflorescence 3- to 10-flowered; rachis 3–4 cm long, glabrous; bracts ovate, 2–5 by 3–4 mm, persistent, coriaceous, glabrous. Flowers showy, long-pedicelled, opening widely at first, afterwards closed. Sepals glabrous, light greenish-yellow, oblanceolate, apex acute, slightly hooded; dorsal sepal 4.5–5.5 by 1.2–1.5 cm, 11- to 13-veined; lateral sepals 4.5–5.5 by 1.2–1.5 cm, 13- to 15-veined. Petals glabrous, light greenish-yellow, oblanceolate, 5–5.2 by 1.2–1.6 cm, 11- to 15-veined, with strong midvein outside, apex acute to obtuse, not hooded. Labellum white, with dark purple markings towards base inside, spathulate in outline, obscurely 3-lobed, 4–5 cm long along the mid-line, with a brush on disc opposite anther, 3–5 mm high, consisting of close transversal flat hinged scales, dented or fringed along the truncate apex, pointing downwards in the flower; side lobes rounded, adnate to the column for most of the column length, the apical margins wavy, recurved, trumpet-like, 3–4 cm across both sides when spread out; midlobe with just a few fat white papillae, about 2 mm long. Column slender, 3.8–4.2 cm long, glabrous, winged at the top; anther ca. 2 mm long, glabrous. Ovary (including pedicel) 1.5–3 cm long. Berry oblong, 5–10 cm by 0.7–1 cm.

description: Stems climbing to several meters long, subquadrangular, green, 5–8 mm in diameter, longitudinally grooved; each aerial root perpendicular to a scale leaf. Foliage leaves reduced to small scales and early caducous, light green, lanceolate, 10–12 by 2–3 mm, apex acuminate, glabrous. Inflorescence 2- to 3-flowered; rachis 2–7 mm long, glabrous; bracts ovate, 2–2.5 by 2–3 mm, persistent, membranous, glabrous. Flowers showy, long-pedicelled. Sepals glabrous, light greenish-yellow, oblong-oblanceolate, apex obtuse, slightly hooded; dorsal sepal 2.3–2.6 by 0.7–0.9 cm, 11- to 15-veined; lateral sepals 2.4–2.6 by 0.7–0.8 cm, 13- to 15-veined. Petals glabrous, light greenish-yellow, oblong-oblanceolate, 2.3–2.6 by 0.8–0.9 cm, 11- to 13-veined, with strong midvein outside, apex acute to obtuse, not hooded. Labellum white to light green, 3-lobed, 2.5–3 cm long along the mid-line, with a brush on disc opposite anther, 2–3 mm high, consisting of close transversal flat hinged scales, deeply fringed at the apex, pointing downwards in the flower, with red streaks on either side, below brush with scattered papillae; side lobes rounded, adnate to the column up to below anther, the apical margins wavy, recurved, 2–2.2 cm across both sides when spread out; midlobe rounded, 1–1.2 cm wide at base, ca. 1 cm long, margin wavy, with dense long fine pale violet hairs continuing in a median band down to the brush, hairs 2–4 mm long. Column slender, 1.5–1.7 cm long, glabrous, slightly winged at the top; anther ca. 2 mm long, glabrous. Ovary (including pedicel) 1–3 cm long. Berry oblong, 7–8 by 0.6–0.7 mm.

description: Stems climbing to several meters long, cylindric, green, 3–8 mm in diameter, longitudinally grooved; aerial roots thin, tendril-like, each of them perpendicular to a petiole. Foliage leaves oblong to oblong-lanceolate, 10–20 by 3.5–8 cm, apex apiculate to cuspidate, coriaceous, glabrous, petiole 3–10 mm long. Inflorescence 3- to 12-flowered; rachis 3–6 cm long, glabrous; bracts ovate, 2–10 by 4–5 mm, persistent, coriaceous, glabrous. Flowers showy, long-pedicelled, opening widely at first, afterwards closed. Sepals glabrous, greenish-yellow, more green at apex, obovate-oblanceolate, apex obtuse to rounded, slightly hooded; dorsal sepal 2.5–3 by 1.3–1.5 cm, 15- to 17-veined; lateral sepals 2.5–3 by 1.3–1.5 cm, 17- to 19-veined. Petals glabrous, light greenish-yellow, more yellow at apex, obovate-oblanceolate, 2.3–2.5 by 1.4–1.5 cm, 11- to 13-veined, with strong midvein outside, apex obtuse to rounded, not hooded. Labellum light greenish-yellow, with reddish brown markings towards base inside, ovate-oblong in outline, obscurely 3-lobed, 1.8–2.5 cm long along the mid-line, with a large globose woolly ball on disc above anther, 3–4 mm wide, consisting of twisted very fine hairs; side lobes rounded, adnate to the column for less than half of the column length, 1.8–2.3 cm across both sides when spread out; midlobe bipartite by a split, margin membranous and plicate, at centre with V-shaped hairiness of fine hairs. Column slender, 1–1.4 cm long, glabrous; anther ca. 2 mm long, glabrous. Ovary (including pedicel) 1.5–3.5 cm long. Berry oblong, 4–8 by 1–1.2 cm.

description: Stems climbing up to several meters high, cylindric, green, 5–10 mm in diameter, longitudinally grooved; aerial roots thin to thick, each of them perpendicular to a petiole. Foliage leaves elliptic, 15–25 by 5.5–11.5 cm, apex acuminate, coriaceous, glabrous; petiole 1–2.2 cm long. Inflorescence 5- to 18-flowered; rachis 6–10 cm long, glabrous; bracts ovate, 7–8 by 4–5 mm, persistent, coriaceous, glabrous. Sepals glabrous, greenish-yellow, oblanceolate, apex acute, slightly hooded; dorsal sepal 3.8–5 by 1.2–1.6 cm, 17- to 19-veined; lateral sepals 3.7–5 by 1.2–1.7 cm, 13- to 17-veined. Petals glabrous, greenish-yellow, oblanceolate, 4–4.7 by 1.3–2 cm, 15- to 19-veined, with strong midvein outside, apex acute, not hooded. Labellum white, with purple throat, ovate in outline, obscurely 3-lobed, 3.5–4.5 cm long along the mid-line, with a brush on disc opposite anther, 3–5 mm high, consisting of close transversal flat hinged scales, dented or fringed along the truncate apex, pointing downwards in the flower; side lobes rounded, overlapping and enclosing the column, adnate to the column up to below stigma, the apical margins wavy, 3–3.5 cm across both sides when spread out; midlobe ovate, 1.5–2 cm wide at base, 1–1.5 cm long, margin wavy, with fat papillae near apex, papillae 5–8 mm long. description: Terrestrial, rhizomatous herbs; the creeping stem-like rhizome rooting from its nodes. Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base, 8–32 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–9, scattered along the stem to crowded on its lower or upper part, petiolate, sheathing at base. Inflorescence racemose, short and dense; bracts longer than the ovary, glabrous to glandular pubescent on the dorsal side. Flowers 7 to many, resupinate, scarcely opening. Sepals free, boat-shaped, 1-veined; dorsal sepal 2.1–5.8 mm long. Petals connivent with the dorsal sepal, 1-veined, entire. Labellum basally adnate to the column, straight (i.e., not twisted), 0.9–4.3 mm long, shorter than the sepals, simple with incurved margins, hooded at apex, proximally with a spur that protrudes below the bases of the lateral sepals when the flower is viewed from the side; spur inside with 1 stalked appendage on either side. Column straight (i.e., not twisted); stigma bipartite, flat; rostellum triangular to subquadrate, retuse to bifid, producing an infundibular tegula that encloses the attenuated bases of the pollinia; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 35 species distributed from scattered areas in mainland Southeast Asia (west to northeastern India) throughout Malesia to northern Queensland and Fiji; 3 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 11–32 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–9, scattered along the stem or crowded on its lower part, uniformly shiny green; petiole (including sheath) 1.2–2.3 cm long; lamina obliquely (obovate-helliptic to ovate-lanceolate, (sub)acute to shortly subacuminate, often mucronate, 2–6.2 by 1.3–3.5 cm, 1.5–2.5 times as long as wide. Inflorescence glandular pubescent, ellipsoid to ovoid or cylindric, 15- to many-flowered; rachis 1.7–6.8 cm long; bracts linear-oblong to narrowly oblanceolate, obtuse to acuminate, entire, glabrous, 8.4–12 by 2.7–5.3 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled, greenish-white to brownish-white. Sepals subglabrous, with fleshy apices; dorsal sepal lanceolate-oblong, rounded, 4.5–5.8 by 1.7–2.2 mm; lateral sepals obliquely elliptic-oblong, slightly falcate, rounded to obtuse, 4.6–5.8 by 2.2–3 mm. Petals obliquely lanceolate-oblong to falcately linear-lanceolate, rounded, 4.2–5.1 by 1.5–1.9 mm. Labellum ovate 3.5–4.3 mm long, with a low median papillose to papillose-pubescent ridge on the ventral side, usually splitting in a V at base; spur slenderly barrel-shaped, rounded to obtuse, 3.2–5.2 mm long. Column 2.1–2.2 mm long; anther obtuse in front, 1.5–1.6 mm long, 1.2–1.3 mm wide. Ovary (including pedicel) 5.6–9 mm long. Capsule erect, short-pedicelled, ellipsoid to oblongoid, 0.8–0.9 cm long, 0.3–0.4 cm in diameter, glabrous.

description: Flowering shoots 15–20 cm tall. Foliage leaves ca. 7, scattered along the stem to somewhat crowded on its upper part, uniformly green; petiole (including sheath) 1.2–1.5 cm long; lamina (linear-)lanceolate, acute, 3.7–7 by 1-2 cm, 3–4 times as long as wide. Inflorescence subglabrous, ovoid to ellipsoid, many-flowered; rachis ca. 2.2 cm long; bracts somewhat boat-shaped, (ovate-) oblong to lanceolate-triangular, rounded to subacuminate, erose-ciliate, otherwise glabrous or nearly so, 4.9–10.1 by 2.3–3.2 mm. Flowers white (apices of sepals sometimes pink). Sepals glabrous, with fleshy apices; dorsal sepal linear-lanceolate, obtuse, 2.1–5 by 1.1–1.7 mm; lateral sepals obliquely (oblong-)lanceolate, obtuse, often hooded at apex, 2.9–5.5 by 1.1–2.2 mm. Petals obliquely ovate to lanceolate-oblong, subtruncate, 1.9–3.2 by 1.1–1.6 mm. Labellum (ovate-)oblong, 0.9–2.7 mm long, with a low median ridge on the ventral side, smooth (or very nearly so); spur broadly spindle-shaped to obliquely conical-cylindric, rounded, 1.8–3.7 mm long. Column 1.7–2 mm long; anther subacuminate in front, ca. 16 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm wide. Ovary (including pedicel) 1.5–3 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 8–12 cm tall. Foliage leaves 6–8, scattered on the stem to somewhat crowded on its upper part, dark green to purplish-brown with one or three whitish longitudinal bands; petiole (including sheath) 0.5–1.6 cm long; lamina obliquely (oblong-)ovate to lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 1.8–4.3 by 0.7–2.4 cm, 1.7–2.6 times as long as wide, often with wavy margins. Inflorescence subglabrous, ellipsoid to subspherical, 7- to 17-flowered; rachis 1.1–1.7 cm long; bracts somewhat boat-shaped, linear-triangular, subacute to acuminate, entire, glandular-pubescent on the dorsal side, 7–9 by 2.5–4 mm. Flowers white (sepals proximally green to brown). Sepals subglabrous, dorsal sepal linear to ovate, obtuse to subacute, 5–5.8 by 1.4–2.6 mm; lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate, acute to (sub)acuminate, 6.5–6.7 by 2.2–2.6 mm. Petals obliquely lanceolate-oblong, rounded to truncate, 3.5–8 by 1.3–2.5 mm. Labellum narrowly elliptic to ovate-oblong 2.9–4.2 mm long, devoid of a median ridge, smooth (or very nearly so); spur slenderly barrel-shaped, rounded, 3.4–4 mm long. Column 2.1–2.4 mm long; anther obtuse in front, 1.3–1.4 mm long, 0.7–0.8 mm wide. Ovary (including pedicel) 4.6–5.1 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Terrestrial, rhizomatous herbs; the elongate (to very strongly condensed) rhizome rooting from its nodes. Flowering shoots (2–)3.5–48 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3–9(–17), scattered (to crowded) on the stem. Inflorescence spicate or racemose: bracts glabrous or (glandular-) pubescent on the dorsal side. Flowers (2–)7 to many, more or less resupinate. Sepals free, 1 to 5-veined; dorsal sepal 3–9 mm long. Petals free or adherent to adnate to the dorsal sepal. Labellum basally adnate to the column, straight (i.e., not twisted), 2.7–7.5 mm long along the mid-line, differentiated into hypochile, mesochile, and epichile; hypochile concave to saccate (but not protruding below the bases of the lateral sepals when the flower is viewed from the side), inside with 1–3 appendages on either side; mesochile devoid of lateral flanges (but sometimes with low keels); epichile bilobed or simple. Column straight (i.e., not twisted), sometimes provided with two prominent wings or low vertical keels or lamellae on the front; stigma bipartite, flat; rostellum triangular, bifid, sometimes producing a tiny tegule; viscidium 1, naked; anther versatile; pollinia 2, basitonous. Ovary glabrous to (glandular-)pubescent. Fruit a capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of ca. 70 species, distributed from tropical and southern Africa across the Indian Ocean to (sub)tropical mainland Asia, Malesia, Queensland and Fiji; additionally, a few probably anthropochorous occurrences elsewhere (see Z. strateumatica); 10 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots (6–)10–35 cm tall. Foliage leaves petiolate, (greyish-)green above, dull light green underneath; lamina linear-lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, acute, (1–)1.3–4.4 by (0.4–)0.5–1.7 cm. Inflorescence pubescent; rachis (1–)1.2–8.3(–12) cm long; bracts lanceolate to ovate, acuminate to cuspidate, pubescent on the dorsal side, 3.7–10.9 by 2.3–4.1 mm. Flowers (sub)sessile, mainly (brownish- to pinkish-)green (petals and labellum white, sometimes with a green or yellow blotch on the epichile). Sepals 3-to 5-veined, pubescent on the dorsal side (rarely subglabrous); dorsal sepal lanceolate-oblong to ovate, rounded to obtuse, 4.5–9 by 2.7–4.7 mm; lateral sepals obliquely (elliptic-)oblong to (ovate-lanceolate, rounded to subacute, 3.8–7.1 by 1.7–3.4 mm. Petals adherent to the dorsal sepal, obliquely lanceolate-oblong to elliptic, not abruptly narrowed below the apex, 4.3–8.5 by 1.6–3.1 mm. Labellum 3.7–7.5 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with 1 papilla-like appendage on either side; mesochile smooth on the outside: epichile bilobed, with a distinct V-shaped sinus at apex when spread out distinctly wider than the hypochile, lobules (obtriangular-)obovate to subcircular, 2.1–7.1 by 1.6–4.8 mm (length measured along the hind edge), 1.1–2.4 times as long as wide. Column devoid of ornaments on the front or with 2 vertical keels that are sometimes abruptly protruding just below the rostellum. Ovary pubescent. Capsule erect, (sub)sessile, oblongoid, (sparsely) pubescent, 0.7–1.3 cm long, 0.3–0.5 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 18–33 cm tall, sometimes branched at base. Foliage leaves petiolate (below) to subsessile (above), blackish-green to reddish-green above, dark green to reddish grey underneath; lamina lanceolate to narrowly ovate, slightly oblique, acute to obtuse, minutely mucronate, (1.3–)2–6.7 by (0.7–)1–3 cm. Inflorescence pubescent; rachis 3.7–8 cm long; bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, ciliate, otherwise glabrous, 5.4–10 by 2.4–4.4 mm. Flowers sessile, mainly dull reddish with white petals, cream to yellow labellum and olive-brown ovary. Sepals 3-veined, glabrous; dorsal sepal ovate, rounded, 5–6 by 2.8–4.2 mm; lateral sepals linear lanceolate, slightly oblique, obtuse, 4.5–6 by 1.3–1.6 mm. Petals adnate to the dorsal sepal, obliquely to falcately oblanceolate, not abruptly narrowed below the apex, 4.6–5.4 by 1.4–1.5 mm. Labellum 3.9–4.2 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with 1 scale-like appendage on either side; mesochile minutely papillose-pubescent on the outside; epichile subquadrate to transversely subrectangular, truncate when spread out, half as wide to approximately as wide as the hypochile. Column with two low, slightly incurved, obliquely triangular lamellae on the front. Ovary glabrous. Capsule suberect, sessile, obliquely oblongoid-fusiform, glabrous, 12–14 mm long, 3.5–4 mm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 12–28 cm tall. Foliage leaves subsessile, lanceolate to ovate, acute, mucronate, (1.3–)2.1–3.8 by 0.7–1.6 cm. Inflorescence pubescent; rachis 1.3–10.5 cm long; bracts linear-triangular, acuminate, pubescent on the dorsal side, 2.8–6.4 by 0.9–2.2 mm. Flowers sessile, mainly dull green with white petals and labellum. Sepals 1- to 3-veined, pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal ovate-triangular, obtuse, 3–4.3 by 1.4–3 mm; lateral sepals obliquely ovate-lanceolate, rounded to subacute, 2.9–3.4 by 1.3–1.6 mm. Petals adherent to the dorsal sepal, obliquely linear (to linear-oblong), not abruptly narrowed below the apex, 3–3.7 by 0.8–1.2 mm. Labellum 2.7–3.1 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with 1 papilla like appendage on either side; mesochile smooth on the outside; epichile bilobed, rounded to subtruncate when spread out, distinctly wider than the hypochile, lobules subquadrate, 0.7–0.8 (–0.9) by 0.8–0.9(–1) mm (length measured along the hind edge), 0.9–1(–1.1) times as long as wide. Column devoid of ornaments on the front. Ovary pubescent. Capsule (sub)erect, sessile, ellipsoid, sparsely pubescent, 0.7–0.8 cm long, 0.3–0.4 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 12–32 cm tall. Foliage leaves petiolate; lamina lanceolate, acute, mucronate, 2.7–9.4 by 0.8–3 cm. Inflorescence pubescent; rachis 1.5–8.7 cm long; bracts ovate lanceolate to linear-triangular, acuminate to cuspidate, pubescent on the dorsal side, 2.8–9.2 by 1.8–3.9 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled to subsessile, mainly purplish- to brownish-green with the petals and labellum (especially the epichile) bright orange-yellow. Sepals 1- to 3-veined, sparsely pubescent on the dorsal side (rarely glabrous); dorsal sepal ovate, obtuse, (3.4–)3.5–5.3 by (2–)2.3–3 mm; lateral sepals obliquely elliptic-oblong, obtuse, 2.7–4.3 by (1.2–)1.4–2.2 mm. Petals adherent to the dorsal sepal, obliquely oblanceolate to oblong, not abruptly narrowed below the apex, 3.1–5.1 by (1–)1.2–2 mm. Labellum (2.8–)3.1–4.7 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with 1 papilla-like appendage on either side; mesochile smooth on the outside; epichile bilobed, truncate (less often with a shallow V-shaped sinus at apex) when spread out, distinctly wider than the hypochile, lobules broadly subrectangular, slightly widening towards apex, (1.3–)1.6–3.6 by (1.1–)1.3–3.3 mm (length measured along the hind edge), 1.1–1.2 times as long as wide. Column on the front with two low vertical keels that are abruptly protruding just below the rostellum. Ovary (including pedicel) glabrous to sparsely pubescent. Capsule suberect, short-pedicelled to subsessile, oblongoid-ellipsoid, subglabrous, 0.7–0.9 cm long, 0.3–0.4 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 12–18 cm tall. Foliage leaves petiolate, uniformly dark reddish-green; lamina obliquely lanceolate, acute, mucronate, 1.3–3.5 by 0.7–1.3 cm. Inflorescence glandular pubescent; rachis 1.1–5.1 cm long; bracts boat-shaped, ovate, acuminate to cuspidate, (glandular-) pubescent on the dorsal side, 3.7–5.2 by 1.9–2.8 mm. Flowers short-pedicelled, mainly greenish with white labellum. Sepals 3-veined, subglabrous or sparsely papillose-pubescent at base on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal ovate, obtuse, 3.5–4.1 by 2.7–3.2 mm; lateral sepals obliquely ovate, rounded, 3.6–4.2 by 2.1–2.8 mm. Petals adherent to the dorsal sepal, broadly and obliquely ovate, abruptly narrowed ca. 1 mm below the apex, 3.5–3.9 by 3.2–3.5 mm. Labellum 3.5–3.8 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with 2–3 more or less compressed appendages on either side; mesochile smooth on the outside; epichile bilobed, with a shallow V-shaped sinus at apex when spread out, wider than the hypochile, lobules subquadrate, 1.6–1.9 by 1.4–1.7 mm (length measured along the hind edge), ca. 1.1 time as long as wide. Column with two prominent subquadrate wings on the front. Ovary (including pedicel) glandular-pubescent. Capsule erect, short-pedicelled, ellipsoid, sparsely (glandular-)pubescent, 0.5–0.6 cm long. 0.3–0.4 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots (15.5–)22–48 cm tall. Foliage leaves sessile, narrowly linear-lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 1.7–6.7 by 0.2–0.5 cm. Inflorescence pubescent; rachis 2–9 cm long; bracts (linear-)lanceolate, (sub)acuminate, pubescent on the dorsal side, 4–10 by 1.7–3 mm. Flowers (sub)sessile, white. Sepals 1-veined, pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal ovate, obtuse, 3.3–4.1 by 2.8–3.1 mm; lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate-oblong, obtuse to subacute, 3.1–3.2 by 1.5–1.6 mm. Petals adherent to the dorsal sepal, obliquely (oblong-)oblanceolate, not abruptly narrowed below the apex, 3.7–4.2 by 1.2–1.6 mm. Labellum 3–3.2 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with 1 papilla-like appendage on either side; mesochile smooth (or nearly so) on the outside; epichile bilobed, truncate when spread out, wider than the hypochile, lobules semicircular to semielliptic, 1.1–1.3 by ca. 1.2 mm (length measured along the hind edge), 0.9–1.1 time as long as wide. Column devoid of ornaments on the front. Ovary densely pubescent. Capsule (sub)erect, subsessile, ellipsoid, pubescent, 0.3–0.5 cm long, 0.2–0.3 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 10–40 cm tall. Foliage leaves petiolate, dull green above, pale light green underneath; lamina elliptic-lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, acute (to acuminate), 1–5.2 by 0.5–1.3 cm. Inflorescence pubescent; rachis 1.5–8.7 cm long; bracts ovate, acuminate to cuspidate, pubescent on the dorsal side. 2.5–3.6 by 1.5–2.2 mm. Flowers sessile, mainly green (petals and labellum white, sometimes with a green or yellow blotch on the epichile). Sepals 1- to 3-veined, pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal ovate, rounded to obtuse, 3.5–4.1 by 2.2–2.7 mm; lateral sepals obliquely (oblong-lanceolate, obtuse to subacute, 2.8–3.8 by 1.1–1.7 mm. Petals adherent to the dorsal sepal, obliquely oblong to oblanceolate, not abruptly narrowed below the apex, 3–3.7 by 1–1.4 mm. Labellum 2.9–3.7 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with 1 papilla-like appendage on either side; mesochile smooth on the outside; epichile bilobed, truncate or with a very shallow V-shaped sinus at apex when spread out, distinctly wider than the hypochile, lobules (linear-)rectangular, (1–)1.7–2.1 by 0.9–1.2 mm (length measured along the hind edge), (1.1–)1.8–2.3 times as long as wide. Column devoid of ornaments or with two low vertical keels on the front. Ovary pubescent. Capsule erect, sessile, (slenderly) ellipsoid, sparsely pubescent, 0.7–1 cm long, 0.3–0.6 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots (2–)3.5–14(–24.5) cm tall. Foliage leaves sessile, dark green above, greyish-green and often tinged with purple underneath, narrowly linear-lanceolate (to linear-oblong), acute to acuminate, (0.5–)1–5.3(–6.9) by 0.2–0.4(–0.8) cm. Inflorescence glabrous; rachis (0.9–)1.3–4(–8.7) cm long; bracts (ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, glabrous, 3.5–10(–15.2) by 2.5–5(–6) mm. Flowers sessile, mainly white to rose-coloured with a bright (greenish-)yellow epichile. Sepals 1- to 3-veined, glabrous; dorsal sepal ovate, obtuse to rounded, 4.1–5.8 by 2.4–2.9 mm; lateral sepals obliquely oblong, rounded, 3.4–4.3 by 1.6–2.2 mm. Petals adherent to the dorsal sepal, obliquely ovate-lanceolate, not abruptly narrowed below the apex, 3.7–5.2 by 1.5–2.1 mm. Labellum 2.7–4 mm long along the mid-line; hypochile inside with 1 papilla-like appendage on either side; mesochile smooth (or nearly so) on the outside; epichile bilobed, truncate to rounded at apex when spread out, wider than the hypochile, lobules semicircular, 0.7–0.9 by 1.1–1.5 mm (length measured along the hind edge), ca. 0.6 times as long as wide. Column devoid of ornaments on the front. Ovary glabrous. Capsule erect, sessile, ellipsoid, glabrous, 0.4–0.8 cm long, 0.3–0.4 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 5–17 cm tall. Foliage leaves petiolate, dark purplish with a pale mid-line; lamina obliquely (oblong-lanceolate (to ovate), acute, mucronate 1.5–2.3 by 0.5–0.8 cm. Inflorescence pubescent; rachis 2–3.4 cm long; bracts boat-shaped, (ovate-)lanceolate, acuminate, pubescent on the dorsal side, 5.4–8.6 by 2.4–3 mm. Flowers subsessile, mainly dark yellowish-green with whitish petals and white epichile. Sepals 1- to 3-veined, papillose pubescent or shortly glandular-pubescent at base on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal ovate, rounded, 5.5–5.7 by 3.2–3.4 mm; lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate-oblong to ovate-oblong, rounded, 5.4–5.5 by 2.6–2.8 mm. Petals free, obliquely lanceolate-oblong to ovate, not abruptly narrowed below the apex, ca. 5.4 by 2.1–2.6 mm. Labellum 5–5.4 mm long along the midline; hypochile inside with 2 (often somewhat cleft) appendages on either side; mesochile smooth on the outside; epichile transversely elliptic to bilobed, rounded to truncate (and sometimes apiculate), as wide as or wider than the hypochile, lobules (if recognizable) semicircular, up to 0.7 by 1 mm (length measured along the hind edge), up to 0.7 times as long as wide. Column with two prominent subtriangular wings on the front. Ovary papillose-pubescent. Capsule not seen.
